title: Advanced Associate, Cloud Services Engineer
description: **Advanced Associate, Cloud Service Engineer** **Location:** Chennai, India (Hybrid) **Team:** Atlassian Administration & Engineering **Experience:** 2+ years in Atlassian administration or a related platform engineering role **About the Role** We’re looking for an Atlassian engineer with a few years of experience to join our Atlassian Administration & Engineering team. You’ll work with a team of seven engineers who support a global Atlassian Cloud platform used by about 10,000–12,000 people around the world, across Jira, Confluence, Jira Product Discovery (JPD), and Jira Service Management (JSM). We recently finished a large migration to Atlassian Cloud, and we’re still bringing separate product instances together into one environment. The migration moved fast and left technical debt behind, so we’re now focused on cleanup: removing legacy customizations and making the platform match Atlassian Cloud best practices. You’ll own parts of that work yourself. That means spotting problems, proposing fixes, and building automation that keeps the platform clean and scalable. **What You’ll Do** * **Platform administration:** Take ownership of administration across Jira, Confluence, JPD, and JSM, including permissions, schemes, workflows, custom fields, and space and project configuration. * **User lifecycle automation:** Design and maintain automated onboarding and offboarding, group management, and license management, working with identity providers and SCIM provisioning. * **Space and project lifecycle:** Build repeatable, automated processes to create, standardize, and archive projects and spaces at scale. * **Reduce legacy customizations:** Audit the environment for redundant custom fields, workflows, schemes, and app dependencies. Then propose and carry out plans to remove or consolidate them, using automation wherever possible. * **Automation engineering:** Build and maintain Atlassian Automation rules for routine and bulk administrative work. Where built-in features fall short, design robust API-driven automation. * **Engineering practices:** Treat platform automation as production code. Changes are peer-reviewed, tested, and released through a pipeline, not run ad hoc. * **AI-assisted engineering:** Make AI part of your everyday workflow, from drafting scripts and analyzing configurations to writing documentation, so you deliver more without lowering the quality bar. * **Service metrics and observability:** Capture service metrics through the Atlassian APIs, store them outside the platform, and build dashboards that show how the service is used and how it’s performing. * **Solution evaluation:** Weigh built-in Atlassian features against custom or external solutions, and explain clearly why the chosen option is the best fit. * **Continuous improvement:** Challenge processes that are overly complex, costly, or full of manual toil, and propose simpler, automated alternatives. * **Best practices and governance:** Help define standards, naming conventions, and configuration guidelines for each product, and document them. * **Instance consolidation:** Contribute to ongoing migration and consolidation work, including planning, data validation, and post-migration cleanup. * **Escalations and mentoring:** Resolve complex platform issues, and share knowledge with less experienced teammates and stakeholders. **What We’re Looking For** **Required:** * 2+ years of hands-on administration of Jira and/or Confluence, preferably in Atlassian Cloud * Working experience with Atlassian Automation, including building and troubleshooting rules * Scripting skills in Python, PowerShell, or a similar language, and experience building automation against REST APIs (including JSON, authentication, pagination, and rate limits) * Hands-on experience with Git and version-controlled code or configuration, plus a working understanding of CI/CD practices: build, test, release, versioning, and branching strategies * Daily, effective use of AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot, Cursor, or Claude, with the judgment to validate, refine, or reject what they produce * A solid understanding of Jira configuration: schemes, workflows, screens, fields, and permissions * Experience managing users and groups at scale in Atlassian Admin * The ability to analyze an existing configuration, recommend simplifications, and explain the trade-offs clearly * Clear written and verbal communication in English, and comfort working with stakeholders around the world * A bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, IT, or a related field, or equivalent experience **Nice to have:** * Atlassian certifications (ACP-120, ACP-620, or Cloud Organization Admin) * Experience with AWS services (such as Timestream, Lambda, or S3) and with dashboards in Grafana or similar tools * Experience administering JSM (request types, queues, SLAs, portals) or JPD * Experience with identity integration such as Okta, Azure AD/Entra ID, SAML SSO, or SCIM * Migration experience with JCMA/CCMA or instance merges * Experience with ScriptRunner or other marketplace apps, and with assessing app usage **What You’ll Gain** * Ownership of meaningful parts of a large, enterprise-scale Atlassian Cloud platform * Real influence over how a global platform is standardized and modernized * A clear growth path to Specialist and Advanced Specialist roles on the Atlassian Platform Engineering team * Support for Atlassian certifications and ongoing learning title: AI Deployment Manager
description: Why RapidClaims US healthcare providers are paid only after every visit is turned into billing codes and submitted as a claim. That work is manual, slow and error-prone, and it is getting harder: claim denial rates have nearly doubled in a decade, from 7% to over 13%, while provider margins have fallen from around 10% to just 1% to 2%. Fixing the revenue cycle is now one of the biggest priorities for every health system in the country, and AI is how they are trying to fix it. RapidClaims is an AI revenue cycle platform. Our autonomous agents code medical records, improve clinical documentation and manage denials, across 25+ specialties, with 98%+ coding accuracy. Clients include Federally Qualified Health Centers (FQHCs), specialty physician groups, community health centers and hospital systems. The company has raised $11 million in total funding from top investors, including Accel and Together Fund. What sets us apart is speed to value. Where incumbents need tens of thousands of records and months of implementation to cover a new specialty, we need a few hundred records and hours. That advantage only counts if every client goes live quickly, stays stable and keeps growing. This role exists to make sure they do. Why this role exists In AI for the revenue cycle, the model is no longer the hard part. The hard part is making it work inside a real provider's workflow: their electronic health record (EHR) system, their specialties, their payer mix, their coders and their habits. The companies winning this market are the ones that get clients live fastest and keep them stable at scale. For a client, the deployment is the product. Every client goes through the same journey with us: a pilot to prove value, a go-live, a period of stabilisation, then expansion into more of their work. Each stage depends on several teams pulling in the same direction, and we are hiring so that one owner holds that together. The team you will join is responsible for pilots and live clients. You will work with engineering, data science, operations and quality control every day. You will wear multiple hats: problem solving, design thinking, debugging client issues and getting them resolved, and working with operations to manage client volume and bring efficiency. What you will own ● The deployment. Run pilots, take clients live, stabilise them and lead their expansion. You are accountable for the client's outcome end to end, and you are the person who knows where every client stands today. ● The translation. Convert client needs into clear, prioritised asks for our teams, and convert our progress into updates the client can act on. Nothing gets lost between the client and the people building for them. ● The resolution. Trace an issue across data, workflow, model and people, route it to the right owner, and drive it to closure. You report problems solved, not problems found. ● The tooling. Prototype agents, prompts and automations that remove manual steps from this job, deploy them, and measure the impact. Where a process is repeated, you are expected to build rather than repeat. ● The product. Turn patterns you see across clients into product features and process changes, so that every client after yours runs on what you learned. Your first 45 days ● By day 15. You understand how a chart moves through our platform and through a client's revenue cycle. You have shadowed a live account, sat in on client calls, and mapped where work gets stuck and why. ● By day 30. You are running a pilot: discovery, data and integration scoping, workflow setup with data science, and the first quality review with the coding and quality control teams. You have shipped one small tool that saves someone on the team hours every week. ● By day 45. You own a portfolio of clients. One automation you built is in daily use by the team, and one product or process change exists because you saw a pattern across clients and made the case. How we will measure success ● Time from pilot start to go-live, and from go-live to a stable, predictable weekly volume. ● Volume moving on time for your clients, and how quickly stuck work gets unstuck. ● Accuracy and quality outcomes for your clients, and how quickly issues reach data science when the model is the cause. ● Expansion: more of each client's specialties, sites and workflows moving onto the platform. ● Manual effort removed from the team by what you built. What you bring ● 2+ years of experience, with shipped AI work. At least one AI-driven solution you built and put in front of real users: an agent, an automation, an internal tool or a product feature. You are hands-on with prompting, agents and evals, and you can walk us through what you built, how you tested it, and what broke. ● A fast learner. Healthcare billing and medical coding are deep domains. You do not need to know them today, but you need to pick them up quickly and enjoy doing so. We are betting on learning speed over prior domain exposure. ● A structured thinker. You break messy problems down MECE (mutually exclusive, collectively exhaustive), so nothing is missed and nothing is counted twice, and you can hold that structure while the details keep changing. ● Comfort with data. SQL, Python or advanced spreadsheets, enough to answer your own questions without waiting on someone else. ● Clear communication, written and spoken. You will talk to clients, engineers, coders and founders in the same day, and each of them needs a different version of the same truth. ● Comfort with context switching. This role moves between a client call, a stuck batch and a prompt that is not working. It is not a role with long quiet blocks, and the people who thrive in it find that energising rather than draining. ● High ownership and a problem-solving nature. You start with "how do I fix this", and you want the zero-to-one journey with the mess that comes with it. Good to have. Exposure to healthcare, billing or US insurance. A prior client-facing or operations role at a startup. Familiarity with agent frameworks, structured outputs and tool calling, or LLM evaluation tools. What this role is not ● Not an implementation or project-management role where you run a checklist and hand off. You build, debug and own the outcome. ● Not a pure operations role. If building your own tools does not excite you, this will feel like the wrong job. ● Not a quiet role. Several clients, several teams, many open threads at once. Benefits: * Paid time off * Provident Fund Application Question(s): * Are you willing to work in Koramangala Bangalore office * How many years of experience in AI * How many years of experience in AI deployment * Have you worked in Health care Industry * How many No. of end-to-end deployment you have completed * what is your team leading size * Do you have managerial experience * What is your current CTC * What is your expected CTC * What is your notice period * Have you been interviewed by Rapid Claims before? Using your agent is mandatory and the point: we grade the result and the trajectory. Half a day. We expect 4-6 focused hours; going well past that is a signal we'd rather not see; it usually means the slice wasn't cut tightly enough. If you hit the edge of the box with things still on your list, stop and write down what you'd have done next and why cutting it was right. title: AI Outcome Customer Engineer, Google Cloud
description: In most instances, this position requires in-person interviews as part of the hiring process. ### **Minimum qualifications:** * Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience. * 7 years of experience troubleshooting technical issues for internal/external partners or customers. * Experience leading technical delivery strategies, debugging systems, and interfacing with product/engineering organizations. * Experience reading or debugging code in a general purpose coding language (e.g., Java, Python, JavaScript, etc.). * Experience with enterprise integrations (e.g., APIs, enterprise content management (ECMs), identity), cloud infrastructure, or AI/ML model deployments. * Experience in system design or orchestration frameworks. ### **Preferred qualifications:** * Experience orchestrating specialized technical resources to execute complex builds. * Experience engaging with, presenting to, and influencing technical stakeholders or executive leaders. * Ability to dive deep into novel technical problems, decipher extreme ambiguity, diagnose bugs, and emerge with credible architectural solutions. * Excellent executive communication skills, capable of translating deep technical integration issues into business impact. **About the job** ----------------- The Google Cloud team helps companies, schools, and government seamlessly make the switch to Google products and supports them along the way. You listen to the customer and swiftly problem-solve technical issues to show how our products can make businesses more productive, collaborative, and innovative. You work closely with a cross-functional team of web developers and systems administrators, not to mention a variety of both regional and international customers. Your relationships with customers are crucial in helping Google grow its Cloud business and helping companies around the world innovate. As an AI Outcome Customer Engineer, Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE), you will be responsible as an enterprise architect, technical debugger, and engineering liaison. You will bridge the gap between pre-sales agreement shaping and post-sales execution. Entering the agreement cycle during the technical evaluation phase for strategic accounts, you will ensure that solutions are shaped strictly through the lens of adoption, rapid activation, and viable delivery. You will be the overarching Enterprise Architect and Technical Delivery Manager charting the course. You will also be responsible for technical design, systemic debugging, product and engineering integration, and strategic FDE alignment. You will architect how these technical marvels actually integrate into the customer's IT ecosystem (connectors, identity, data residency, legal constraints) and drive the technical delivery strategy from start to finish. Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems. **Responsibilities** -------------------- * Partner with Account teams and practice Customer Engineer (CEs) during technical evaluation phases to assess project feasibility, shape proposals for long-term adoption, and validate FDE engagement requests. * Lead upfront technical design for enterprise-grade AI solutions, ensuring seamless and secure integration of models, agents, and connectors into existing customer data pipelines, identity providers, and compliance boundaries. * Dive into code-level context to diagnose and resolve complex customer implementation issues, identify core product bugs, and test workarounds to clear execution roadblocks. * Serve as the definitive liaison to core Product and Engineering teams, troubleshooting systemic deployment blockers and translating real-world field feedback into actionable feature requests. * Steer implementation strategy through technical authority and architectural foresight while owning the technical reality of delivery alongside customer-facing teams. Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form.

title: AI Platform Senior Engineer, QA
description: **About Accrete** Accrete is an agentic managed services company: an AI workforce that does high-stakes, judgement-heavy work for government and enterprise clients — at the economics of software, not labor. From national security to commercial operations, Accrete delivers the work on one platform, with unlimited expert agents and expert judgement. **About the Role:** We are seeking an **AI Platform Senior Engineer, QA – Agentic AI & Automation** to lead quality assurance for our agent-driven platforms and AI models. This role focuses on validating intelligent agents, non-deterministic AI outputs, and cross-product workflows using advanced automation and AI evaluation techniques. You will play a key role in building our **Enterprise AI Trust & Validation Framework**, ensuring reliability, transparency, and scalability of AI systems. **Key Responsibilities** ------------------------ ### **Agentic AI & System Testing** * Test multi-agent workflows, orchestration layers, and cross-domain intelligence systems * Validate AI-generated narratives, themes, and analytical outputs. * Perform groundedness, coherence, hallucination, and stability testing. * Test conversational AI and chat-based agent systems. * Evaluate consistency across multiple runs and detect output drift. ### **Automation & Framework Development** * Design and maintain automation frameworks using **Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Pytest, and Playwright**. * Build E2E automation for UI, APIs, and agent pipelines. * Develop reusable test utilities for AI validation and regression testing. * Integrate automation with CI/CD pipelines. ### **AI Model & Evaluation Testing** * Validate in-house AI/ML models and inference pipelines. * Implement LLM-as-Judge and semantic similarity-based validation. * Perform statistical and comparative testing for model outputs. * Support testing of models deployed on AWS. ### **A****PI & Performance Engineering** * Perform API testing using Postman and automated scripts. * Design and execute load and stress testing. * Monitor system performance under AI-heavy workloads. * Identify bottlenecks and scalability risks. ### **Quality Strategy & Collaboration** * Analyze business requirements, user stories, and AI specifications. * Design test strategies for agentic and AI-driven systems. * Work closely with Engineering, Product, and Data Science teams. * Track defects, quality metrics, and release readiness. * Drive continuous improvement in QA processes **Required Qualifications** --------------------------- * 6–8+ years of experience in QA, Automation, or Quality Engineering. * Strong proficiency in **Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Pytest, and Playwright**. * Experience testing AI systems, chatbots, or LLM-based platforms. * Strong understanding of non-deterministic system testing. * Experience with API testing (Postman, REST frameworks). * Hands-on experience with performance testing. (K6 familiarity is a plus). * Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments. * Strong analytical and debugging skills. * Excellent communication and documentation abilities. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience with agent frameworks (LangChain, AutoGen, CrewAI, etc.). * Knowledge of RAG systems and vector databases. * Exposure to MLOps and AI observability tools. * Experience with cloud platforms (AWS preferred). * Familiarity with statistical validation and NLP evaluation. * CI/CD experience (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab). * Familiarity with containerization technologies such as Docker/Kubernetes **Core Competencies** * AI Quality Engineering * Agent Workflow Validation * Automation Architecture * Model Evaluation & Monitoring * Performance Engineering * Risk Assessment * Cross-team Collaboration * Ownership Mindset **Career Growth** This role offers growth into positions such as: * Principal AI QA Engineer * AI Systems Quality Architect * QA Engineering Lead * AI QA Engineering Manager **Cultural Fit & Values** At Accrete, success goes beyond technical expertise. We value: * **Ownership & Accountability:** Drive initiatives to completion with high standards and proactive problem-solving. * **Transparency & Communication:** Share information openly and give and receive constructive feedback. * **Strategic Thinking & Problem-Solving:** Analyze challenges critically and develop effective, scalable solutions. * **Collaboration & Professionalism:** Work effectively across teams and contribute to a culture of mutual respect. * **Passion for AI & Innovation:** Stay curious, continuously learn, and push the boundaries of AI. * **Going Beyond the Job Description:** Look for opportunities to create impact beyond your immediate responsibilities. These principles shape our culture, performance expectations, and growth opportunities. **Company Benefits** * **Competitive Compensation:** Aligned with experience and market standards. * **Mediclaim:** ₹10 lakh coverage for you and your family. * **Flexible PTO & Hybrid Work:** Take time off when needed and enjoy remote flexibility in accordance with company guidelines. * **Growth & Development:** Access to professional learning opportunities and career advancement support. * **Onsite Perks:** Catered lunches and snacks. * **Team Bonding:** Company-sponsored social events and team activities. *Accrete is an equal opportunity/affirmative action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected Veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law.*

description: AppZen is the leader in autonomous spend-to-pay software. Its patented artificial intelligence accurately and efficiently processes information from thousands of data sources so that organizations can better understand enterprise spend at scale to make smarter business decisions. It seamlessly integrates with existing accounts payable, expense, and card workflows to read, understand, and make real-time decisions based on your unique spend profile, leading to faster processing times and fewer instances of fraud or wasteful spend. Global enterprises, including one-third of the Fortune 500, use AppZen’s invoice, expense, and card transaction solutions to replace manual finance processes and accelerate the speed and agility of their businesses. To learn more, visit us at www.appzen.com. ### **About the role :** We are looking for an **AI/ML Engineer** with 1–3 years of experience to join our growing AI team. In this role, you will build and ship the **LLM-powered and agentic features** that read, understand and make decisions on invoices, expense reports and card transactions for some of the world’s largest finance teams. You will work alongside senior AI/ML engineers, data scientists and product managers to take features from prototype to production, and own them once they are live. If you enjoy turning the latest advances in LLMs and agents into reliable and measurable products, AppZen is the place for you. ### **Key Responsibilities :** * **LLM & Agent Development:** Build and improve LLM-powered features and multi-step agentic workflows (e.g., using LangGraph) that extract, validate and reason over invoices, receipts, expense reports and card transactions. * **Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG):** Build retrieval pipelines (chunking, embeddings, vector search and re-ranking) that give models the right policy, vendor and transaction context to make accurate financial decisions. * **Tool Use & Structured Outputs:** Implement function calling and API integrations so that models can reliably query internal services and ERP/AP systems, and return validated, structured (JSON) outputs. * **Evaluation & Quality:** Build evaluation datasets, metrics and automated test suites to measure accuracy, hallucination rate, latency and cost, and use the results to improve prompts, retrieval and models. * **Production Engineering:** Package and deploy models and services using Docker and CI/CD pipelines, add monitoring and logging, and keep them reliable, scalable and cost-efficient in production. * **Cross-functional Collaboration:** Work closely with senior engineers, data scientists and product managers to turn customer and business requirements into well-scoped technical solutions, and contribute to code reviews and design discussions. ### **Required Skills :** * **Professional Experience:** 1–3 years of experience building and deploying ML/AI solutions in production, including at least 1 year of hands-on work on LLM-based applications. * **Programming:** Strong **Python** skills, with experience writing clean, tested, production-grade code and building REST APIs (e.g., FastAPI or Flask). * **LLM & Agent Frameworks:** Hands-on experience with **LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex** or similar frameworks, and with LLM APIs (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini) or open-source models. * **RAG & Vector Databases:** Practical experience building RAG pipelines using vector databases such as **Pinecone, Milvus, pgvector or FAISS**. * **Prompting & Structured Outputs:** Good understanding of prompting techniques (few-shot, Chain-of-Thought, ReAct) and of getting reliable structured outputs and function calls from LLMs. * **ML Fundamentals:** Solid grounding in ML and NLP fundamentals, with working experience in **PyTorch** or a similar framework. Exposure to fine-tuning (e.g., LoRA) is a plus. * **MLOps & Cloud:** Working knowledge of Docker, Git and CI/CD, and experience deploying on a cloud platform (AWS, GCP or Azure). Familiarity with LLM observability tools (e.g., LangSmith, Arize Phoenix or Weights & Biases) is a plus. * **Good to Have:** Experience with document AI (OCR, invoice or receipt data extraction) or with finance, accounts payable or expense data. * **Education:** Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. title: Analytics Lead
description: Product · Bengaluru You own *The Ken’s* data from the pipeline to the answer, and you’re the person the company trusts to say what the numbers mean, including when they say something nobody wants to hear. Bengaluru; full-time; 2 to 4 years of experience in data engineering, analytics engineering, or data science. Link Copied ### **About the role** *The Ken* runs on judgment: which stories to chase, which products to build, which experiments to try. We want every one of those bets grounded in evidence that supports or disproves our instincts, and we have more evidence than we use. Ten years of subscribers, reads, listens, renewals, and payments sit in a warehouse, with a few hundred dbt models and dashboards on top. What we don’t have is the part that makes data trustworthy. Our jobs run on fixed times and don’t tell anyone when they fail, so a late export produces a dashboard that looks normal but is wrong. Core numbers like an active subscriber or a renewal are defined in more than one place. We can’t say which story, newsletter, or episode brought a user who went on to subscribe, and much of what we do is meant to be judged on exactly that. We can’t run an experiment and measure it on revenue. And more of the team now asks questions of the data in plain language through AI, which makes all of this matter more: a model writing SQL against messy tables produces confident numbers that are wrong. This role owns *The Ken’s* entire data, analytics, and insights stack, end to end, by themselves. Half the job is building the systems that collect, organise, and check the data. The other half is owning the answers that come out of them, and being the truth teller when an answer is inconvenient. ### **What you will do** **Own the pipeline.** The warehouse, the transformation models, and the scheduled jobs that bring in data from our site, apps, payments, and product events. Make it reliable: jobs that wait for their inputs, alerts when something fails, a daily freshness check, so nobody finds a broken pipeline by noticing a strange number. Engineering owns how data is collected inside our products and supports you on infrastructure; everything from the moment data lands is yours. **Define the numbers once.** Active subscriber, signup, conversion, renewal, churn, story read, engaged day. Write each definition down, encode it with tests, and make sure every dashboard, analysis, and AI query uses the same one. **Build attribution.** Which stories, newsletters, episodes, and posts bring people who later subscribe, including what they read before they signed up. It doesn’t exist today, the whole company is waiting on it, and building it is yours. **Put AI on the warehouse, safely.** The team should be able to ask the data a question in plain language and get an answer that’s right. That means a clean, documented layer for AI tools like Claude to read, a metrics skill that carries the definitions, and checks that catch a plausible wrong answer before it reaches a decision. **Answer the questions that matter.** Why certain stories do well and others don’t. Which product levers work. Where the funnel leaks. What predicts a renewal. Take a vague business question, break it into data questions, write the queries, and present the finding as something a team can act on. **Make experiments possible.** Log who saw which variant, build a standard readout, and run the first paywall or nudge test measured on retained revenue against a holdout. **Keep the open review honest.** Supply the weekly analytics series and the numbers for the monthly review. Each owner presents their own; you make sure what they present is true, and say so when it isn’t. **Protect subscriber data.** Keep identified data away from the people and tools that don’t need it, pseudonymise what analysts and AI read, and keep credentials and keys where they belong. ### **What we are looking for** 2 to 4 years working professionally with data, in data engineering, analytics engineering, or data science, ideally at a subscription, media, or consumer internet business. You’re strong in SQL and Python, and comfortable with large datasets. Above all, we care whether you know which questions to ask, how to find the answers in data, and how to explain what they mean. You will do well here if: – You’ve built or run a pipeline other people depended on. You can describe a time it broke and how you found out. – You can take a vague question, turn it into data questions, and come back with a narrative. You know your way around cohort analysis, correlations, and the rest of the toolkit. – You’ve used dbt or something like it, and you’ve written a test for a number before someone else discovered it was wrong. – You have a point of view on LLMs and agents for analysis and automation, formed by using them, including where they fail. – You’d rather say “this data can’t tell us that” than produce a number. – You can tell a founder that a number they like is wrong, show why, and hold your ground. – You think about product: how readers discover us, what their experience is, what makes them engage and share. – Bonus: experimentation, subscription metrics (retention, renewal, lifetime value), GCP or BigQuery, data privacy. We understand not everyone will have all of this today. If you have most of it and want to acquire the rest on the job, apply. ### **What you get** The whole stack and the questions that sit on top of it, at a stage when most data people own one layer of someone else’s. A warehouse and pipeline that already work, built by engineers who will support you. Ten years of subscriber behaviour at a subscription business, which is rarer data than it sounds. Founders who read data and want to be told when they’re wrong, and who see your work every month. And over a year, the experience of building a company’s measurement from definitions to decisions, with your name on the numbers everyone uses. Have questions? Mail us at careers@the-ken.com with the name of the position in the subject line.

title: Applied AI and ML Engineer
description: In most instances, this position requires in-person interviews as part of the hiring process. ### **Minimum qualifications:** * Master's degree in a quantitative discipline such as Statistics, Engineering, Sciences, or equivalent practical experience. * 3 years of experience using analytics to solve product or business problems, coding (e.g., Python, R, SQL), querying databases or statistical analysis, or a PhD degree in a quantitative discipline (e.g., Statistics, Engineering, Sciences). * 1 year of experience building agentic systems. ### **Preferred qualifications:** * 4 years of experience using analytics to solve product problems, coding (e.g., Python, R, SQL), querying databases or statistical analysis, or a relevant PhD degree. * Experience working in a financial, audit, or highly regulated domain where deterministic accuracy and auditability are paramount. * Demonstrated expertise in developing and deploying AI or ML models and utilizing modern observability/monitoring tools to track performance, latency, model drift. * Excellent communication skills, with a proven ability to translate complex technical architectures and probabilistic model behaviors. * Strong command of classical ML modeling (e.g., time-series forecasting, tree-based models) alongside modern LLM/Generative AI tooling. **About the job** ----------------- Google's leadership team hand-picks thorny business challenges, and members of BizOps work in small teams to find solutions. As part of this team you fully immerse yourself in data collection, draw insight from analysis, and then zoom out to develop compelling, synthesized recommendations. Taking strategy one step further, you also persuasively communicate your recommendations to senior-level executives, roll-up your sleeves to help drive implementation and check back-in to see the impact of your recommendations. At Google, data drives all of our decision-making. As part of the Finance Data and AI (DnA) team in the CFO organization, our focus is on building secure, scalable, and intelligent solutions that transform financial operations. In this role, you will lead the technical strategy, design, and deployment of end-to-end AI/ML and Agentic solutions to transform legacy Finance processes into AI-native workflows. You will not just build models; you will design autonomous, self-correcting agentic systems that partner with Finance Googlers to drive unprecedented efficiency across Google's Finance organization. You will operate at the intersection of advanced ML and Agentic tools to design, develop and deploy large-scale solutions for various Finance processes like Accounting, Finance Operations, financial planning and analysis, etc. **Responsibilities** -------------------- * Contribute to the technical design of multi-agent workflows, utilizing a toolkit (ML and Gemini LLMs) to solve complex, multi-layered financial problems. * Build, prototype, and scale end-to-end AI agents. Collaborate with senior developers to build robust system architectures that prioritize reliability, usability, and auditability—ensuring clear human-in-the-loop interfaces for finance professionals. * Take prototypes from isolated testing environments to scaled production systems. Collaborate with senior developers to design and deploy high-availability model endpoints with robust health checks, error handling, retries, and fallback mechanisms. * Implement rigorous evaluation frameworks and guardrails to eliminate logical errors, hallucinations, and biases in automated financial decision-making. description: **Job Description:** Business Analyst (Conversational AI & Enterprise SaaS) **Company:** Tech Brainbucks Infosoft Private Limited **Product:** TBB-VaaniAI (VaaniAIOS) **Role:** Business Analyst / Technical Business Analyst **Location:** Hybrid / Jaipur / Delhi-NCR / Bengaluru (India) **Experience:** 2–5 Years **Employment Type:** Full-time --- **About Tech Brainbucks Infosoft & TBB-VaaniAI** **Tech Brainbucks Infosoft Private Limited** is a forward-thinking technology innovation company delivering next-generation enterprise software, AI solutions, and digital infrastructure. **TBB-VaaniAI** is our flagship sovereign, enterprise-grade Voice AI Operating System built specifically for Indian businesses and global markets. We empower MSMEs, large distributors, hospitals, recruitment agencies, and contact centers to automate high-value, high-context voice calls. From automated B2B trade receivables recovery (integrated with Tally and ERP systems) to sales lead qualification, healthcare OPD management, and customer care, TBB-VaaniAI delivers human-parity, bilingual (Hindi, Hinglish, English, and regional languages) conversations at millisecond latency. **Role Overview** We are seeking a proactive and detail-oriented \*\*Business Analyst\*\* to join the core \*\*TBB-VaaniAI\*\* product team at Tech Brainbucks Infosoft. In this role, you will be the crucial bridge connecting \*\*Client Business Needs, Product Strategy, Real-Time Telephony Data, and AI Engineering\*\*. You will define how our AI voice agents interact with customers, analyze conversational funnels, specify ERP/CRM integration touchpoints, and leverage data to optimize call outcomes, payment promises, and conversion rates. --- Key Responsibilities 1. Product Requirements & Conversational Blueprints (PRDs) - Interface with enterprise clients, business stakeholders, and partners to deeply understand domain-specific operational workflows. - Author detailed \*\*Product Requirement Documents (PRDs)\*\*, functional user stories, process flowcharts, and acceptance criteria. - Architect domain-specific \*\*AI Agent Blueprints\*\*: map conversation stages, objection-handling trees, dynamic voice tools (e.g., balance check, payment promise recording, WhatsApp invoice delivery), and live human transfer rules. 2. Telephony & Conversational Analytics - Regularly analyze live telemetry across voice campaigns: \*\*Connection Rates, Average Call Duration, User Interruption/Barge-in Rates, Intent Detection Accuracy, Broken Payment Promises, and Resolution Ratios\*\*. - Audit raw call transcripts and audio logs to discover drop-off points, regional linguistic accents, colloquial Hindi phrases, and prompt failures. - Provide empirical feedback to AI engineers to fine-tune system prompts, VAD sensitivity, and post-call structured extraction. 3. Enterprise Integration & Field Reality Workflows - Map real-world data pipelines between TBB-VaaniAI and Indian business software ecosystems (e.g., Tally Prime/ERP9, Busy, Zoho, Salesforce, and custom SQL databases). - Design solutions for real-world accounting gaps—such as "On-Account" running balances, bill-aging categories, payment reconciliation schedules, and automated receipt voucher writebacks. - Develop data-cleansing and contact-reconciliation workflows (e.g., identifying landlines, cleaning invalid phone numbers, CRM lead matching). 4. Metrics, Dashboards & A/B Testing - Track and report on core platform KPIs: Recovery Rates, Cost-per-Collection, Agent Utilization, Wallet Consumption, and First-Call Resolution. - Write SQL queries (PostgreSQL) to build custom analytics dashboards and executive performance reports. - Conduct data-driven experiments on calling windows, caller IDs (DIDs), retry algorithms, and script variations to maximize business outcomes. 5. Cross-Functional Execution & UAT - Work in tandem with Frontend, Backend, Voice Engineering, and Client Success teams to drive features from ideation to production. - Own \*\*User Acceptance Testing (UAT)\*\* for new module releases, ensuring zero regression and seamless end-to-end user journeys. - Create clear client onboarding collateral, user manuals, and feature release notes. Qualifications & Requirements - \*\*Experience:\*\* 2–5 years of experience as a Business Analyst, Product Analyst, or Implementation Consultant in B2B SaaS, Conversational AI, CPaaS/CCaaS, Telephony, or Fintech. - \*\*SQL & Data Proficiency:\*\* Solid hands-on experience with SQL (PostgreSQL preferred) to write joins, aggregates, and extract analytical insights. - \*\*Conversational AI & Telephony Understanding:\*\* Good grasp of Prompt Engineering, LLM capabilities and guardrails, Speech-to-Text (STT), Text-to-Speech (TTS), and telephony concepts (DIDs, IVR, Call Disposition, WebSockets). - \*\*ERP / Business Process Knowledge:\*\* Familiarity with Indian accounting systems (Tally, Busy, Marg) or CRM funnels (Lead $\rightarrow$ Opportunity $\rightarrow$ Invoice $\rightarrow$ Collection) is strongly preferred. - \*\*Strong Documentation Skills:\*\* Proven ability to turn complex business logic into clear, structured diagrams and technical PRDs (using Miro, Mermaid, Notion, or Confluence). - \*\*First-Principles Problem Solver:\*\* Eager to listen to real call recordings, diagnose why an outcome failed, and implement systematic fixes. --- ### What We Offer - \*\*High-Impact Work:\*\* Direct involvement in building one of India's most advanced enterprise Voice AI operating systems. - \*\*Collaborative Engineering Culture:\*\* Work closely with a skilled engineering team deploying scalable cloud architectures on GCP and modern AI models. - \*\*Fast Career Growth:\*\* Opportunity to take ownership of entire product verticals as TBB-VaaniAI scales across enterprise sectors. - \*\*Competitive Compensation:\*\* Attractive CTC aligned with experience and performance. --- ### How to Apply Interested candidates can share their updated CV along with any sample PRD, case study, or project portfolio at: nand@brainbucks.in / nand@vaaniai.io \*Subject Line: Application – Business Analyst – TBB-VaaniAI – [Your Name]\* Pay: ₹419,000.00 - ₹1,540,000.00 per year Benefits: * Flexible schedule * Leave encashment * Life insurance * Paid sick time * Paid time off * Provident Fund Work Location: In person

title: Business Analytics Leader
description: Bangalore Full-Time Senior **About this role** ------------------- Mission Brief: Be the Analytical Brain Beside Every Decision-Maker at Lenskart This is a high-impact leadership role for someone who will sit shoulder-to-shoulder with Lenskart's functional leaders — the CEO, Business Heads, Supply Chain Head, Technology Head, and the leaders running our individual geographies — and turn data into the decisions that move the business forward. You will not run a back-office reporting function. You will be a thinking partner in the room where strategy happens, translating the firehose of Lenskart's data into sharp, timely insight that changes what we do next. Your mandate is to make Lenskart's decision-making faster, sharper, and more AI-native than any retailer in the world. The Context: Where Lenskart Already Is You are not being asked to start from zero — you are being asked to take a fast-moving machine and accelerate it. Today at Lenskart, our meetings are transcribed and processed by our AI agents, our global technology and revenue roadmaps are part of the training context for our internal AI agents, and those agents already analyze weekly revenue trends on their own. Every Monday they surface what should be on the agenda for our weekly business reviews — what we're building, what's working, and what we're missing. Anonymized signals from Slack, email, and other communications flow into our analytics engine, which crisply summarizes the next steps for the organization. That is the baseline. We are looking for someone who can natively operate in this environment and push it considerably further. Core Mandate 1. Insight Partnership to Functional Leaders (The Decision Focus) Embed alongside the CEO, business heads, supply chain, technology, and geography leaders as their trusted analytics partner. Frame the right questions, pressure-test assumptions with data, and deliver the insight that drives concrete business decisions — pricing, assortment, expansion, capital allocation, and growth bets. Own the quality and speed of the insight that reaches the leadership table. 2. AI-First Transformation of Analytics & Decision-Making (The AI Focus) Be the fastest adopter — and the chief evangelist — of emerging AI tools, models, and analytics technologies across Lenskart. Reimagine how analysis itself is produced and consumed, moving the organization from dashboards-on-request toward autonomous, agent-driven insight. Set the standard for how decisions are made in an AI-native company and bring every function along with you. 3. Advancing Lenskart's AI & Analytics Systems (The Builder Focus) Take ownership of evolving our existing AI infrastructure — the meeting-intelligence pipelines, the roadmap-trained agents, the weekly revenue-trend analysis, and the communications summarization engine. Partner with Data Science and Engineering to extend these systems' reach, reliability, and sophistication, ensuring they remain a genuine competitive advantage rather than a novelty. 4. Cross-Functional Leadership & Adoption (The Culture Focus) Drive a data-and-AI-first decision-making culture across every function and geography. Challenge the status quo, raise the analytical bar of the leaders you support, and mentor a high-performing team of analysts who can operate at the pace of a high-growth global retailer. The Essentials Track Record: A strong record of partnering directly with senior executives and influencing material business decisions through analytics, data science, or strategy/decision-support work. AI Fluency: Demonstrated, hands-on adoption of modern AI and analytics tooling (LLMs, agentic workflows, ML-driven forecasting and decision systems) — not as a spectator, but as an early and aggressive practitioner who has put these tools into real operational use. Technical Acumen: Deep, practical command of analytics and data — SQL and modern data stacks, statistical and ML modeling, and the ability to translate ambiguous business questions into rigorous, scalable analysis. Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in a highly quantitative field — Engineering, Statistics, Operations Research, Economics, Computer Science, or similar. The Mindset AI-Native by Default: You reach for AI to solve problems instinctively, you stay at the frontier of new tools, and you are energized by the idea of building a company where agents do the first draft of analysis and humans make sharper decisions because of it. Executive Presence & Influence: You are a compelling communicator who can sit across from any functional leader, distill complexity into a clear recommendation, and earn the right to shape the decision. Analytical Rigor & Speed: You thrive on data complexity and turn ambiguity into clear, profitable action at the pace of a high-growth tech company. Builder's Bias: You see analytics as a living product and an evolving system — never finished, always being made faster and smarter. **Details** ----------- Job Type Full-Time Experience Senior Category Operations Deadline At Lenskart, we’re on a mission to revolutionize how India sees. From cutting-edge eyewear design to seamless omnichannel experiences, we combine technology, fashion, and customer obsession to deliver clarity to millions. Join us and be part of one of India’s fastest-growing consumer brands redefining vision care. Posted on 6/3/2026

title: Business Architect
description: **Project Role :** Business Architect **Project Role Description :** Identify opportunities to deliver tangible business value by assessing the current state, capturing high-level requirements, and defining business solutions. Translate business needs into technology-enabled solutions and operating models. Support transformation by developing business cases and guiding implementation of key initiatives. **Must have skills :** SAP Gen AI Hub **Good to have skills :** NA Minimum **7.5** year(s) of experience is required **Educational Qualification :** 15 years full time education Summary: Seeking an experienced SAP BTP GenAI Hub Developer with strong expertise in SAP BTP, SAP AI Core, Generative AI Hub, Large Language Models (LLMs), and AI-driven application development. The role focuses on building an AI-enabled BTP layer for APO-to-IBP migration solutions, leveraging SAP BTP services, AI capabilities, automation frameworks, and modern cloud technologies to deliver scalable, intelligent, and business-focused solutions. Roles & Responsibilities: Serve as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) for SAP BTP and Generative AI solutions. Design and deliver AI-driven solutions using Generative AI and Agentic AI technologies. Architect and implement AI applications using SAP AI Core, Generative AI Hub, and SAP HANA Cloud. Design and develop RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) and GraphRAG solutions. Integrate LLMs and Foundation Models with SAP and non-SAP enterprise systems. Develop LangChain/LangGraph-based orchestration pipelines. Build AI-enabled automation solutions for APO-to-IBP migration programs. Develop custom applications using SAP BTP, CAP, Node.js, and Python. Implement browser automation using Playwright and process automation using SAP Build Process Automation. Collaborate with business, functional, and technical teams to deliver AI-powered business solutions. Ensure solution scalability, security, compliance, and performance. Mentor team members and promote AI innovation and best practices. Professional & Technical Skills: Strong expertise in SAP BTP services, especially SAP AI Core, Generative AI Hub, and SAP HANA Cloud. Experience with Large Language Models (LLMs), Foundation Models, and Agentic AI. Hands-on experience with LangChain, LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, or similar AI frameworks. Experience designing Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) solutions. Knowledge of Knowledge Graphs, GraphRAG, semantic search, and vector search technologies. Strong understanding of prompt engineering, AI evaluation frameworks, and AI governance. Experience with SAP application architecture, cloud-native development, and enterprise integrations. Strong understanding of REST APIs, OData services, and SAP integration technologies. Ability to align AI capabilities with business objectives and drive measurable outcomes. Primary Skills: Strong hands-on SAP BTP development experience. Cloud Foundry application development, deployment, and troubleshooting. AI agent / LLM-based application development. Browser/UI automation using Playwright. Working knowledge of CAP / Node.js / Python. REST/OData APIs and SAP/non-SAP system integration. BTP Destinations, Connectivity Service, and Cloud Connector. Authentication and service integration using OAuth, XSUAA/IAS, and service bindings. Working knowledge of SAP AI Core / Generative AI Hub and AI service integration. Secondary Skills: SAP Build Process Automation. SAP Build Work Zone. SAP Integration Suite / API Management. Git and basic CI/CD. SAP HANA Cloud. SAP Signavio or other BPM tools. Prerequisite for RDE: Translate business processes into AI-driven workflows using Agentic AI and SAP AI services. Design and develop scalable, intelligent, and automation-ready applications. Own end-to-end solution lifecycle including architecture, development, testing, deployment, and support. Experience transforming SAP business processes through AI and automation. Strong stakeholder management, client communication, and solution demonstration skills. Ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams and drive AI adoption initiatives. Industry & Functional Experience: Experience in Supply Chain, Finance (FI), or industry-specific SAP business processes. Understanding of SAP Business AI capabilities and use cases. Experience with business process transformation and AI-driven innovation. Knowledge of BPM/process mining tools such as SAP Signavio is an advantage. SAP Certifications preferred, especially in SAP BTP, SAP Business AI, or SAP Generative AI. Additional Information: Minimum 7+ years of experience in SAP BTP and enterprise application development. Experience with SAP AI Core, Generative AI Hub, and SAP HANA Cloud preferred. Experience in SAP APO, SAP IBP, or Supply Chain transformation projects is highly desirable. Strong problem-solving, communication, and leadership skills required. Experience delivering enterprise-scale AI and automation solutions is preferred. 15 years full time education

description: In most instances, this position requires in-person interviews as part of the hiring process. Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: **Bengaluru, Karnataka, India; Hyderabad, Telangana, India; Gurgaon, Haryana, India; Pune, Maharashtra, India**. ### **Minimum qualifications:** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. * 6 years of experience in software engineering, enterprise cloud architecture, or technical consulting * 3 years of experience in advanced AI/ML architecture, deploying generative AI applications, intelligent agents, or LLM-powered solutions globally. * Experience in Python including implementation and deployment of tiered microservices applications. * Experience deploying production-grade cloud infrastructure or architecting and building cloud-based data solutions (e.g., enterprise data warehouses, data lakes, data pipelines, and associated technologies). ### **Preferred qualifications:** * Master’s degree or PhD in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, or a related field. * Experience pioneering multimodal AI solutions (text, image, video, and voice) to solve novel, previously unsolved enterprise workflow challenges. * Experience with AI security, Large Language Model (LLM) governance, enterprise guardrails, and global compliance requirements (e.g., data privacy regulations, data sovereignty). * Ability to architect highly resilient, globally distributed Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems and securely connecting LLMs with disparate legacy enterprise databases. * Recognized industry thought leadership (e.g., patents, published research, keynotes) in Generative AI, agentic workflows, or large-scale cloud data infrastructure. **About the job** ----------------- The Google Cloud Platform team helps customers transform and build what's next for their business — all with technology built in the cloud. Our products are developed for security, reliability and scalability, running the full stack from infrastructure to applications to devices and hardware. Our teams are dedicated to helping our customers — developers, small and large businesses, educational institutions and government agencies — see the benefits of our technology come to life. As part of an entrepreneurial team in this rapidly growing business, you will play a key role in understanding the needs of our customers and help shape the future of businesses of all sizes use technology to connect with customers, employees and partners. As a Cloud AI Engineer, you will play a key leadership role in ensuring that strategic customers have the best experience adopting Gemini Enterprise alongside the broader Google Cloud Agentic AI suite of products. You will design and implement robust, production-ready application architectures to support customer use cases, leveraging Gemini Enterprise and core Google AI products. You will work with customers to identify opportunities to transform their workflows with autonomous agents, actively removing technical barriers to ensure successful deployment and high adoption rates of Gemini Enterprise. You will have access to Google’s technology to monitor application performance, debug and troubleshoot complex agent behaviors, and address customer and partner needs. In this role, you will lead the end-to-end and timely execution of adopting Google Cloud Platform solutions to the customer. Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems. **Responsibilities** -------------------- * Lead and oversee the global delivery and implementation of Gemini Enterprise solutions, utilizing Agent Development Kits (ADKs) to solve highly complex, enterprise-scale technical challenges. * Serve as the trusted technical advisor to C-suite executives at Google’s most strategic global accounts, shaping their overarching AI strategy and accelerating the adoption of Gemini Enterprise. * Influence the core product roadmap by translating complex architectural challenges into actionable requirements for Google's engineering teams. * Deliver leading practice recommendations and high-stakes technical presentations to executive boards and key business stakeholders to secure massive-scale technical wins. * Act as a thought leader and mentor across the Google Cloud organization, elevating the technical acumen of engineers and shaping best practices for agentic AI architectures. Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. title: Cloud and DevSecOps Engineer
description: **The Role: Cloud & DevSecOps Engineer** Day to day, that means designing and running our infrastructure across Google Cloud Platform and AWS, owning our GitLab CI/CD pipelines, and implementing the security controls that protect PHI and financial data. This role has a deliberate growth path. You will start as the hands-on engineer who builds and secures the platform. Over your first year, you will work alongside the team lead and an external compliance specialist. During that time you will take on increasing ownership of our HIPAA program and SOC 2 Type II attestation, moving from implementing controls to designing and leading them. The goal is that you become our security and compliance lead. We will fund necessary training to get you there. If you want your infrastructure and security decisions to actually matter, and you want a path from senior engineer to program owner, this is that role. **What You'll Do** ***Cloud Architecture: GCP and AWS*** * Design, deploy, and operate our SaaS infrastructure across GCP and AWS using HIPAA-aligned reference architectures. * Make sure every workload touching PHI runs only on HIPAA-eligible services. Business Associate Agreements must be signed for each cloud account and project before any PHI lands. * Implement network segmentation and VPC design, encryption at rest and in transit, KMS key management, and least-privilege IAM across both clouds. * Build everything as infrastructure-as-code with Terraform. Environments should be reproducible, reviewable, and auditable. ***DevOps and GitLab CI/CD*** * Own and improve our GitLab CI/CD pipelines end to end: build, test, scan, deploy. * Integrate security scanning into the pipeline (SAST, dependency and SCA scanning, container and IaC scanning) without turning delivery into a crawl. * Manage secrets, artifacts, and release processes securely. Keep PHI out of logs, caches, and lower environments. * Support the development team. Good pipelines make other engineers faster, not slower. ***Security Engineering*** * Implement and maintain technical safeguards: phishing-resistant MFA, centralized audit logging, monitoring and alerting, vulnerability management, and incident response. * Enforce bastion or VDI-only production access with no local download of PHI, backed by DLP and egress controls. * Keep production access minimal and regularly reviewed. Use de-identified or synthetic data in development and test environments. * Respond to security events and lead post-incident reviews. ***Compliance: HIPAA, SOC 2 Type II, Plaid*** *Starting out, you implement and evidence. Over time, you design and lead.* * Implement the technical controls behind our HIPAA Security Rule safeguards and SOC 2 Trust Services Criteria, then take ownership of the program as you grow into the role. * Operate our compliance automation platform (Vanta, Drata, or Secureframe): keep evidence collection running, monitor for control drift, close gaps. * Own the security side of our Plaid integration. That means TLS 1.2+ and mTLS where required, encrypted secrets, least-privilege access to financial data, and monitoring for unauthorized access. You will also support Plaid's production access review and security questionnaire. Handling consumer financial data carries GLBA and FTC Safeguards Rule obligations, and you will help us meet them. * Support penetration tests and audits: help scope them, coordinate with the testers and auditor, and drive remediation. * Over time, you will lead the HIPAA risk analysis, own control design, select and manage the external auditor, and carry us through the SOC 2 Type II observation period. **What You Need** * 3+ years in cloud engineering, DevOps, or DevSecOps. * Hands-on production experience on both GCP and AWS. Not one cloud plus a certification in the other: real production work in both. * Strong GitLab CI/CD experience, or equivalent CI/CD depth and the ability to move to GitLab quickly. * Terraform and containerization (Docker, Kubernetes). * Practical security engineering: IAM and least privilege, encryption, secrets management, network security, logging and monitoring. * Working exposure to HIPAA or SOC 2 in practice. You should be able to explain what a control is and how you'd evidence it. * The judgment to handle PHI responsibly and work inside strict access controls. * Clear written and spoken English. description: **Location:** Remote – India **Job Type:** Full-Time #### **Role Overview** We are looking for a Cloud Security Engineer to join our global infrastructure team. involvement in cloud provisioning and DevOps support to ensure security is embedded across the deployment lifecycle. #### **Key Responsibilities** **Cloud-Level Security (Primary)** * Design, manage, and secure VPC/VNet architecture — subnets (public/private), route tables, NAT gateways, peering, and network segmentation. * Configure and audit security groups, NACLs, and firewall rules to enforce misconfigurations, and anomalous activity using CloudWatch, Azure Monitor, and SIEM/security dashboards. * Secure cloud-based databases (Snowflake, PostgreSQL, MySQL) — encryption at rest/in transit, and governance policies. * Conduct root cause analysis for security incidents and maintain incident response runbooks. * Manage backup, recovery, and disaster-resilience posture for critical workloads. * Maintain security documentation, network diagrams, and operational playbooks. **Application-Level Security (Primary)** * Review application architecture for security gaps (authentication, authorization, data exposure). * Support secure API design — token management, rate limiting, input validation at the gateway/WAF level. * Configure and manage WAF rules to protect against common exploits (OWASP Top 10). * Support vulnerability scanning and patch management for application-layer components. * Collaborate with dev teams on secure coding practices and dependency/vulnerability checks in CI/CD pipelines. **Cloud Services & DevOps (Secondary)** * Support provisioning of compute, storage, and networking resources in AWS and Azure with security-first configurations. * Automate secure deployments and configuration using Terraform or CloudFormation, including VPC/subnet as code. * Support CI/CD workflows with DevOps teams, embedding security checks (SAST/DAST, secrets scanning) into the pipeline. * Support scaling and capacity planning for production and staging environments. #### **Preferred Qualifications** * 3+ years of hands-on experience in cloud security or cloud administration/engineering with a security focus. * Strong working knowledge of AWS and/or Azure security services (IAM, VPC/VNet, security groups/NACLs, WAF, monitoring, logging). * Experience designing or managing network architecture (subnets, routing, peering, segmentation). * Experience securing databases in cloud environments (Snowflake, PostgreSQL, MySQL). * Proficiency in Terraform/CloudFormation with attention to secure IaC practices. * Familiarity with application security concepts (OWASP Top 10, WAF, API security). * Familiarity with cloud monitoring and threat detection tools. * Scripting skills in Python, Bash, or PowerShell for security automation. #### **Soft Skills** * Strong troubleshooting and incident-response mindset. * Effective communicator in remote and cross-functional teams. * Detail-oriented with a proactive, risk-aware approach. * Ability to prioritize under pressure in a fast-changing environment.

title: Conversation AI Engineer
description: We are looking for a Conversation AI Specialist who builds agentic, process-aligned dialogue systems — not scripted chatbots. You will build the conversational intelligence layer of our advisor efficiency platform. It includes timely orchestration, intent reasoning, and LLM-powered assist systems that help advisors during complex customer interactions across chat, phone, and ecommerce. You will own the full conversation stack, from utterance to action. Key Responsibilities **Agentic Conversation Design:** Architect and build the conversational layer of our prompt-based agentic platform — including intent detection, dialogue orchestration, and multi-step reasoning flows aligned to advisor workflows. **LLM Integration & Prompt Engineering:** Design and maintain the prompt architecture that drives advisor-assist features — including context injection, tool-calling patterns, guardrails, and output validation. **Advisor Assist Systems:** Build real-time AI tools that surface relevant knowledge, suggest responses, and guide advisors through commerce, subscription, and support interactions. **Process Mapping:** Work with operations and product teams to deeply understand advisor business processes, then translate that understanding into conversation system design. **Evaluation & Quality:** Define conversation quality metrics, build evaluation datasets from real interaction logs, and operate a continuous improvement loop for deployed systems. **Probabilistic Fallback Design:** Design graceful degradation patterns — ensuring the system handles low-confidence states, ambiguous intents, and out-of-scope inputs without advisor disruption. **Cross-platform Delivery:** Integrate conversational AI features throughout chat, phone, and ecommerce advisor surfaces — maintaining coherent behavior across channels. Attitude & Approach We're Hiring For Beyond technical skills, we are specifically hiring for three attitude shifts that define success in this role: **Process-aligned composition:** you build conversation flows that mirror advisor operational workflows — not abstract dialogue trees disconnected from how work actually happens. **Probabilistic reasoning:** you architect systems where intent is inferred, confidence is tracked, and ambiguity is handled gracefully rather than failing hard. **Data-driven iteration:** you measure conversation quality with data, not intuition — defining metrics, curating evaluation sets, and iterating based on evidence. Required Qualifications 3–5 years in conversational AI, NLP engineering, or LLM-based product development. Experience building dialogue systems with real business process alignment, not just scripted flows. Proficiency in Python and NLP tooling Strong understanding of intent classification, entity extraction, and context management in stateful conversations. Experience deploying conversational AI to production with real user traffic. Ability to build for uncertainty — confidence scoring, fallback handling, human-in-the-loop blocking issue. Preferred Qualifications Experience building agentic systems with tool use, function calling, or multi-step LLM orchestration. Familiarity with RAG for knowledge-grounded responses.
