description: # Job Description: AI Engineer ## Job Overview - \*\*Job Title:\*\* AI Engineer - \*\*Department:\*\* Engineering / Artificial Intelligence - \*\*Experience:\*\* 5–6 Years - \*\*Employment Type:\*\*C2H - \*\*Work Mode:\*\* Remote - \*\*Open Positions:\*\* 2 - \*\*Joining:\*\* Immediate Joiners / Candidates with Short Notice Period Preferred - \*\*Job Location:\*\* Remote – India ## About the Role We are looking for a skilled and hands-on AI Engineer to design, develop, integrate, and deploy AI-powered applications and intelligent systems. The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in Python programming, Machine Learning, Large Language Models (LLMs), Generative AI, and modern AI application development frameworks. The candidate will be responsible for building scalable AI solutions, developing intelligent conversational systems, implementing Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines, integrating third-party AI models and APIs, and optimizing AI applications for performance, accuracy, reliability, and cost. The ideal candidate should have practical experience taking AI solutions from proof of concept to production, along with a strong understanding of backend development, data processing, model evaluation, and deployment practices. ## Key Responsibilities \*\*AI Application Development\*\* - Design, develop, and deploy AI-powered applications to solve real-world business problems. - Build intelligent systems using Machine Learning, Deep Learning, Generative AI, and Large Language Models. - Translate business requirements into technical AI solutions and production-ready applications. - Develop reusable, modular, scalable, and maintainable AI components. - Evaluate emerging AI technologies and recommend appropriate solutions based on business requirements. \*\*Generative AI and LLM Engineering\*\* - Develop and integrate applications using LLMs from providers such as OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, or open-source model ecosystems. - Implement prompt engineering techniques, structured outputs, function calling, and tool use. - Build conversational AI systems capable of understanding user intent, maintaining context, and generating relevant responses. - Implement multi-step AI workflows and agentic applications where appropriate. - Optimize model selection, response quality, latency, token consumption, and inference costs. - Apply techniques such as prompt templates, output validation, context management, and fallback mechanisms. \*\*Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)\*\* - Design and implement end-to-end RAG pipelines for document-based and enterprise knowledge applications. - Develop document ingestion, parsing, chunking, embedding generation, indexing, and retrieval workflows. - Integrate vector databases and search technologies to retrieve relevant information. - Implement semantic search, metadata filtering, hybrid search, and reranking where appropriate. - Improve answer relevance, contextual accuracy, and grounding in retrieved information. - Implement source attribution and citation mechanisms to reduce unsupported AI-generated responses. - Evaluate and optimize retrieval quality and end-to-end RAG performance. \*\*Machine Learning and Model Development\*\* - Develop, train, evaluate, and optimize Machine Learning models based on business needs. - Apply supervised and unsupervised learning techniques to suitable use cases. - Perform data preprocessing, feature engineering, model selection, and hyperparameter tuning. - Work with relevant Deep Learning frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow. - Evaluate models using appropriate metrics and validate their performance against business objectives. - Determine when to use existing foundation models, fine-tuning, traditional ML, or custom model development. \*\*AI Agents and Workflow Automation\*\* - Develop AI agents that can use tools, APIs, and external systems to complete defined tasks. - Build multi-step workflows with appropriate state management, validation, and error handling. - Integrate agent frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, or equivalent technologies when suitable. - Implement human-in-the-loop approval mechanisms for sensitive or consequential operations. - Prevent uncontrolled tool execution and handle failed tool calls, invalid outputs, and unexpected user inputs. - Evaluate agent reliability and ensure workflows remain predictable and observable. \*\*Backend Development and API Integration\*\* - Develop AI service backends using Python frameworks such as FastAPI, Flask, or Django. - Build REST APIs and integrate AI capabilities with frontend applications and existing business systems. - Implement authentication, authorization, input validation, error handling, and logging. - Integrate external APIs, databases, cloud services, and enterprise applications. - Work with SQL and NoSQL databases to manage application and AI-related data. - Ensure APIs are scalable, secure, reliable, and production-ready. \*\*Vector Databases and Data Engineering\*\* - Work with vector databases such as Pinecone, Qdrant, Weaviate, Chroma, or FAISS. - Develop data ingestion and transformation pipelines for structured and unstructured data. - Generate and manage embeddings for semantic retrieval and similarity search. - Work with PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, or equivalent databases as required. - Optimize retrieval speed, indexing strategies, metadata management, and data quality. - Implement data validation and synchronization mechanisms for AI applications. \*\*Model Evaluation, Testing, and Optimization\*\* - Design evaluation frameworks to measure AI response quality, factual accuracy, relevance, and consistency. - Create test datasets and test cases for LLM-powered applications. - Perform regression testing when prompts, models, datasets, or retrieval configurations change. - Evaluate hallucinations, retrieval failures, prompt injection risks, and inappropriate outputs. - Monitor production performance, latency, errors, and AI service availability. - Use automated evaluation and observability tools where appropriate. - Continuously improve AI system quality through experimentation and feedback. \*\*Deployment, Cloud, and MLOps\*\* - Deploy AI applications to production environments using Docker and cloud infrastructure. - Work with AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud, or equivalent platforms. - Implement CI/CD pipelines and automated testing for reliable releases. - Use Git and standard software engineering practices for version control and collaboration. - Monitor application health, model performance, resource utilization, and inference costs. - Optimize deployments for scalability, availability, and operational efficiency. - Support model versioning, configuration management, and reproducible deployments. \*\*Security and Responsible AI\*\* - Implement appropriate safeguards for sensitive information and confidential business data. - Apply secure API key management, access controls, and data protection practices. - Understand prompt injection, data leakage, unsafe tool execution, and other LLM application risks. - Implement input/output validation, rate limiting, and appropriate content safeguards. - Follow responsible AI practices and applicable privacy and security requirements. - Ensure AI outputs are appropriately validated before being used in critical workflows. \*\*Collaboration and Documentation\*\* - Collaborate with product managers, software engineers, data scientists, and other stakeholders. - Participate in technical discussions, architecture reviews, code reviews, and sprint planning. - Document AI architecture, APIs, workflows, model configurations, and deployment procedures. - Explain technical trade-offs, implementation decisions, and model limitations clearly. - Take ownership of assigned features from design and development through testing and production deployment. ## Required Technical Skills - Strong proficiency in Python. - Good understanding of object-oriented programming, data structures, algorithms, and software design principles. - Hands-on experience developing backend services using FastAPI, Flask, or Django. - Experience building and consuming REST APIs. - Practical experience building applications using Large Language Models. - Strong understanding of prompt engineering, context windows, tokenization, and structured outputs. - Experience integrating commercial or open-source LLMs. - Knowledge of embeddings, semantic similarity, and vector search. - Hands-on experience implementing RAG-based applications. - Experience with LangChain and/or LangGraph, Hugging Face Transformers, PyTorch and/or TensorFlow, Scikit-learn, LlamaIndex or equivalent RAG frameworks, NumPy, and Pandas. - Experience with SQL databases such as PostgreSQL or MySQL. - Familiarity with vector databases such as Pinecone, Qdrant, Weaviate, Chroma, or FAISS. - Hands-on experience deploying applications to a cloud environment. - Working knowledge of Docker, Git, CI/CD, logging, and monitoring. ## Preferred Skills - Experience building production-grade AI assistants, chatbots, or enterprise AI applications. - Experience implementing agentic workflows and tool-calling systems. - Familiarity with model fine-tuning, LoRA/PEFT, or other parameter-efficient training techniques. - Experience with reranking, hybrid search, and advanced RAG optimization. - Knowledge of model serving and inference optimization. - Experience with asynchronous Python, background jobs, caching, and rate limiting. - Familiarity with LLM evaluation frameworks such as Ragas, DeepEval, or equivalent tools. - Understanding of AI security, guardrails, observability, and responsible AI practices. - Experience with Redis, message queues, or event-driven architectures. - Experience working in Agile development environments. ## Minimum Qualifications - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. - 3–6 years of relevant software engineering, AI engineering, or Machine Learning experience. - Demonstrable hands-on experience developing AI/ML applications. - Strong Python development skills and sound software engineering fundamentals. - Experience integrating AI models into usable applications or backend services. - Ability to independently troubleshoot technical issues and deliver working solutions. ## What We Are Looking For - A hands-on engineer who can write production-quality code rather than only experiment with AI tools. - Strong understanding of the practical application of LLMs and Machine Learning. - Ability to independently design, implement, test, and deploy AI features. - Understanding of the trade-offs between model accuracy, cost, latency, and scalability. - Comfort working in a fast-paced environment with evolving technical requirements. - Ownership, curiosity, analytical thinking, and a willingness to learn new technologies. ## Interview Evaluation Areas 1. Python programming and problem-solving. 2. AI/ML fundamentals and practical implementation. 3. LLM integration, prompt engineering, and structured outputs. 4. RAG architecture, embeddings, and vector search. 5. Backend API development and database integration. 6. AI application testing, evaluation, and production deployment. 7. System design, debugging, and real-world project experience. ## Compensation and Benefits - \*\*Work Mode:\*\* Remore - \*\*Employment:\*\* C2H - \*\*Openings:\*\* 2. - \*\*Joining Preference:\*\* Immediate joiners or candidates with a short notice period. Pay: ₹1,000,000.00 - ₹2,000,000.00 per year Experience: * AI/ML: 3 years (Required) Work Location: Remote

The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience in cloud infrastructure, automation, monitoring, deployment pipelines, and production support. **Key Responsibilities** * Design, implement, and manage Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) environments for microservices. * Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins, GitLab CI, and related tools. * Implement GitOps practices using Helm, ArgoCD, and Terraform. * Manage containerized applications using Docker and Kubernetes. * Configure and support Istio Service Mesh for security, traffic management, and observability. * Automate infrastructure and operational tasks using Python, Bash, and Shell Scripting. * Monitor platform health using Prometheus, Grafana, Dynatrace, OpenTelemetry, and Kiali. * Support production environments, troubleshoot deployment issues, and ensure platform reliability. * Collaborate with Development, QA, Infrastructure, and Vendor teams for application deployments and enhancements. * Drive performance tuning, scalability improvements, and infrastructure optimization. **Mandatory Skills** * 8+ years of DevOps experience. * Strong expertise in Azure Cloud and AKS. * Hands-on experience with Kubernetes, Docker, and Istio. * Experience with ArgoCD, Helm, Terraform (GitOps). * Strong knowledge of Jenkins, GitLab CI, and CI/CD pipelines. * Strong Linux Administration skills. * Scripting experience in Python, Bash, and Shell. * Experience with Prometheus, Grafana, Dynatrace, and OpenTelemetry. * Experience supporting enterprise-scale microservices architecture. **Good to Have** * Java development knowledge. * Experience with Kafka, Redis, MySQL, Apigee, Akamai, and Palo Alto Firewall. * FinOps and cloud cost optimization. * Performance testing and tuning. * Team leadership experience. title: Senior DevOps Engineer

provisioning**. * Experience with Jenkins and CI/CD pipeline development. * Knowledge of Kubernetes and VMware virtualization technologies. * Experience with Git and version control systems. * Strong expertise in Ansible automation and PowerShell scripting. * Proficiency in Python scripting and Infrastructure as Code (IaC). * Understanding of security scanning, secrets management, and compliance controls. * Experience working with Windows and Linux operating systems. * Knowledge of infrastructure provisioning, configuration management, testing, monitoring, and troubleshooting. * Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills. **Preferred Experience** * Experience with ServiceNow-based intake, approval, orchestration, and change-management workflows. * infrastructure testing, rollback strategies, and production handover. title: Senior Engineer- Dot Net
description: Location: Chennai, India Business: Energy Systems Position type: Full Time Contract type: Permanent Employee Job ID: 7614 **Overview** ------------ ### **About us** We are the independent expert in assurance and risk management. Driven by our purpose, to safeguard life, property, and the environment, we empower our customers and their stakeholders with facts and reliable insights so that critical decisions can be made with confidence. As a trusted voice for many of the world’s most successful organizations, we use our knowledge to advance safety and performance, set industry benchmarks, and inspire and invent solutions to tackle global transformations. **About Energy Systems** We help customers navigate the complex transition to a decarbonized and more sustainable energy future. We do this by assuring that energy systems work safely and effectively, using solutions that are increasingly digital. We also help industries and governments to navigate the many complex, interrelated transitions taking place globally and regionally, in the energy industry. ### **About the role** The Senior Software Engineer is responsible for designing, developing, testing, deploying, and supporting production-grade software products and shared platform capabilities within DNV’s Digital & Transformation organization. This role sits within the Application Engineering section and contributes to the development and modernization of scalable web applications that support digital delivery across Energy Systems. This role helps to advance how DNV performs Due Diligence, Verification & Assurance, and Renewables Certification work across Energy Systems. This is not a project-based delivery or staff-augmentation role. Engineers are expected to develop deep product knowledge and remain accountable for the quality, maintainability, and operation of the software they build. Working in close partnership with Frontend Engineers, Product leadership, Data & AI Engineering, Solution Engineering, Platform Reliability, Solution Architecture, and Platform Security & Compliance, this role helps bring application capabilities, data services, AI-enabled features, workflows, and APIs into one cohesive platform and product experience. The Senior Software Engineer designs, builds, tests, deploys, and supports scalable software across a modern Microsoft-oriented full-stack environment. The primary stack includes C# and .NET 10, Entity Framework Core, SignalR, MySQL, Redis, TypeScript, React, Redux, Tailwind CSS, Docker, .NET Aspire, Azure Functions, Azure Storage, Azure AI Search, and Azure DevOps. The role requires strong engineering fundamentals, practical cloud experience, and the ability to collaborate effectively across globally distributed teams. This role supports custom software development, application modernization, and integration with low-code or hybrid development environments, helping establish shared patterns, APIs, reusable components, and maintainable application architecture across the platform. \*\*This role is based at our DNV office in Chennai, India. Further details regarding role-specific requirements will be shared during the interview process.\*\* **Key Responsibilities** **Software Engineering & Delivery** * Design, develop, test, and maintain scalable application and platform capabilities using modern software engineering practices. * Build cohesive product experiences across backend services, APIs and platform integrations. * Work directly with Product and Architecture stakeholders to shape requirements, evaluate technical approaches, and translate product direction into maintainable, production-ready software. * Participate actively in code reviews, technical design discussions, estimation, delivery planning, and implementation decisions. * Write clean, well-structured, testable, and maintainable code that supports long-term product quality and team velocity. * Own product capabilities through design, implementation, deployment, monitoring, maintenance, and iterative improvement rather than treating delivery as complete when the initial feature is released. **.NET Application Development** * Develop modern API capabilities using C#, .NET 10, Entity Framework Core, SignalR, and related technologies. * Develop solutions for Azure and contribute to their deployment and support. * Support application modernization efforts, including refactoring, technical debt reduction, framework upgrades, and migration from legacy patterns where appropriate. * Develop application capabilities used for structured review workflows, real-time collaboration, issue tracking, customer interaction, reporting, and delivery of technical work products. * Partner with Product and design stakeholders to ensure application functionality is intuitive, reliable, and aligned with user workflows. * Develop APIs, backend services, frontend components, and integration patterns that support platform interoperability. * Help integrate applications with data services, AI-enabled capabilities, workflow configurations, authentication patterns, and enterprise systems. * Contribute to reusable development patterns, documentation, and engineering practices that improve team velocity and consistency. * Integrate data-driven, search, agentic, and AI-enabled capabilities into production web applications using well-defined APIs and reusable application patterns. **Modern Development & AI-Enabled Engineering** * Use AI-assisted development tools to accelerate coding, testing, debugging, documentation, refactoring, and engineering analysis. * Apply strong engineering judgment when using LLM-enabled workflows, ensuring generated or assisted code meets standards for quality, security, maintainability, and performance. * Use AI-enabled tools where appropriate to support test generation, code review preparation, technical documentation, and developer productivity. **DevOps, Reliability & Security** * Contribute to Azure DevOps repositories and pipelines, automated testing, deployment automation, environment management, monitoring, and incident readiness. * Build software using an Agile methodology, with strong attention to reliability, performance, availability, scalability, and operational support. * Support observability practices including logging, monitoring, error handling, and production diagnostics. * Follow secure development practices aligned with internal security standards, SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, and enterprise security expectations. * Collaborate with Platform Reliability, Security, and Global Shared Services teams to support secure, reliable, and maintainable production systems. **Collaboration & Technical Ownership** * Work effectively with Product, Solution Engineering, Data & AI Engineering, Platform Reliability, Architecture, Security, and regional teams in a globally distributed environment. * Take ownership of assigned features, services, defects, and technical improvements from design through production support. * Communicate technical trade-offs clearly and contribute to pragmatic engineering decisions. * Mentor less experienced engineers through code reviews, technical guidance, pairing, and shared engineering practices. * Contribute to a culture of accountability, collaboration, continuous improvement, and delivery excellence. * Contribute actively within planning and design meetings, speaking up where potential issues arise or where a requirement is poorly defined. * Champion potential solutions to problems and communicate them clearly to the team. ### **What we offer** * Flexible work arrangements for better work-life balance * Generous Paid Leaves (Annual, Sick, Compassionate, Local Public, Marriage, Maternity, Paternity, Medical leave) * Medical benefits ( Insurance and Annual Health Check-up) * Pension and Insurance Policies (Group Term Life Insurance, Group Personal Accident Insurance, Travel Insurance) * Training and Development Assistance (Training Sponsorship, On-The-Job Training, Training Programme) * Additional Benefits (Long Service Awards, Mobile Phone Reimbursement) * Company bonus/Profit share. \*Benefits may vary based on position, tenure/contract/grade level\* DNV is an Equal Opportunity Employer and gives consideration for employment to qualified applicants without regard to gender, religion, race, national or ethnic origin, cultural background, social group, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, age or political opinion. Diversity is fundamental to our culture and we invite you to be part of this diversity. ### **About you** * Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or related field, or equivalent experience. * 5+ years of experience developing production software in application engineering, software engineering, platform engineering, or related technical roles. * Strong production experience developing backend applications and services using C# and modern .NET. * Experience designing REST APIs and building distributed or service-oriented application capabilities. * Deep understanding of SQL and database optimisation. * Experience building, modernizing, or operating scalable web applications in production environments, especially applications that support complex workflows, collaboration, reporting, document review, or customer-facing delivery. * Experience building APIs, backend services, frontend components, integrations, and application capabilities in production environments. * Experience developing, deploying, and supporting cloud-hosted applications, with practical experience in Microsoft Azure strongly preferred. * Strong understanding of software design, testing, code quality, maintainability, security, and performance. * Experience with CI/CD, automated testing, source control, code review, and modern software delivery practices. * Demonstrated experience using AI-assisted development tools or LLM-enabled coding workflows to improve development productivity. * Ability to collaborate with Product, Architecture, Security, Platform Reliability, and cross-functional stakeholders in a matrixed environment. * Strong English communication skills and ability to work effectively across globally distributed teams. **What is Preferred** * Experience in Search, RAG or AI integration technologies. * Experience of real-time collaboration or data syncing with technologies such as SignalR or WebSockets. * Experience in frontend systems such as React or Blazor. * Experience in product-led or platform-based organizations. * Familiarity with low-code or hybrid development environments. * Experience with collaborative due diligence, document review, workflow, reporting, Q&A, risk management, or transaction delivery applications. * Experience supporting interoperability across multiple systems or enterprise platforms. * Experience working in a broader multi-cloud enterprise environment, including familiarity with AWS. * Background in energy, infrastructure, renewables, assurance, certification, or other technically complex industries. * Experience with multi-cloud environments spanning Azure and AWS. Experience modernizing legacy applications or integrating acquired software products into a broader enterprise platform. Security and compliance with statutory requirements in the countries in which we operate is essential for DNV. Background checks will be conducted on all final candidates as part of the offer process, in accordance with applicable country-specific laws and practices. **Benefits** ------------ Please note that some benefits may vary depending on location, business area, and employment terms. Please confirm with your recruiter. ### **Profit Share** You’ll be part of our global profit share scheme that means we all share in our success as a business. If we profit, so do you. This will be part of our Total Compensation approach each year and depends on our year-end results. ### **Professional Development** We believe in the 70/20/10 learning model, where 70% of your learning comes from performing your everyday tasks and working on different projects, new areas and initiatives to gain new skills. 20% from working with others and mentoring and the rest from formal education. ### **Hybrid Work Model** We work in a hybrid model (three days from the office) and have flexible starting hours. This means you can fit your work and life together in a way that works for you. ### **Global Opportunities** We support you in exploring different career opportunities or shifting between teams, business areas, or geographies, so that you can shape your career according to what you find motivating. ### **Modern Office in Pune** Our office in Pune has a modern look and feel and you’ll find zones for both focused work and team integration. Sit/stand desks, high-quality adjustable chairs and balance balls are just a few examples of what ergonomic office means at DNV. ### **Integration Events** Depending on where you are located, you’ll have the opportunity to participate in offsite meetings as well as different initiatives and fun events at the office. We believe that a well-integrated team is a well-functioning team. **Diversity, Equity and Inclusion** ----------------------------------- At DNV, our commitment to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion is not only an ethical choice, but also a business decision. Diversity, fairness, and a sense of belonging are a source of strength for our people, our business, and our customers, and help us to deliver on our purpose, vision, and values. about DEI **Working here** ---------------- Since 1864 we’ve been dedicated to safeguarding life, property and the environment. Today we remain at the forefront of new technologies and techniques to help our customers transform for a more sustainable future. At DNV you can expect to deliver career and industry defining work. You’ll be given the time to build your network, the resources to support your development, and the freedom to satisfy your curiosity and desire to learn. about Working here

title: Senior Integration Developer (India)
description: Alimentiv is a global CRO with a singular focus: advancing therapies for patients with gastrointestinal diseases. GI is our WHY and for more than 30 years that purpose has driven our scientific rigour, operational excellence, and deep therapeutic expertise, including supporting more than 70% of IBD compounds in development. We operate as a private, profit-with-purpose company, channeling our commercial success back into scientific research, technology, and our people. With approximately 700 people across multiple countries and three service lines, we are growing deliberately, and the capability of our leaders and our organization is central to how we get there. If you want to do meaningful work, build something real, and invest back in research that changes lives — we want to meet you! **Job Overview** We are seeking an experienced **Senior Integration Developer** to design, develop, and maintain secure, scalable, and reliable integration solutions connecting business applications, clinical systems, and enterprise data platforms. In this role, you will leverage **Azure Integration Services, APIs, messaging technologies, and event-driven architectures** to enable seamless data exchange across internal systems, cloud platforms, and external partners. You will play a key role in improving integration performance, automation, monitoring, and security while ensuring compliance with relevant data governance and regulatory requirements. Working closely with technical teams, application owners, vendors, and business stakeholders, you will contribute to integration architecture decisions, support production environments, and provide technical guidance to junior developers. **Key Responsibilities** * Design, develop, and maintain scalable integration solutions using Azure Logic Apps, Azure Functions, Azure Service Bus, Event Grid, and API Management. * Build and support REST/JSON and SOAP/XML integrations connecting enterprise applications, SaaS platforms, external vendors, and data environments. * Implement messaging and event-driven architectures, including queues, publish/subscribe patterns, message handling, and error recovery mechanisms. * Develop serverless applications and custom integration components using Python and/or C#, ensuring performance, reliability, and scalability. * Implement monitoring, logging, alerting, and troubleshooting solutions using Azure Monitor, Application Insights, and Log Analytics. * Automate integration deployments through Git-based CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure-as-code tools such as Terraform, ARM, or Bicep. * Develop reusable integration frameworks, automated testing processes, and standardised components to improve development efficiency and reliability. * Apply security best practices, including OAuth 2.0, Microsoft Entra ID, managed identities, and Azure Key Vault, while ensuring compliance with GxP, GDPR, and HIPAA requirements. * Collaborate with application owners, vendors, and business stakeholders to translate technical and operational requirements into effective integration solutions. * Participate in technical design reviews, mentor junior developers, contribute to architecture improvements, and identify opportunities to optimise integration processes. **Skills & Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related discipline; a Master's degree is preferred. * 5–8 years of experience designing, developing, and supporting enterprise integration solutions, including APIs, messaging systems, event-driven architectures, and serverless technologies. * Expert-level proficiency in **Azure Integration Services**, including Azure Service Bus, Logic Apps, Azure Functions, Event Grid, and API Management. * Strong programming skills in Python and/or C#, with working knowledge of SQL and experience developing API-based and serverless integration solutions. * Proven experience designing, developing, and consuming REST and SOAP APIs using JSON, XML, OpenAPI, and OAuth 2.0. * Strong experience with Azure Monitor, Application Insights, Log Analytics (KQL), and integration monitoring, troubleshooting, and performance optimisation. * Hands-on experience with Git, CI/CD automation using GitHub Actions, and infrastructure-as-code tools such as Terraform, ARM, or Bicep. * Familiarity with AWS integration services, including Lambda, SQS, SNS, EventBridge, and API Gateway; experience integrating with Databricks or Microsoft Fabric is advantageous. * Understanding of cloud security, data governance, and regulatory requirements, including GxP, GDPR, and HIPAA; experience in life sciences or healthcare is highly desirable. * Excellent communication, problem-solving, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work independently, collaborate across teams, mentor junior developers, and meet project deadlines. ### **What We Offer** In addition, as an Alimentiv Employee, you’re also eligible for the following programs: * Education Reimbursement program for full-time employees * Monthly Cell Phone and Remote Work Allowance (dependent on role eligibility) * One time office setup allowance (can be used to purchase a scanner/printer, extra monitor, office furniture, etc.) * Working while visiting program – up to 4 weeks per year! * Flexible Summer Hours Program from May – September * Employee referral incentive – we know great people know other great people, and we think that warrants recognition! * Full-time employees also become beneficiaries of the Alimentiv Trust after one year of employment, and permanent members after 5 years of employment * Optional formal mentorship program (Alimentorship); country/region annual social events in person; leadership development programs for people leaders in accordance with your seniority; social committee and several other optional initiatives designed to support you in feeling like part of the Alimentiv team! *Additional benefits may be available depending on the country of employment and are subject to local policies and eligibility.* ### **Our Services** * End-to-end GI clinical trial services, from protocol design through submission support * Central medical imaging management and endoscopic reading * Precision medicine and biomarker solutions * Real-world evidence and clinical consulting * Histopathology and lab services through AcelaBio ### **How to Apply** To apply for this position, please submit your resume through the Alimentiv Careers Portal or via LinkedIn’s Easy Apply. Resumes must be submitted in English. ### **Equal Opportunity and Accessibility** *Alimentiv is committed to building a diverse, inclusive and respectful workplace. We are an equal opportunity employer and consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, colour, ethnicity, national origin, religion or belief, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, marital or family status, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.* *Accommodations are available upon request for persons with disabilities throughout the recruitment and selection process. Requests can be directed to* *recruitment@alimentiv.com**.* **Stay Alert to Recruitment Scams** Alimentiv is aware of a continued increase in phishing scams, which use various methods of attack via email, text, voice and social media, including individuals posing as our recruiters and contacting candidates with fraudulent opportunities. description: At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us. About Eli Lilly At Lilly, we unite caring with discovery to make life better for people around the world. We are a global healthcare leader headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana. Our employees around the world work to discover and bring life-changing medicines to those who need them, and to improve the understanding and management of disease. We're looking for people who are determined to make life better for people around the world. About CI&A and the AI Engineering Team The Lilly Bengaluru Customer Insights & Analytics (CI&A) team was started in 2017 with the objective of using innovative data mining and analytics to support business decisions for Marketing functions in the US and ex-US affiliates. The team has grown to more than 100 staff members across data management, data science, analytical techniques, pharmaceutical commercial operations, and business insights, and provides analytics outcomes that drive decision-making across Lilly's Marketing, Sales, Medical Affairs, and other functions. A parallel data and analytics team operates out of Indianapolis (HQ). Within CI&A, the AI Engineering team designs, builds, and operates the platforms that take Lilly's commercial generative-AI and agentic-AI solutions from prototype to enterprise-scale production - including our agentic AI application platform and its transition to a modern, cloud-hosted architecture, and CI&A's participation in Lilly's broader enterprise agentic AI platform initiative. Role Overview We are looking for a Senior Machine Learning Engineer to join the AI Engineering team, with a primary focus on Hands-On Engineering (MLE) and MLOps & Platform Reliability. Core Responsibilities * Build and maintain production-grade ML/AI components and services with minimal supervision. * Apply software engineering best practices (version control, testing, code review, documentation) across your work. * Debug and resolve moderately complex issues spanning multiple components of the system. * Take ownership of small features or workstreams end-to-end, from design through deployment. * Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines (e.g. GitHub Actions) for ML/AI deployments; contribute to pipeline design for new projects. * Work with Docker, Kubernetes, and Prefect to deploy and orchestrate ML/AI workloads across environments. * Support models through deployment, monitoring, and retraining; escalate drift or degradation issues. Key Tools & Technologies * Cloud & Data Infra: AWS (EC2/ECS, S3, Lambda, IAM, CloudWatch or equivalent); Databricks & Unity Catalog * Foundational: R; Python; Git/GitHub; software engineering best practices; testing; SQL * MLOps & Deployment: Docker, Kubernetes, Prefect; CI/CD (GitHub Actions); production monitoring; model versioning & lineage; GitOps governance Required Qualifications * 4–8 years of hands-on experience building and operating ML/AI systems in production environments. * Strong proficiency in Python and/or R with a track record of writing clean, testable, production-quality code. * Demonstrated experience owning CI/CD, containerisation, and orchestration for production ML/AI systems. * Strong working knowledge of containerisation (Docker), orchestration (Kubernetes), and CI/CD pipelines. * Working knowledge of AWS cloud services and Databricks/Unity Catalog or equivalent enterprise data platforms. * Excellent verbal and written communication skills. * Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments. Education * Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Applications, or a related technical field. description: **Storytelling is, and will always be, the heart of what we do at Skydance.** Our vision is to build a thriving entertainment ecosystem where stories and worlds are imagined, brought to life and experienced. We create for every age and audience, anchored by the strength of our content and experiences and the depth of our connection with fans. LET’S GO! ㅤ **Senior Machine Learning Engineer (Growth & ML), Hyderabad** **About Warner Bros. Discovery** Warner Bros. Discovery, a premier global media and entertainment company, offers audiences the world's most differentiated and complete portfolio of content, brands and franchises across television, film, streaming and gaming. The new company combines Warner Media’s premium entertainment, sports and news assets with Discovery's leading non-fiction and international entertainment and sports businesses. For more information, please visit www.wbd.com. **Meet our Team** Warner Bros. Discovery (WBD) is home to the world’s most iconic entertainment, news, and sports brands — HBO Max, CNN, Discovery+, DC, Warner Bros., Bleacher Report, Food Network, and many more. Within the Data & Audience Platform (DAP) organization, our Machine Learning Engineering team in Hyderabad builds the foundational AI/ML intelligence that powers identity, audience, advertising, and personalization across every WBD brand. We turn first-party signals from hundreds of millions of viewers into production ML systems that expand addressable audiences, sharpen targeting and measurement, forecast demand, and personalize content discovery — directly driving advertising yield, marketing efficiency, engagement, and retention. At WBD, MLEs do rigorous data science *and* own the engineering that brings models to life: production ML data pipelines, model training and optimization, and the ML infrastructure — feature stores, training and serving pipelines, and MLOps — that makes our work reliable, repeatable, and scalable. We build primarily on **Databricks**, with strong working knowledge of **Snowflake** and **AWS**, and we are an early, enthusiastic adopter of agentic AI development workflows. **About the Role** As a Senior MLE, you will own the design and delivery of production ML systems that directly impact audience targeting, advertising revenue, subscriber engagement, and retention across WBD’s global portfolio. You will lead technical execution on key workstreams — including probabilistic identity resolution, lookalike modeling, single-title affinity, and forecasting — while mentoring MLE 2s and collaborating closely with Staff MLEs and product stakeholders. This is a high-ownership role for engineers with roughly 5–8 years of experience who can independently drive a project from problem framing through production deployment and monitoring. **Roles & Responsibilities:** **ML System Design & Ownership** * Lead end-to-end development of production ML systems: data sourcing, feature engineering, model training, evaluation, deployment, and monitoring. * Own key ML products such as probabilistic identity resolution (matching unauthenticated device IDs and 1P cookies to households/persons with calibrated confidence), single-title affinity (e.g., STAT two-tower retrieval), and audience/propensity models. * Design scalable feature pipelines on Databricks (PySpark, Delta, Workflows/DLT, Unity Catalog) and the WBD feature store, with documented feature contracts, backfill paths, and freshness SLAs. * Architect batch and near-real-time inference pipelines integrated with Snowflake and activation systems (Mosaic, FreeWheel, GAM). **Modeling & Experimentation** * Develop and optimize models across the ML spectrum: gradient boosting (XGBoost/LightGBM), embedding/two-tower retrieval, neural ranking, probability calibration (e.g., isotonic regression), and probabilistic/graph-based matching. * Design rigorous offline and online experiments; define evaluation frameworks (precision/recall, AUC-ROC, NDCG, decile lift, calibration curves) appropriate to each use case. * Apply causal-inference techniques (propensity scoring, uplift/incrementality modeling) to measure true lift of audience targeting on engagement and retention KPIs. * Contribute to lookalike modeling (LAL 2.0+) using 1,000+ first- and third-party features, including privacy-safe builds inside Data Clean Rooms (Snowflake DCR). **MLOps & Infrastructure** * Champion MLOps best practices: model versioning, champion/challenger promotion, automated retraining triggers, drift detection, and production monitoring with MLflow on Databricks. * Build and maintain robust, reproducible, auditable ML pipelines on Databricks (and AWS SageMaker where appropriate, e.g., the identity-resolution track); enforce leakage prevention and training/serving consistency. * Contribute to the team’s feature-store strategy — feature contracts, backfills, and freshness SLAs — and implement data-quality checks, model-health dashboards, and alerting thresholds. * Embed FinOps cost discipline (compute caps, auto-termination, job tagging) into pipeline design. **Mentorship & Cross-functional Collaboration** * Mentor MLE 2s through code reviews, design discussions, and pairing; contribute to team technical standards. * Partner with Product, Marketing, and Ad Sales to translate business requirements into ML problem formulations, and with Data Engineering on data contracts and pipeline SLAs. * Communicate model performance, trade-offs, and business impact clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders. **Flagship Projects You’ll Work On** * **Identity Intelligence** — foundational, privacy-safe identity across all WBD brands: probabilistic ID resolution that resolves unauthenticated signals to households/persons with calibrated confidence (entity resolution with gradient boosting and embeddings, representation learning, isotonic calibration, candidate blocking, champion/challenger pipelines), expanding addressable audiences beyond deterministic matching. * **Audience Intelligence** — advertising and marketing use cases: lookalike and predictive audiences (LAL across 1,000+ features), ML-driven smart audiences, layered retrieval + propensity, and incrementality/closed-loop optimization, with privacy-safe activation including data clean rooms. * **ML-based Forecasting** — audience growth, demand, and advertising yield/pricing forecasting that powers ad sales and marketing decisions. * **Content Preferences & Affinity** — genre-preference, content-preference, and single-title affinity modeling (two-tower retrieval with semantic content embeddings) that ranks audiences for upcoming titles and powers cross-channel promotion. **What You’ll Bring** **Required** * 5–8 years of industry experience in ML engineering or applied data science (3+ years with a Ph.D.). * Deep Python expertise and production-quality software engineering practices; production experience building and deploying ML at scale (millions+ of users/records). * Strong proficiency in Databricks (PySpark, Delta Lake, Workflows/DLT, MLflow, Unity Catalog) and solid SQL/Snowflake experience for feature sourcing and model-output delivery. * Experience with AWS ML services (SageMaker, S3, Lambda). * Strong understanding of ML model evaluation, A/B testing, and statistical inference; knowledge in one or more of recommendations & ranking, identity resolution, embeddings/retrieval, causal/interpretable ML, forecasting, bandits, or optimization. * Demonstrated ability to lead technical decisions and mentor engineers. * Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Engineering, or a related quantitative field (or equivalent experience). * Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to advocate technical solutions to engineers, scientists, and product stakeholders. **Preferred:** * Recommendation systems, personalization, identity resolution, or audience modeling in a media / streaming / ad-tech context. * Familiarity with Data Clean Room environments (Snowflake DCR, AWS Clean Rooms) and consent-aware activation. * Experience with two-tower / retrieval architectures, probabilistic identity resolution (graph-based matching, entity resolution), and probability calibration. * Hands-on experience with agentic AI frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, AutoGen, MCP), Databricks Genie Space configuration, and Snowflake Cortex. * Experience with feature stores (Databricks Feature Store, Tecton, Feast) and contributions to open source or ML publications. **What We Offer:** * A Great Place to work * Equal opportunity employer * Fast track growth opportunities **About Skydance** Skydance is a next-generation global media and entertainment company, comprised of three business segments: Studios, Direct-to-Consumer, and TV Media. Skydance's portfolio unites legendary brands, including Paramount, Warner Bros., HBO and HBO Max, Paramount+, Pluto TV, CBS, CNN, CBS Sports, TNT Sports, Nickelodeon, Cartoon Network, MTV, Food Network, BET, HGTV, and Comedy Central. **Some Important Details** We embrace the opportunity to build a workforce that reflects a wide array of perspectives, backgrounds and experiences. Being an equal opportunity employer means that we take seriously our responsibility to consider qualified candidates on the basis of merit. In line with the laws of the country or region in which the role is based, this includes consideration without regard to race, color, ethnicity, national origin, citizenship status, religion or belief, sex, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, pregnancy, parenthood, physical or mental disability, genetic information, military or protected veteran status, union status or any other category protected by applicable law. title: Senior Product Designer
description: aion is the enterprise AI platform, a full-stack solution for building, fine-tuning, and deploying AI at scale. Whether an organization is modernizing internal operations, launching AI-powered products, or transforming customer experiences, Aion takes them from concept to production on a single, unified platform. We’re a fast-growing, VC-backed startup led by founders with a track record of successful exits. With teams across the US, UK, and India, we’re building the next generation of enterprise AI and we’re looking for exceptional people to help us scale. We're hiring a product designer for whom UX and UI are one craft. You take a vague problem to a flow that feels obvious, then to screens where every pixel, word and transition is placed on purpose. The bar is software that feels inevitable: nothing missing, nothing extra, nothing a pixel out of place. What you'll do * Turn ambiguous problems into clear flows, information architecture and interaction models. * Design every state of every screen: empty, loading, partial, error and the edge cases nobody listed. * Own the visual layer: typography, layout, colour, iconography and hierarchy. * Specify interactions and motion precisely enough that engineers ship them as designed. * Build and evolve the design system. * Review what ships at 1× and 2×, and catch the 1 px misalignment, the wrong easing and the clipped label before anyone else does. * Test with real users and iterate until nothing is left to remove. **Requirements** UX * 6+ years in product design, with complex products shipped end to end. * User research: interviews, contextual inquiry and usability testing, planned and run yourself and turned into decisions. * Problem framing: user needs, jobs to be done and success measures defined before any screen is drawn. * End-to-end journeys: journey maps and service blueprints covering every touchpoint, handoff and failure path. * Task flows and wireframes that account for every branch, edge case and error, tested before visual design. * Information architecture: content models, navigation and labelling, validated with card sorts and tree tests. * Interaction design: mental models, affordances, feedback and system status, consistent across the product. * Evaluation: heuristic reviews and usability metrics such as task success, time on task and error rate. UI * Visual hierarchy: one clear focal point per screen, built with scale, weight, contrast and space rather than decoration. * Typography: type scales, optical sizes, tracking that tightens as type grows, tabular figures, and layouts that hold up at larger text sizes. * Layout: grids, a strict spacing scale, every edge on the pixel grid, and optical corrections where the measurements are right but the result looks wrong. * Colour: semantic colour systems for light and dark themes, and perceptually even palettes in OKLCH or Display P3. * Depth and materials: elevation, shadows, translucency and blur, continuous corner curves and concentric radii, used to show what is interactive and what sits on top of what. * Component states: default, hover, pressed, focus, selected, disabled, loading and error, designed for every component. * Design systems: primitive and semantic tokens, variables and modes, components with real variants, and documentation teams use. * Iconography: a consistent grid, stroke and corner language, with icons drawn to read at small sizes. * Motion: springs rather than fixed durations; fluid, interruptible motion that follows the finger and keeps its momentum on release; clear choreography of what moves first, what follows and what leaves. * Platform conventions: deep knowledge of desktop, web and mobile patterns, and the judgement to know when to break them. * Accessibility designed in from the start to WCAG 2.2 AA: contrast, focus order, larger text, reduced motion and screen-reader labels. Tools * Figma at expert level: variables and modes, component properties, auto layout, advanced prototyping and Figma Motion. * After Effects, Rive or ProtoPie when an interaction has to be felt, not described. Designing for AI * Interfaces for output that is non-deterministic, streamed and sometimes wrong. * Patterns that keep people in control: review, correction, undo and honest failure states. * Trust built through clarity, not decoration. Good to have * Illustration, iconography or brand identity work. * Industrial, print or type design, where tolerances are unforgiving. * Dense professional tools: editors, dashboards, developer products. * Public work: writing, talks or side projects. **Benefits** * Work directly with high-pedigree founders shaping technical and product strategy. * Build infrastructure powering the future of AI compute globally. * Significant ownership and impact with equity reflective of your contributions. * Competitive compensation, flexible work options, and wellness benefits.

You live at the intersection of product, design, and engineering. You take features from a half-formed idea to deployed and owned (frontend, backend, and everything between) and you care about the architecture, health, and quality of the whole thing, not just your slice. Your depth is in backend distributed systems, with a real feel for how mobile apps (iOS, Android, our shared KMM and WebView layers) consume what you build. You design the APIs, data layers, and platform infra other teams stand on, and you raise developer velocity org-wide: build systems, testing, observability, tooling. You reach for first principles over stack familiarity, you have taste in UX and accessibility, and you understand LLMs well enough to design automations that genuinely take load off support, ops, and engineering. You use AI dev tools to contain complexity and tech debt, not just to move faster. **What we look for** -------------------- * 5+ years shipping product end-to-end (ideation to deployment) that customers actually feel * Deep in backend distributed systems, with a strong grasp of mobile app ecosystems (native plus our shared KMM and WebView layers) * Designs APIs, data layers, and platform infra that other teams build on; raises developer velocity org-wide * Reasons from fundamentals and first principles over familiarity with any one stack * Understands LLMs and designs automations for support, developer productivity, and operational efficiency, including the trust boundaries they need * Has UX and accessibility sense, and uses AI dev tools to contain complexity and tech debt, not just go faster **The assignment** ------------------ A Cityflo support team is drowning: ~1,800 tickets a day in one undifferentiated queue, routine refunds and 'where's my bus' sitting next to safety incidents that get found too late. We hand you a messy real-world dataset (support tickets plus the trip and booking records behind them) and you decide what to build. Write a one-page product memo, then build the smallest useful end-to-end slice that puts an LLM where it actually earns its keep (triage, drafting, reconciling claims against trip data), with a real UI a human can use and a decision trail someone could later defend to a rider, to finance, or to a regulator. Build it like a platform seam, not a one-off. Some of the text in this dataset was written by people trying to game whatever reads it; design for that. AI is mandatory and part of what we grade. Up to a weekend; we expect 8–12 focused hours. Up to a weekend. We expect 8–12 focused hours of real work; going much past that is a signal we'd rather not see. Deliberate scoping is part of what we grade: a sharp slice of the data, handled honestly, beats a shallow pass over all of it.

title: Senior React Developer
description: Application *Solvd Inc. is a rapidly growing AI-native consulting and technology services firm delivering enterprise transformation across* ***cloud, data, software engineering, and artificial intelligence****. Our capability centers combine deep technical expertise, proven delivery methodologies, and sector-specific knowledge to address complex business challenges quickly and effectively.* We are looking for a **Senior React Developer** to build the front-end layer of a platform migration — a tenant/admin console for a new self-serve onboarding and configuration model, and a modernized analytics front end replacing a legacy BI tool being retired as part of this architectural shift. This is front-end work with real stakes. The current system has no way to view or change tenant configuration without a developer running a manual process, and the reporting layer it replaces wasn't built with multi-tenant, self-serve distribution in mind. You'll be building the UI that makes both of those problems go away. **What you'll do** ------------------ * Build a tenant/admin console — giving operators visibility into tenant status, configuration, feature toggles, and onboarding health without touching a backend service directly. * Migrate legacy BI reporting dashboards into native React components against a new data layer, preserving the analytics the business depends on. * Build visualization components for behavioral and event data — time-series, per-user, per-tenant activity — designed for the data model, not just a generic charting library dropped in. * Design every screen with multi-tenant data boundaries in mind — no shared component state, caching, or API call patterns that could leak one tenant's data into another's view, even transiently. * Work against APIs being built in parallel — adapting to evolving contracts as backend services for provisioning, configuration, and data access stabilize alongside your front-end work. * Make configuration changes usable, not just possible — ensuring operators can see what they're changing, for which tenant, and what the effect will be. **Required skills & experience** -------------------------------- * 5+ years of professional React development including TypeScript, in production applications used by real end users. * Experience building admin or back-office consoles for multi-tenant SaaS products — not just customer-facing marketing sites or single-tenant internal tools. * Experience with data visualization — time-series, dashboards, or similar — using charting libraries appropriate to the data and use case. * Comfortable working against REST or GraphQL APIs that are still evolving, including handling versioning and backward-incompatible changes gracefully. * Solid state-management discipline — able to explain and implement tenant data isolation across views in a multi-tenant admin UI, not just deliver happy-path screens. **Preferred qualifications** ---------------------------- * Experience building a front end hosted or embedded within a larger platform's own application framework rather than a fully standalone deployment. * Experience migrating legacy BI or reporting tool dashboards into custom-built components. * Familiarity with accessibility standards for enterprise admin tooling. **When you join Solvd, you'll…** * Shape real-world AI-driven projects across key industries, working with clients from startup innovation to enterprise transformation. * Be part of a global team with equal opportunities for collaboration across continents and cultures. * Thrive in an inclusive environment that prioritizes continuous learning, innovation, and ethical AI standards. **Ready to make an impact?** If you're excited to build things that matter, champion responsible AI, and grow with some of the industry’s sharpest minds. Apply today and let’s innovate together. *Solvd is an equal opportunity employer.*

title: Senior ServiceNow Developer

Customer Service Management (CSM) * Design and enhance case management, case lifecycle, assignment and routing, agent queues, approvals, SLAs, and notifications. * Develop business workflows and integrations around ServiceNow case management. * Ensure efficient case processing, data integrity, and reliable system behavior. 4. Configurable Workspace & UI Builder * Build modern user experiences using Configurable Workspace and UI Builder. * Configure Declarative Actions, Data Resources, contextual panels, dynamic forms, related lists, and user actions. * Develop intuitive interfaces integrated with backend services and business workflows. 5. Flow Designer / Workflow Studio * Build reusable flows, actions, subflows, approval processes, triggers, and decision logic. * Implement asynchronous execution and exception handling. * Select appropriate solutions across Flow Designer, Business Rules, Script Includes, Events, and integration services. 6. Security & Access Control * Configure ACLs, roles, groups, table-level and field-level security. * Implement secure API access, credential management, service accounts, and least-privilege access. * Maintain audit logging, traceability, and end-user authorization across integrations. 7. Production Support & Release Management * Troubleshoot production issues across ServiceNow applications, workflows, APIs, and external integrations. * Perform log analysis, API debugging, performance troubleshooting, and root-cause analysis. * Lead defect resolution, hotfixes, rollback planning, and post-release validation. * Manage DEV, TEST, UAT, and PROD deployments. * Work with Update Sets, Scoped Applications, Application Repository, source control, and Automated Test Framework (ATF). * Maintain engineering standards and ensure upgrade-safe implementations. 8. AI & Modern Integrations * Integrate ServiceNow with external AI, GenAI, enterprise search, and intelligence platforms. * Exchange user, case, and workflow context with external APIs. * Process external responses and display relevant information within Workspace. * Maintain audit history, source references, error handling, and traceability. technologies as the automation landscape evolves. ### **What You Will Get To Do:** * Design, build, test, deploy, and support complex enterprise automation solutions using Blue Prism * Own automation design, integration patterns, deployment models, and support models * Review and refactor poorly designed, unstable, or difficult-to-maintain automation solutions * Integrate Blue Prism with web applications, Windows applications, Java applications, mainframe systems, Citrix environments, APIs, databases, file systems, Microsoft Excel, Microsoft Outlook, and enterprise platforms * Build and consume REST and SOAP services and work with XML, JSON, authentication, certificates, tokens, and secure credentials * Work closely with infrastructure, architecture, information security, database, application-support, and business teams to resolve technical dependencies * Support Blue Prism environment upgrades, migrations, configuration changes, patching, capacity planning, and platform improvements * Participate in technical design reviews and challenge solutions that are not scalable, secure, supportable, or operationally resilient * Create clear technical documentation, including architecture teams to solve core engineering problems * Continuously expand technical capability by learning and applying multiple technologies based on business and platform needs ### **What You Will Prism development experience * Strong practical expertise in Blue Prism Process Studio and Object Studio * Deep understanding of Blue Prism application modelling, spying techniques, dynamic attributes, wait stages, collections, work queues, environment variables, credentials, schedules, sessions, and runtime resources * Demonstrated experience building complex Blue Prism solutions rather understanding of enterprise automation architecture and the technical dependencies required to run Blue Prism at scale * Experience integrating Blue Prism with REST APIs, SOAP services, XML, JSON, integrations * Experience with at least one programming or scripting technology such as C#, .NET, Python, PowerShell, JavaScript, or VBA * Ability to read and troubleshoot code, scripts, API payloads, including application servers, interactive clients, runtime resources, databases, virtual machines, connectivity, and environment configuration * Experience with production monitoring, incident management, problem management, change management, and release management * Strong understanding of SDLC, Agile delivery, release controls, security controls, and enterprise development standards * title: Senior Software Engineer (Machine Learning)
description: Everything we do is for our customers! Featured on Deloitte's Technology Fast 500 list and G2's leaderboard, Maropost offers a unified commerce experience that our customers need, transforming ecommerce, retail, marketing automation, merchandising, helpdesk and AI operations with one platform designed to scale for fast-growing businesses. With a relentless focus on our customers’ success, we are motivated by customer obsession, extreme urgency, excellence and resourcefulness to power 5,000+ global brands while we head to 100,000+. Driven by the same customer-centric mentality as above, we empower businesses to achieve their goals and grow alongside us. If you're a driver and not passenger and are ready to make a significant impact and be part of our transformative journey, Maropost is the place for you. **The Opportunity:** You will own the machine learning that powers product discovery for our merchants: personalized search ranking, recommendation widgets, email recommendations, and an LLM shopping assistant. This is an end-to-end role. You will train the models, build the services that serve them, and keep both running in production. You will not hand a model over a wall to someone else. The team is small and the systems are real: Recommendations are re-ranked in the live request path for storefronts, under a 200 ms budget, measured by merchant conversion. **What Youʼll Be Responsible For:** * Design, train and ship recommendation and ranking models - session-based embeddings, collaborative filtering, content and visual embeddings. * Build and operate the Python services that serve them at low latency. * Run the batch pipelines that rebuild model artifacts daily across hundreds of merchants. * Design and read AB tests; decide what ships on the evidence. * Own your deployments: containers, Kubernetes manifests, autoscaling, dashboards, alerts. * Extend our LLM work - a shopping assistant and LLM-assisted catalogue enrichment - with proper evaluation behind it. **What Youʼll Bring to Maropost:** * 5+ years building machine learning systems, with at least 3 years of models serving live production traffic. * Strong Python,(FastAPI or equivalent). * Vector databases (Qdrant). * Other ANN libraries - FAISS, Annoy, ScaNN. title: Senior Software Solutions Engineer

title: Senior Technical PM, Applied AI
description: **About the Company:** Netomi is the leading agentic AI platform for enterprise customer experience. We work with the largest global brands like Delta Airlines, MetLife, United, and others to enable agentic automation at scale across the entire customer journey. Our no-code platform delivers the fastest time to market, lowest total cost of ownership, and simple, scalable management of AI agents for any CX use case. Backed by WndrCo, Y Combinator, and Index Ventures, we help enterprises drive efficiency, lower costs, and deliver higher quality customer experiences. Want to be part of the AI revolution and transform how the world’s largest global brands do business? Join us! Netomi is hiring a Senior Technical PM to own the product strategy and roadmap for our Agents platform. You will decide what we build and why, tie every investment to enterprise customer and business outcomes, and get capabilities shipped and adopted by some of the world’s largest brands. This role is also firmly hands-on. You will work directly with AI labs, understand new model capabilities early, build experiments and prototypes yourself, design evaluations and debug failing agents. You use that hands-on work to make better, faster product decisions. ### **Product and business ownership** * **Business focus:** tie the roadmap to measurable business outcomes such as autonomous resolution rate, cost per resolution, CSAT, revenue expansion and competitive wins. Know where Netomi wins and loses against competitors, and shape our position. * **Product strategy and roadmap:** own the multi-quarter roadmap for Agents end to end, from problem discovery and prioritization to delivery and outcome tracking. Make and defend hard trade-offs when priorities compete. * **Customer and partner needs:** work directly with enterprise customers, Customer Success, Delivery and Sales to find the highest-value problems. Translate them into clear problem statements, PRDs, user stories, success metrics and dependency maps. * **Cross-functional leadership:** drive alignment across engineering, research, data science, QA and go-to-market on scope, dependencies and launch readiness, without direct authority. * **Planning and execution:** run the cadence of quarterly roadmap inputs, monthly scope lock, weekly execution reviews and launch readiness sign-offs. * **Launch and adoption:** own launch checklists (instrumentation, enablement, success criteria), track adoption per capability and publish a monthly Agent Outcomes readout across deployments. * **Post-release learning:** run monitoring windows and post-incident reviews, and feed what you learn back into the roadmap. ### **Product areas you will own** * **Agent reasoning and orchestration:** multi-step task planning, action selection, retry and fallback logic, and supervisor and sub-agent patterns. * **Tool and API use:** reliable, observable, policy-compliant tool calling for CRM, ITSM and custom enterprise systems, including MCP. * **Memory and context:** conversation memory, long-running task state and continuity across channels and sessions. * **Human-in-the-loop:** clarification, graceful escalation to live agents, approval steps for high-risk actions and hybrid autonomy modes. * **Enterprise governance:** guardrails, audit trails, explainable decisions, role-based access, and safe rollout through shadow mode, staged releases and rollback. ### **Hands-on work** * **AI labs and new capabilities:** be our product point person with AI labs and model providers. Test new models and features (reasoning, tool use, realtime voice, memory) on our use cases, decide what to build, change or skip, and give labs evidence-based feedback. * **Experiments and prototypes:** vibe code prototypes, build agents, and connect them to real systems through APIs and MCP tools. Run offline tests, shadow mode and canary releases with clear decision criteria, and hand engineering a working reference, not just a document. * **Evaluation and quality:** define the Agent Readiness Scorecard and Go/No-Go criteria. Design evals for task completion, tool success, policy compliance, latency and cost, and keep regression tests running on every model, prompt or tool change. * **Debugging production failures:** read agent traces with engineering, find root causes (wrong action, missed escalation, bad tool call, memory gaps) and make sure each serious failure gets a fix and a test. * **Model choices:** inform model selection and routing decisions by weighing quality, latency and cost with real data. ### **Requirements** **Product skills** * Roughly 4–8 years of relevant experience, ideally from a deeply technical product role, applied AI engineering or research engineering with clear product ownership. * Proven ownership of a complex technical product area, with features delivered to enterprise customers and measurable business results. * Strong product judgment: you can prioritize, work with customers and get capabilities shipped. * Customer-first: you turn enterprise needs into clear, actionable requirements. * Excellent communicator who can align engineering, research and go-to-market teams and present clearly to executives. **Hands-on skills** * Comfortable vibe coding, building agents, connecting APIs and MCP tools, designing evaluations and debugging production failures. * Deep understanding of LLM reasoning, tool calling, multi-step task execution, orchestration patterns, evaluation methods and production observability for agents. * Technical fluency with APIs, cloud environments and AI deployment workflows. ### **Nice to have** * Experience shipping AI agent products at a conversational AI or enterprise AI platform company. * Direct experience working with AI labs or model providers (early-access programs, model evaluations). * Familiarity with agent frameworks and protocols (e.g., LangGraph, MCP) and with voice AI. * Experience in regulated or mission-critical industries (airlines, banking, healthcare, payments) and with large SI partners. * Public work you can show: a repo, demo, blog post or talk. Netomi is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity in the workplace. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, disability, veteran status, and other protected characteristics. We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.
