title: Site Reliability Engineer, Cloud Platform
description: Come work at a place where innovation and teamwork come together to support the most exciting missions in the world! **Site Reliability Engineer (SRE)** **The Opportunity** The Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) plays a critical role in ensuring the **reliability, scalability, performance, and operational excellence** of Qualys platforms and services. This role operates at the intersection of software engineering and operations, applying automation, observability, troubleshooting, and reliability engineering practices to maintain highly available production systems and improve customer experience. The SRE will work closely with Engineering, DevOps, Infrastructure, Security, and Data Platform teams to monitor production systems, troubleshoot issues, automate operational processes, and continuously improve system reliability. **Where This Role Sits** The SRE role partners closely with **Engineering, DevOps, Infrastructure, Security, and Data Platform teams** to ensure production systems remain resilient, scalable, observable, and operationally efficient. The role provides hands-on support for cloud-native and distributed systems, including **Kubernetes, Apache Spark, Kafka, and cloud-based data platforms**, while contributing to incident response, automation, monitoring, and reliability improvements. **Key Responsibilities** **Reliability and Operations** * Monitor production applications, infrastructure, and distributed systems to identify issues and maintain service health. * Participate in incident response, troubleshooting, escalation, and root-cause analysis. * Support highly available and scalable production services and workloads. * Monitor system performance, resource utilization, availability, latency, and overall service health. * Participate in on-call rotations and follow established incident management processes. * Support capacity planning and identify potential reliability and performance risks. * Assist engineering teams in resolving production issues and implementing corrective actions. * Contribute to post-incident reviews and continuous reliability improvements. **Data Platform and Distributed Systems** * Support the operation and monitoring of **Apache Spark workloads and Kafka pipelines**. * Monitor distributed data-processing workloads and investigate performance or availability issues. * Assist with troubleshooting Spark jobs, Kafka pipelines, application failures, resource constraints, and related production issues. * Develop an understanding of distributed systems concepts and their operational requirements. * Support data platforms and technologies such as **Delta Lake and S3** where applicable. * Apply basic SQL skills for troubleshooting, validation, and operational analysis. **Kubernetes and Cloud Operations** * Assist with **Kubernetes deployments, resource monitoring, application troubleshooting, and operational support**. * Monitor containerized applications and investigate resource, availability, and performance issues. * Support cloud environments such as **AWS, OCI, or Google Cloud Platform**. * Work with infrastructure and engineering teams on configuration, deployments, and operational workflows. * Develop familiarity with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and cloud-native operational practices. **Monitoring and Observability** * Monitor applications, infrastructure, and distributed workloads using tools such as **Prometheus and Grafana**. * Create and maintain dashboards, alerts, and monitoring configurations. * Analyze logs, metrics, and system behavior to identify and troubleshoot production issues. * Track reliability indicators such as availability, latency, performance, resource utilization, and service health. * Contribute to improvements in observability and proactive issue detection. **Automation and Platform Engineering** * Develop scripts and automation to reduce repetitive manual operational tasks. * Create tooling for monitoring, log analysis, troubleshooting, deployments, and operational workflows. * Use **Python, Bash, Go, or similar** **programming/scripting** **languages** to automate operational processes. * Support CI/CD and automated deployment workflows. * Contribute to Infrastructure as Code and self-service capabilities where applicable. * Continuously improve operational processes through automation and standardization. **Collaboration and Continuous Improvement** * Collaborate with Engineering, DevOps, Infrastructure, Security, and Data Platform teams to improve system reliability. * Assist development teams in designing and operating production-ready services. * Document system architectures, operational procedures, troubleshooting steps, and best practices. * Create and maintain **runbooks, SOPs, and troubleshooting guides**. * Proactively identify reliability risks and opportunities for operational improvement. * Contribute to SRE best practices, knowledge sharing, and continuous improvement initiatives. **What Good Looks Like** * Proactively identifies reliability and performance risks before they significantly impact customers. * Responds effectively to production incidents and contributes to meaningful root-cause analysis. * Uses automation to reduce repetitive manual operational work. * Demonstrates strong troubleshooting skills across Linux, Kubernetes, cloud, and distributed systems. * Effectively monitors and analyzes system metrics, logs, and application behavior. * Collaborates effectively with engineering and infrastructure teams to resolve production issues. * Continuously improves system reliability, observability, scalability, and operational efficiency. * Builds a strong understanding of production systems and applies SRE principles to day-to-day operations. **Distinguishing Expectations** The SRE is measured by improvements in **reliability, automation, operational efficiency, observability, and service availability**. For an early-career SRE, success is demonstrated through: * Effective monitoring and troubleshooting of production systems. * Rapid learning of complex production environments. * Reduction of manual operational effort through automation. * Consistent participation in incident response and root-cause analysis. * Improvements to monitoring, documentation, and operational processes. * Growing ownership of production services and reliability-focused initiatives. **Required Qualifications** * **0–3 years** of experience in SRE, DevOps, Cloud Engineering, Systems Engineering, or a related technical role. * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. * Basic understanding of **Linux/Unix systems**, processes, memory, networking, and system troubleshooting. * Fundamental understanding of **distributed systems and cloud-native technologies**. * Experience or familiarity with **Kubernetes and containerized applications**. * Familiarity with **Apache Spark, Kafka, or similar distributed data-processing platforms**. * Strong programming and scripting fundamentals in **Python, Bash, Go, Java, Scala, or similar languages**. * Ability to write scripts for automation, monitoring, log analysis, and operational tasks. * Basic **SQL** knowledge and strong problem-solving skills. * Familiarity with monitoring and observability tools such as **Prometheus and Grafana**. * Basic understanding of cloud platforms such as **AWS, OCI, or Google Cloud Platform**. * Understanding of basic networking, security, and distributed systems concepts. * Willingness to learn production systems, debugging techniques, and SRE practices. **Preferred Qualifications** * Familiarity with **Delta Lake, S3, or distributed data platforms**. * Understanding of **CI/CD** and automated deployment processes. * Familiarity with **Terraform, CloudFormation, or other Infrastructure as Code tools**. * Experience with scripting-based automation or internal tooling projects. * Familiarity with tools such as **Jenkins, GitHub, Bitbucket, ELK, Splunk, or AppDynamics**. * Experience with large-scale or distributed systems. * Understanding of reliability engineering principles and automation best practices. * Exposure to incident management, on-call processes, and postmortem practices. * Cloud certifications are a plus. * Strong analytical, communication, collaboration, and troubleshooting skills. **Core Competencies** **SRE | Linux | Python / Bash / Go | Coding & Scripting | Spark | Kafka | Kubernetes | Cloud Platforms | SQL | Monitoring & Observability | Automation | Distributed Systems | Troubleshooting | Incident Response | CI/CD | Reliability Engineering** **Work Environment** * Full-time role. * On-call participation may be required. * Hybrid or remote flexibility depending on company policy. * Cross-functional collaboration with Engineering, DevOps, Infrastructure, Security, and Data Platform teams. * Opportunity to work with cloud-native, distributed, and large-scale production systems. **ABOUT QUALYS** Qualys, Inc. is a pioneer and leading provider of cloud-based IT, security, and compliance solutions, serving more than 10,000 customers across over 130 countries. Qualys delivers innovative security and compliance solutions that help organizations simplify security operations and reduce risk.

scale (high TPS, large datasets, or multi-tenant environments) * Expert-level Node.js and a strong track record of writing clean, modular, reusable codeDeep expertise with MongoDB (complex schemas, title: Software Engineer
description: **ABOUT INDEX ENGINES** At Index Engines, we're all about helping companies bounce back from cyber threats and trust their data again — no matter what hits them. You'll be a key contributor in both creating what's next and keeping what's built running smoothly. requirements into working software. * Install and configure Index Engines products in Linux environments, including creating and managing virtual machines. * Implement and refine automation strategies to validate functionality, performance, and stability. * Troubleshoot automation pipelines, identify bottlenecks, and improve efficiency through creative problem-solving. * Contribute to architecture and CI/CD integration, ensuring automation is embedded in the development process. **WHAT YOU BRING** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field. * 3+ years of professional software engineering experience. * Strong experience with Python and a solid understanding of Linux environments. * Skilled in Bash scripting, SSH operations, and basic SQL usage. * Familiar with REST APIs, Postman, and cURL. * Experience with UI testing frameworks like Playwright, Selenium, or similar tools. * Comfortable with Git/GitHub and Jira for version control and task virtualization, network-attached storage, and data management and protection solutions — is an added advantage. * Bonus points if you've worked with AWS, Docker, or Ansible Playbooks. **YOU'LL SUCCEED A pioneer in the field, FlexTrade is internationally recognized for introducing FlexTRADER®, the world’s first broker-neutral execution management trading system, which allows clients to completely control and customize their execution workflows through a comprehensive ability to search/access liquidity while maintaining the confidentiality of their trading strategies. At FlexTrade, we hold our values close to heart, with pride and gratitude, as they guide us in everything that we do. Although we are a small team, we leverage our cross-functional expertise to deliver quality campaigns to our stakeholders from strategy through execution. The ideal candidate is passionate about building robust backend services, creating intuitive user interfaces, and driving technical excellence across the development lifecycle. **Key Responsibilities:** * Design, develop, and maintain scalable backend applications and services using Golang. * Build, enhance, and support RESTful APIs and microservices-based architectures. * Ensure application performance, reliability, scalability, and security through best engineering practices. * Collaborate closely with product managers, designers, and cross-functional teams to define, develop, and deliver new features. * Write clean, maintainable, and well-tested code while adhering to coding standards and best practices. * Participate in code reviews, technical discussions, and continuous improvement initiatives. * Develop and maintain responsive, user-friendly web interfaces using Angular or React. * Troubleshoot, debug, and resolve application issues to ensure a seamless user experience. * Contribute to the design and implementation of modern software architectures and development processes. * Stay up to date with emerging technologies and recommend improvements to enhance product quality and development efficiency. * Minimum 2+ years of experience in Golang + Snowflake + MongoDB, React, JavaScript, HTML, CSS * Understanding and experience in shell scripting and database queries (RDMS/NoSQL). * Experience in UNIX fundamentals, REST APIs, and understanding of the microservices concept. * Must be able to see opportunities for improvement and meet client expectations in terms of quality and timeliness. * Experience with RESTful APIs integration into frontend frameworks. **Skills - Must Have** * Excellent command over Golang + React, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, Bootstrap, Nginx. * Experience of working with shell scripts, TypeScript, and Ajax. * Comfortable in converting UI Mock-ups into finished web apps (Angular/ReactJS & Redux/HTML/CSS). * Should have an understanding of web standards & responsive web design. * Good UI / UX sense and comfortable with responsive design. * Software Product Development experience with Microservices architecture. * Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills. * Experience in version control framework GIT/Bitbucket. **Good to Have** * Experience in ReactJS & Redux will be an added advantage. * Exposure to CI/CD pipelines. * Experience of using UI libraries like Material UI, PrimeFaces (Primeng, PrimeReact), Ag-grid, Bootstrap. FlexTrade does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firm recruiters. Fees will not be paid in the event a candidate submitted by a recruiter without an authorized agreement for a particular SOW (Statement of Work) in place is hired: such resumes are deemed the sole property of FlexTrade. *FlexTrade Systems, Inc. is an equal opportunity employer and makes employment decisions without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status disability status or any other status protected by law.*

title: Software Engineer (India)
description: At Commure, we're building the AI Operating System for healthcare, the foundation that defines how care is delivered, documented, and financed. Our platform spans the full care journey: Ambient AI and Dictation eliminating documentation burden at the point of care, intelligent Agents automating patient and revenue workflows, and autonomous RCM processing billions in claims, all on a single AI-native platform integrated with 60+ EHRs. Healthcare carries a $1 trillion administrative burden and we're at the center of transforming it. Today, 500,000+ clinicians across 500+ healthcare organizations nationwide trust Commure to handle $25B+ in annual claims and support over 200 million patient interactions. Our latest $70M raise at a $7B valuation reflects the confidence the market has placed in this mission. We've also been named to the Fortune Future 50 list and the 2026 AI Breakthrough Awards for “Overall NLP Company of the Year.” Our team works directly alongside clinicians, not through layers of process, which means the gap between what you build and its impact on patient care is immediate. We move fast, deploy daily, and take full ownership from early thinking to production. If you're energized by hard problems, high stakes, and a team that holds itself to a high bar, you'll find your people here. The future of healthcare is being built right now. Come deliver this transformation. **About the Role** As a Software Engineer at Commure, you'll play a crucial role in collaborating directly with healthcare clients, understanding their needs, and actively participating in the design and implementation of customized solutions. This immersive experience offers you the chance to be at the heart of healthcare technology, contributing to projects that enhance patient access, affordability, and care quality. In this highly visible position, you'll provide essential technical support, tackle various challenges, and maintain vital documentation. Additionally, by keeping pace with evolving healthcare technology trends, you'll contribute innovative ideas and solutions. Your contributions will be instrumental in advancing our mission to revolutionize healthcare through technology. This role is based in **India** and will require working hours aligned with **US time zones** to support our US-based clients and teams. **What You'll Do** * Participate in the implementation process, aiding in the integration of our solutions into client settings. * Provide technical assistance and contribute to problem-solving during deployment and integration phases. * Work collaboratively with healthcare clients to understand their technology needs, compliance requirements, and patient care goals. * Support our development and engineering teams in crafting tailored solutions for the healthcare industry. * Help identify and address technical challenges encountered during project implementation. * Assist in creating and updating technical documentation to streamline client onboarding and system maintenance. * Keep informed about the latest trends in healthcare technology and regulations to help propose relevant solutions. **What You Have** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field * 1+ years of professional experience in software engineering or a similar role * Foundational knowledge of full-stack engineering principles and system design. * Experience with programming languages such as Python, Javascript, React, and SQL. * Experience building 0-1 products * Demonstrated strong problem-solving skills and effective communication abilities. * Eagerness to collaborate and ability to engage confidently with clients. * Adaptability and enthusiasm for working in a fast-paced, client-focused healthcare environment. Please be aware that all official communication from us will come exclusively from email addresses ending in **@****commure.com**. Any emails from other domains are not affiliated with our organization. Employees will act in accordance with the organization’s information security policies, to include but not limited to protecting assets from unauthorized access, disclosure, modification, destruction or interference nor execute particular security processes or activities. Employees will report to the information security office any confirmed or potential events or other risks to the organization. Employees will be required to attest to these requirements upon hire and on an annual basis.

title: Software Engineer - Frontend

title: Software Engineer 2

This is a high-impact engineering systems role requiring strong technical depth, innovation, and ownership. We do not just value differences or different perspectives. title: Software Team Leader
description: We are looking for a hands-on Technical Head who can take ownership of our overall technology and development function. The person will be responsible for overseeing ongoing development, reviewing technical implementation, solving complex integration requirements, building APIs and webhooks, managing server and cloud infrastructure, and ensuring that all technology systems work reliably with our marketing, CRM, analytics, and third-party platforms. This is not a purely managerial role. The ideal candidate should be technically strong enough to understand, review, troubleshoot, design, and implement solutions independently when required. The candidate should have strong experience with APIs, webhooks, server-side integrations, cloud infrastructure, databases, CRM integrations, marketing APIs, conversion tracking, CAPI, offline conversions, and automation. **Key Responsibilities** 1. Development & Technical Oversight - Oversee the development team and monitor the progress and quality of ongoing projects. - Review technical architecture, code quality, development practices, and implementation. - Understand existing applications, websites, dashboards, portals, and backend systems. - Identify technical issues and provide practical solutions. - Review developers' work and ensure projects are delivered according to requirements. - Take ownership of critical technical tasks when the development team requires support. - Ensure proper documentation of APIs, integrations, architecture, credentials, environments, and deployment processes. - Establish technical standards and best practices across projects. 2. API Development & Integration - Design, develop, integrate, and maintain REST APIs and other required APIs. - Create APIs based on business, product, CRM, and marketing requirements. - Develop and manage webhooks for real-time data transfer and event-based communication. - Integrate third-party APIs, SaaS platforms, CRMs, payment systems, analytics platforms, and marketing platforms. - Handle authentication methods such as API keys, OAuth, tokens, JWT, etc. - Understand API request/response structures, JSON, HTTP methods, status codes, authentication, rate limits, and error handling. - Troubleshoot failed API calls, data mismatches, authentication issues, and integration failures. - Build middleware or backend services where required to connect multiple platforms. 3. Marketing Technology & Tracking Integrations A strong understanding of MarTech and performance marketing integrations is mandatory. The candidate should be able to work closely with the marketing and performance marketing teams to implement and troubleshoot: - Meta Conversions API (CAPI) - Meta Pixel - Google Ads Conversion Tracking - Google Ads Offline Conversion Tracking - Google Ads API / Data Manager integrations - Google Analytics 4 - Google Tag Manager - CRM integrations - Lead tracking and lead lifecycle integrations - Click ID tracking such as GCLID, FBCLID and other attribution parameters - UTM tracking - Server-side tracking - Web-to-CRM integrations - CRM-to-ad-platform integrations - Conversion and event APIs - Postback integrations - S2S tracking - Affiliate tracking integrations - Webhook-based lead and conversion transfer - Offline conversion uploads - Lead status and revenue/value feedback to advertising platforms The candidate should understand how a lead moves from: Ad → Landing Page → Tracking → CRM → Sales/Conversion → Revenue → Marketing Platform and should be able to build or troubleshoot the technical infrastructure required at each stage. 4. CRM & Data Integrations - Integrate websites, landing pages, CRM systems, marketing platforms, and internal systems. - Build APIs and webhooks for lead creation, lead updates, status changes, and conversion events. - Ensure accurate transfer of lead information between systems. - Implement two-way data synchronization where required. - Maintain unique identifiers and event IDs to prevent duplicate conversions. - Build systems for passing revenue, transaction, deposit, purchase, or other conversion values back to advertising platforms. - Work with marketing teams to ensure accurate attribution and reporting. 5. Server & Cloud Infrastructure - Manage and understand server environments and cloud infrastructure. - Work with platforms such as AWS, Google Cloud, Azure, Cloudflare, or equivalent infrastructure. - Understand domains, DNS, SSL, CDN, hosting, databases, storage, networking, and server configuration. - Manage application deployment and production environments. - Monitor server performance, uptime, logs, errors, and resource utilization. - Troubleshoot server-side issues affecting websites, APIs, applications, and integrations. - Implement appropriate security measures for APIs and backend systems. - Work with developers and external infrastructure teams when required. 6. Database & Backend - Strong understanding of backend architecture and databases. - Work with SQL and/or NoSQL databases. - Understand database structures, relationships, queries, indexing, and data integrity. - Ensure reliable storage and transfer of lead, customer, transaction, and conversion data. - Troubleshoot database-related issues and performance problems. - Design appropriate data structures for API and integration requirements. 7. Technical Problem Solving - Act as the escalation point for complex technical issues. - Diagnose problems across frontend, backend, APIs, servers, databases, and third-party platforms. - Identify whether an issue is related to code, server configuration, API, tracking, CRM, cloud infrastructure, or third-party systems. - Work with developers to resolve bugs and production issues quickly. - Take ownership of technical incidents until resolution. 8. Technology Planning & Architecture - Evaluate existing technology infrastructure and recommend improvements. - Design scalable technical solutions for new projects. - Select appropriate technologies, APIs, services, and infrastructure based on project requirements. - Review third-party tools before implementation. - Ensure systems are scalable, secure, maintainable, and properly documented. - Identify opportunities to automate repetitive technical and operational processes. Required Technical Skills Backend & APIs - REST APIs - API development and integration - Webhooks - JSON - HTTP/HTTPS - OAuth 2.0 - JWT / API authentication - API security - Error handling and logging Programming Strong hands-on knowledge of at least one backend language/framework, such as: - Node.js / Express - PHP / Laravel - Python / Django / FastAPI - Java / Spring - .NET / C# Knowledge of JavaScript/TypeScript would be an advantage. Cloud & Infrastructure - AWS / Google Cloud / Azure - Linux - Server management - DNS - SSL - CDN - Cloudflare - Hosting and deployment - Basic networking - Monitoring and logging - CI/CD Database - MySQL / PostgreSQL - MongoDB or other NoSQL databases - Database design - Query optimization - Data security and integrity Marketing Technology Hands-on experience with: - Meta Pixel & CAPI - Google Ads Conversion Tracking - Google Ads Offline Conversions - Google Analytics 4 - Google Tag Manager - CRM integrations - Server-side tracking - S2S integrations - Postbacks - Webhooks - UTM and attribution tracking - GCLID / FBCLID and similar tracking parameters - Conversion APIs Integration Experience Experience integrating platforms such as: - CRMs - Marketing automation platforms - Payment gateways - Analytics platforms - Advertising platforms - Affiliate networks - Lead management systems - WhatsApp / communication APIs - Internal business applications - Third-party SaaS platforms Leadership Responsibilities - Manage and mentor the development team. - Allocate technical tasks and monitor delivery. - Review development timelines and identify bottlenecks. - Conduct technical reviews of major projects. - Ensure developers follow proper coding, deployment, security, and documentation practices. - Coordinate with marketing, sales, operations, and management teams. - Convert business requirements into practical technical solutions. - Work with external developers, vendors, and technology partners when required. **Ideal Candidate** The ideal candidate is someone who can both manage technology and get their hands dirty technically. You should be comfortable going from a business requirement such as: «"We need every qualified lead from the CRM to be sent back to Meta and Google with the correct campaign, click ID, lead status, and conversion value."» to understanding exactly: Where the data originates → how it is stored → which API/webhook is required → how authentication works → how the data is transformed → how it is sent → how errors are handled → how the conversion is verified. Similarly, if a developer says an integration cannot be completed because "the API isn't working," you should be able to investigate the API documentation, inspect requests/responses and logs, identify the actual problem, and guide or implement the solution. **Qualifications** - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field preferred. - 6+ years of relevant technical experience. - Strong backend development experience. - Strong API and third-party integration experience. - Hands-on experience with cloud/server infrastructure. - Experience managing developers or a technical team. - Strong understanding of marketing technology and conversion tracking. - Experience working with CRM and advertising platform integrations. - Excellent troubleshooting and problem-solving skills. **Key Performance Areas** Success in this role will be measured by: - Quality and reliability of technical implementations - Successful API and third-party integrations - Stability of production systems - Accuracy of marketing and conversion tracking - Reduction in technical issues and integration failures - Development team productivity and delivery - API/webhook reliability - Server and cloud uptime - Security and scalability of systems - Speed of resolving critical technical issues **What We Are Looking For** Must Have: - Strong backend development knowledge - API development and integration - Webhook implementation - CRM integration - Server/cloud knowledge - Database knowledge - Meta CAPI - Google Ads conversion/offline conversion integration - GTM and GA4 - Server-side tracking - Strong troubleshooting skills - Ability to manage and review developers - Willingness to remain hands-on technically **Good to Have:** - AWS / GCP certification - DevOps experience - Docker - CI/CD - Cloudflare - Affiliate/postback tracking - Fintech/e-commerce/ad-tech experience - Experience with high-volume lead and conversion data - Experience building internal automation systems **Role Summary** We are looking for a Technical Head who can own the complete technical ecosystem, from development and APIs to servers, cloud infrastructure, CRM, marketing integrations, tracking, and automation. The person should be a technical problem solver first and a team manager second, with the ability to understand business requirements, architect the solution, guide developers, and personally implement critical integrations when required. Pay: ₹700,000.00 - ₹1,200,000.00 per year Application Question(s): * Have you managed or mentored a development team? If yes, how many members and in what capacity? * Are you a immediate joiner? * Do you have hands-on experience with marketing/tracking integrations such as Meta CAPI, Google Ads Conversion Tracking (including offline conversions), GA4, and GTM? Please briefly describe your experience. * Which backend language/framework are you most proficient in (Node.js, PHP/Laravel, Python, Java, .NET, etc.), and how many years have you worked with it? * How many years of experience do you have building and integrating REST APIs and webhooks with third-party platforms (CRM, payment gateways, marketing platforms, etc.)? * Total how many years of experience do you have? Work Location: In person

description: **Overview** Work with multinational enterprise customers to achieve their business goals using Azure as their platform of choice. Open doors, become a trusted technical adviser, uncover opportunities and turn their ambitions into practical solutions that deliver business value. Combine an enterprise-architecture mindset and broad cloud understanding with strong, hands-on Apps and AI expertise. You do not need to be the deepest expert in every Azure service; know how a complete solution fits together and when to involve specialists and subject matter experts. This role offers autonomy and influence across customer organisations. Own the technical direction of complex opportunities, align teams when priorities are unclear and take responsibility for achieving agreed technical outcomes. Work from executive conversations to practical demonstrations, challenging assumptions constructively and drawing on account teams, specialists and partners. **Responsibilities** ### **Technical Sales Leadership** * Proactively build customer access, discover unmet needs across Azure and create new technical opportunities that deliver business value. * Independently lead complex engagements spanning multiple technologies, teams and customer locations. Align stakeholders, resolve competing priorities and drive technical decisions through discovery, workshops and demonstrations. ### **Application Modernization** * Help customers modernise applications using Azure and cloud-native approaches, balancing existing investments with future business needs. * Guide modern software delivery and developer productivity, including GitHub and GitHub Copilot, to accelerate innovation. ### **AI & Intelligent Applications** * Shape intelligent applications and agent solutions using Microsoft Foundry, Copilot technologies and enterprise data, including Microsoft Fabric where relevant. * Build focused prototypes and demonstrations to test customer ideas, show value and guide secure, responsible AI adoption. ### **Solution Design & Architecture** * Take an end-to-end view across Azure infrastructure, networking, identity, security, data, applications and AI, including hybrid environments. * Adapt and extend architecture patterns for complex customer requirements. Make clear recommendations on trade-offs between business value, security, reliability and cost, and develop practical roadmaps rather than isolated product designs. * Work with specialists, customer success and partners to help customers progress from architecture to adoption. ### **Customer & Market Engagement** * Build trusted relationships from developers and architects to Heads of Development and VPs; listen, challenge constructively and build consensus across technical and business stakeholders. * Understand customer priorities, programmes and decision-makers, aligning technical engagement with their wider business and transformation strategy. ### **Sales & Business Impact** * Use business and commercial judgement to connect technical choices to customer outcomes and differentiated Microsoft value, building a clear case for investment. * Qualify technical opportunities around clear customer needs and business value, and agree meaningful next steps. * Shape the strategy for winning and growing opportunities with account teams, using customer and competitive insight to guide investment decisions and overcome technical barriers. ### **Team & Community Contribution** * Lead collaboration across teams and coach technical colleagues and account teams. Create reusable architectures and approaches from customer engagements, and help others apply them to improve outcomes beyond your own opportunities. * Maintain hands-on learning, relevant skills and certifications, and demonstrate inclusion, integrity and customer focus. **Qualifications** ### **Minimum Qualifications** Meet one of the following alternatives: * Master's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field AND 4+ years technical pre-sales or technical consulting experience; * OR Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field AND 6+ years technical pre-sales or technical consulting experience; * OR 7+ years technical pre-sales or technical consulting experience; * OR equivalent experience. ### **Technical Experience** * Proven experience across technical selling and delivery, leading complex opportunities across multiple technologies and teams from discovery to practical validation. Infrastructure & Systems Engineering** Architect and modernize a scalable, high-availability voice infrastructure that replaces legacy systems Build multi-threaded, low-latency server frameworks handling to ensure reliable audio flow between telephony providers, clients, and ML services **Evaluation, Observability & Quality** Define and implement speech quality evaluation frameworks, including WER/CER analysis, latency tracking, and perceptual TTS metrics Build tooling and dashboards to monitor production performance and detect regressions in accuracy, latency, or naturalness ASR and TTS models Work with Security and Compliance teams to ensure voice data handling meets enterprise and regulatory standards Collaborate with Product teams to translate conversational quality requirements into measurable system improvements ### **What you'll need** **Core Engineering Background** 5+ years of software engineering experience building and operating production-grade streaming data **Speech & Audio Expertise** Practical experience working with ASR and/or TTS systems in applied or production environments Understanding of how to adapt and tune speech models for domain-specific use cases Familiarity with speech quality metrics such as WER, CER, MOS, latency, and streaming stability Strong grasp of audio fundamentals, including sample rates, codecs (Opus, G.711), buffering, packet loss, and jitter **Applied ML for Speech** Experience evaluating model performance and running structured experiments to improve transcription accuracy and speech naturalness techniques or phoneme/word-level timing models * Hands-on experience deploying ML services with Kubernetes, Docker, and cloud platforms (AWS/GCP/Azure) * Knowledge of event-driven and asynchronous systems (e.g., async I/O, event loops, streaming frameworks) * Experience analyzing large-scale speech or conversation datasets to drive model or system improvements $215,000 - $235,000 a year The stacks (RAG, vector databases, A2A) * Experience handling unstructured data; technical documents, specifications, reports; alongside structured and tabular data. * Solid grounding in cloud services title: Staff Frontend Engineer (Product UI and Design)
description: **About Lexsi Labs** Lexsi Labs is a frontier AI lab working toward aligned, interpretable and safe superintelligent systems. Our near-term mission is to build safety-aware autonomous systems for mission-critical settings such as banking, insurance, government and healthcare. We believe the institutions that deploy AI should be able to audit, correct and own the risk of the models they rely on, and we build the research and the platform that make that possible. Our research spans AI alignment methodologies, interpretability-led system design, and foundation model research across language, structured and tabular data, and autonomous systems. We have published 25+ papers in the past 15 months across conferences including ICLR, ICML, WWW, IJCNN, MICCAI and EurIPS. Our labs are in India (Mumbai and remote), Paris and London. We operate with a flat structure, high autonomy, and a strong bias toward engineers who take full ownership of what they build, from architecture to production behaviour. **About the Role** We are building the platform through which institutions own the AI they depend on. Post-training, alignment, evaluation, deployment and monitoring run inside the customer’s own environment, on the methods our labs publish. The people using it vary widely. Post-training scientists and AI researchers run experiments at the edge of what current methods can do. AI and ML engineers take models and agents into production. Data scientists build and validate models on enterprise data. Platform and infrastructure teams operate the compute and services underneath. Inside banks, insurers and public institutions, model risk, validation and audit teams need to understand and sign off on results without writing code, and business owners need to see what is running and how it is performing. The same screen often has to serve a researcher and a risk reviewer. The interface decides whether frontier model science stays in research papers or becomes something every institution can operate. This is a hands-on individual contributor role. You will write production React and TypeScript most of the week, own the frontend architecture of the platform, and make the final call on its flows, information architecture and visual design. You will work with a product designer and one or two frontend engineers, setting the standard through code and review rather than management. Expect roughly 70% of your time on building and 30% on design decisions, review and direction. **What you’ll work on** * Own the frontend architecture of a large React and TypeScript application: routing and layout, code splitting, state boundaries, and the contracts between the UI and backend services. * Own the component library and design tokens as a single system used across the application, evolving it incrementally in a live codebase without pausing feature work. * Design and build data-dense interfaces: virtualised tables over large result sets, live metrics and log streams, trace and graph visualisations, side-by-side comparisons, and code and configuration editors. * Build a real-time data layer over SSE and WebSockets with reconnection, backpressure and cache semantics that stay consistent with request-response queries. * Build schema-driven form systems for deeply nested, conditional configuration, validated against backend schemas. * Design interfaces that work for users with very different levels of technical depth, from researchers to risk reviewers, without splitting the product in two. * Make the final call on information architecture, interaction and visual design, and take your decisions from Figma to production yourself. * Set and enforce performance budgets: render profiling, bundle size, and interaction latency on locked-down enterprise machines. * Ship builds that run in restricted and fully offline networks, with reproducible builds, self-hosted assets and no runtime dependence on external hosts. * Meet enterprise requirements in the UI: SSO, role-aware interfaces, auditability, accessibility, and internationalisation including right-to-left layouts. * Raise the engineering bar across the frontend: type safety, testing strategy, tooling and code review. * Work directly with researchers and platform engineers to turn new methods into usable product, often before the method has settled. **You may be a good fit if you have** * 8+ years building production web applications, including several years as the technical lead on a complex product UI. * Expert-level TypeScript and React, including React 19 rendering and concurrency behaviour and hands-on performance profiling. * Owned the architecture of a large frontend codebase and improved it materially while the team kept shipping. * Led an incremental migration in a live application, such as a component library, state management approach, router or build system. * Built interfaces where performance was the hard problem: tens of thousands of rows, high-frequency streaming updates, large JSON or log payloads, or complex interactive charts. * Deep, practical experience with TanStack Query or equivalent, Tailwind CSS, React Hook Form with Zod, Vite and pnpm. * Built or maintained a design system with tokens, theming, accessibility to WCAG standards and documentation in Storybook. * Designed and shipped product yourself, with a portfolio that shows both the decisions you made and the code that implemented them. * Built for multiple user types with different expertise in the same product, and made it work for each of them. * A testing discipline built on Vitest or Jest, Playwright and API mocking. * Worked without a product manager or a full spec, decided what to build, and defended the decision with evidence. * Clear written and verbal communication of trade-offs to engineers, researchers and leadership. **Strong candidates may also have** * Built developer tools or ML tooling, such as experiment tracking, training dashboards, evaluation or observability products. * Visualisation depth with ECharts, D3, or canvas and WebGL rendering. * Built graph or trace viewers (React Flow or similar) and embedded code editors (CodeMirror or Monaco). * Shipped software into on-premise, regulated or air-gapped environments. * Built right-to-left and multi-locale products. * Used state machines such as XState for complex multi-step flows. * Instrumented frontends with OpenTelemetry and web vitals. * Shipped LLM-powered product features. * Contributed to open-source frontend libraries. If you meet most of this but not all, we would still like to hear from you. **What this role is not** * Not a people management role at the start. There are no direct reports, and influence comes through code, review and design decisions. * Not a visual design role. You will design, but you will be measured on what ships to production. * Not a ticket-implementation role. You will be expected to question specs and decide what should be built. **What we expect in the first six months** * Own a set of redesigned core flows end to end, from information architecture through to production. * Establish the component system and tokens as the single source of truth for the application. * Set performance budgets for the heaviest views and bring them within budget. * Put test coverage in place across the core flows. **How we will evaluate** * A review of shipped work where you can show both the design decisions and the code. * A build exercise on a data-dense screen, assessed on code quality, structure and performance. * A design critique of a flow in our product, where you decide what changes and why. * An architecture conversation on component systems, data and streaming layers, and offline deployment.

description: In most instances, this position requires in-person interviews as part of the hiring process. ### **Minimum qualifications:** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, a related field, or equivalent practical experience. * Experience programming in one or more programming languages. * Experience working with administration (e.g., filesystems, inodes, system calls) or networking (e.g., TCP/IP, routing, network topologies and hardware, SDN). ### **Preferred qualifications:** * Master's degree in Computer Science or Engineering. * Experience in Unix/Linux systems, IP networking, performance, and application issues. * Experience with problem solving and analyzing enterprise systems. * Experience navigating enterprise software, deployment, and management of workloads on Cloud. * Experience in an engineering or operations role within enterprise applications or other enterprise spaces. **About the job** ----------------- *Hope is not a strategy. Engineering solutions to design, build, and maintain efficient large-scale systems is a true strategy, and a good one.* Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) is an engineering discipline that combines software and systems engineering to build and run large-scale, massively distributed, fault-tolerant systems. SRE ensures that Google's services—both our internally critical and our externally-visible systems—have reliability and uptime appropriate to users' needs and a fast rate of improvement while keeping an ever-watchful eye on capacity and performance. SRE is also a mindset and a set of engineering approaches to running better production systems—we build our own creative engineering solutions to operations problems. Much of our software development focuses on optimizing existing systems, building infrastructure and eliminating work through automation. As SREs are responsible for the big picture of how our systems relate to each other, we use a breadth of tools and approaches to solve a broad spectrum of problems. Practices such as limiting time spent on operational work, blameless postmortems and proactive identification of potential outages factor into iterative improvement that is key to both product quality and interesting and dynamic day-to-day work. SRE's culture of diversity, intellectual curiosity, problem solving and openness is key to its success. Our organization brings together people with a wide variety of backgrounds, experiences and perspectives. We encourage them to collaborate, think big and take risks in a blame-free environment. We promote self-direction to work on meaningful projects, while we also strive to create an environment that provides the support and mentorship needed to learn and grow. To learn more: * Check out *Site Reliability Engineering*, written by Google SREs. * Watch a recorded Hangout on Air to meet some of our SREs. * Read a career profile about why a software engineer chose to join SRE. Behind everything our users see online is the architecture built by the Technical Infrastructure team to keep it running. From developing and maintaining our data centers to building the next generation of Google platforms, we make Google's product portfolio possible. We're proud to be our engineers' engineers and love voiding warranties by taking things apart so we can rebuild them. We keep our networks up and running, ensuring our users have the best and fastest experience possible. **Responsibilities** -------------------- * Collaborate to support Corp Engineering services, and build relationships with business partners. * Drive technical interactions with business partners to come up with innovative ideas for improving reliability for enterprise applications. * Leverage Google SRE reliability strategies to span GCP and the Google stack, and reduce the operational work. * Work with other engineering teams to ensure that the infrastructure is reliable, scalable, and secure, and participate in the team's on-call rotation. title: Technical Product Owner
description: Hiring: AI-Native Technical Product Owner & Agentic Systems Engineer **Company:** RoamYoo **Employment Type:** Full-Time **Experience:** 3–7 years preferred; exceptional builders with demonstrable production experience are welcome About RoamYoo RoamYoo is building an AI-powered, social-meets-marketplace travel platform that connects travellers with verified local hosts, authentic experiences, group trips, stays, transport, and community-driven travel opportunities. We are looking for a highly capable, technology-driven professional who can take ownership of multiple applications, manage the complete product lifecycle, build AI-powered systems, automate engineering workflows, and ensure that every application is reliable, secure, scalable, and production-ready. This is not a conventional Product Owner role focused on meetings, documentation, and task management. We need a **hands-on technical owner who can think like a product manager, build like an engineer, automate like a DevOps specialist, and troubleshoot like a production engineer.** Role Overview You will own the complete lifecycle of multiple digital products and applications, from requirements and architecture to development, testing, deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement. You must understand how modern AI coding tools, agentic workflows, APIs, databases, cloud infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, and automation systems work together to deliver production-grade applications. You will be expected to work independently, identify technical and product problems, implement solutions, coordinate with other developers when required, and take accountability for outcomes rather than simply completing assigned tasks. Key Responsibilities1. Product Ownership & Application Management * Own multiple web applications, mobile applications, internal tools, admin panels, and AI-powered products. * Convert business requirements into product specifications, user stories, technical tasks, and acceptance criteria. * Manage product roadmaps, sprint priorities, backlogs, releases, and dependencies. * Understand user journeys, business logic, database relationships, API integrations, and application architecture. * Coordinate product development from initial prototype to MVP and production release. * Identify bottlenecks, technical debt, performance issues, and opportunities for automation. * Maintain product documentation, system diagrams, API documentation, release notes, and operational runbooks. * Ensure applications remain functional as requirements, users, integrations, and business processes evolve. 2. Agentic AI Systems & AI Engineering * Design, implement, and maintain agentic AI workflows that can plan, execute tasks, use tools, and validate outcomes. * Build multi-agent systems where appropriate, including orchestration, delegation, state management, retries, and human approval checkpoints. * Work with LLM APIs, structured outputs, function calling, tool use, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and embeddings. * Understand agent memory, context management, evaluation, guardrails, and failure recovery. * Integrate AI agents with databases, internal applications, third-party APIs, browser tools, and business workflows. * Develop reliable workflows rather than depending on unstructured prompts alone. * Implement observability, tracing, evaluation datasets, token and latency monitoring, and cost controls. * Know when to use a deterministic workflow instead of an autonomous agent. **Relevant technologies:** OpenAI APIs, Anthropic APIs, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, LangChain, MCP, vector databases, and other relevant agent orchestration frameworks. 3. AI-Assisted & Agentic Software Development * Work effectively with Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, Cursor, VS Code, and other AI-assisted development environments. * Use AI coding agents for implementation, debugging, refactoring, test generation, code review, and documentation. * Create reusable project instructions, coding standards, agent skills, tool integrations, and repeatable development workflows. * Design multi-step coding workflows with planning, implementation, testing, review, and validation. * Understand the code being generated rather than blindly accepting AI-generated output. * Review AI-generated code for security vulnerabilities, incorrect business logic, performance problems, and maintainability. * Use Git-based version control, pull requests, branch protection, and code review practices. * Establish a repeatable workflow for moving from an idea or prompt to tested, deployable software. 4. Full-Stack Development & System Architecture * Understand and work across frontend, backend, databases, APIs, authentication, infrastructure, and integrations. * Build and maintain responsive, accessible, and performant user interfaces. * Design REST APIs and understand GraphQL where appropriate. * Implement authentication, role-based access control, permissions, session management, and secure data handling. * Design database schemas, migrations, indexes, relationships, transactions, and query optimization. * Integrate payment gateways, messaging systems, maps, analytics, AI services, and third-party platforms. * Understand modular monoliths, microservices, event-driven systems, background jobs, and asynchronous processing. * Diagnose issues across the entire stack instead of treating frontend and backend as isolated components. **Preferred technologies:** TypeScript, JavaScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, Python, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, Redis, Supabase, and other equivalent production-grade technologies. 5. Automated Deployment & DevOps * Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for automated testing, builds, deployments, and release verification. * Configure development, staging, and production environments. * Manage environment variables, secrets, configuration, and database migrations safely. * Work with GitHub Actions, Docker, cloud hosting, managed databases, and deployment platforms. * Automate build validation, linting, type checks, test execution, security scanning, and release workflows. * Implement deployment verification, health checks, rollback procedures, and recovery plans. * Understand containerization, infrastructure configuration, networking, logs, and application runtime environments. * Manage production releases with minimal downtime and controlled risk. * Troubleshoot failed deployments, dependency conflicts, build errors, server issues, and environment-specific bugs. **Relevant tools:** GitHub Actions, Docker, Vercel, AWS, GCP, Azure, Railway, Render, Supabase, and Terraform or equivalent infrastructure-as-code tools. 6. Quality Assurance & Production Readiness * Build a reliable testing strategy covering unit, integration, API, end-to-end, and regression testing. * Use tools such as Playwright, Vitest, Jest, or equivalent frameworks. * Verify critical business flows before releases, including authentication, payments, bookings, notifications, and admin operations. * Identify race conditions, edge cases, inconsistent data, permission errors, and failure scenarios. * Implement structured logging, error tracking, uptime monitoring, and application performance monitoring. * Use tools such as Sentry, OpenTelemetry, and cloud-native monitoring solutions. * Establish production-readiness checklists, incident response procedures, backup policies, and disaster recovery practices. * Ensure that an application is not considered complete merely because it works on a developer's machine. 7. Security, Reliability & Scalability * Apply secure coding practices and follow relevant OWASP guidance. * Prevent common vulnerabilities such as injection, broken access control, exposed secrets, and insecure API endpoints. * Protect user data and implement appropriate authorization, validation, rate limiting, and audit logging. * Understand secure authentication flows, password handling, OAuth, and token management. * Manage database backups, recovery procedures, dependency vulnerabilities, and access permissions. * Identify scalability bottlenecks and optimize database queries, API response times, caching, and background processing. * Establish sensible controls for AI tool permissions, prompt injection, sensitive data exposure, and unsafe agent actions. 8. Technical Documentation & Engineering Operations * Maintain a clear inventory of all applications, repositories, environments, domains, integrations, and deployment pipelines. * Document architecture, setup instructions, environment configuration, dependencies, and troubleshooting procedures. * Track technical debt, recurring production issues, service dependencies, and infrastructure costs. * Create reusable templates and standards so new applications can be launched consistently. * Ensure that no critical system depends entirely on undocumented knowledge held by one individual. Required Technical Skills Candidates must be able to demonstrate practical competence in the following areas: * **Product engineering:** Requirements gathering, feature prioritization, user stories, acceptance criteria, release planning, and product lifecycle ownership. * **Programming:** Strong proficiency in at least one production-grade language, preferably TypeScript or Python. * **Full-stack fundamentals:** Frontend, backend, REST APIs, authentication, databases, and integrations. * **Agentic AI:** LLM integration, tool calling, agent orchestration, structured outputs, workflow reliability, and evaluation. * **AI development tools:** Practical experience with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, or comparable AI coding agents. * **Version control:** Git, GitHub, branching strategies, pull requests, and code review. * **CI/CD:** Automated pipelines, build checks, deployment automation, release verification, and rollback. * **Cloud and infrastructure:** Practical experience deploying and operating real applications. * **Testing:** Automated unit, integration, and end-to-end testing. * **Production operations:** Logs, monitoring, incident diagnosis, backups, performance, and reliability. * **Security:** Secrets management, authorization, secure API design, and dependency management. * **Technical communication:** Ability to explain architecture, trade-offs, risks, and implementation decisions clearly. Preferred Qualifications * Experience managing or maintaining multiple production applications. * Experience building and deploying AI-powered products or agentic workflows. * Familiarity with MCP servers, reusable agent skills, and tool integrations. * Experience with Supabase, PostgreSQL, authentication systems, and database migrations. * Experience with payment gateways, third-party integrations, and webhook processing. * Understanding of queues, scheduled jobs, event-driven workflows, and distributed system fundamentals. * Experience with observability, cloud cost optimization, and infrastructure automation. * Familiarity with travel technology, marketplaces, booking systems, SaaS products, or consumer applications. * Experience working in a startup environment with limited resources and high ownership expectations. What We Expect From You * Take ownership from problem identification to verified resolution. * Build and maintain systems instead of relying entirely on other developers or external agencies. * Make informed decisions about when to code manually, use AI agents, or automate a workflow. * Prioritize reliability, security, maintainability, and business value over impressive demos. * Move quickly without compromising essential engineering standards. * Work independently, communicate blockers early, and document critical decisions. * Be comfortable operating in an environment where product requirements and priorities evolve. * Treat the product as something you are responsible for building and improving, not merely a list of assigned tickets. First 90-Day Success Criteria **First 30 days — Understand and stabilize** * Audit existing applications, repositories, infrastructure, integrations, and deployment processes. * Identify critical bugs, security gaps, undocumented dependencies, and operational risks. * Create an application inventory, architecture overview, and prioritized improvement roadmap. **Days 31–60 — Automate and improve** * Establish reliable CI/CD workflows for priority applications. * Improve automated testing, monitoring, error reporting, and release procedures. * Build or improve at least one meaningful AI-powered workflow or agentic automation. * Document setup, deployment, rollback, and recovery processes. **Days 61–90 — Deliver and scale** * Independently deliver a production-ready feature or application improvement. * Demonstrate repeatable, tested deployments with appropriate release safeguards. * Establish measurable engineering KPIs, including deployment success, escaped defects, recovery time, and release lead time. * Present a technical roadmap covering scalability, security, AI automation, reliability, and engineering efficiency. Application Process Please share: * Your resume and LinkedIn profile. * GitHub profile, portfolio, or relevant technical projects. * One application you have taken from development to production. * One example of an AI agent or automation workflow you have built. * Your role in deployment automation, testing, monitoring, and production troubleshooting. * The AI coding tools, frameworks, cloud services, and development tools you use regularly. Candidates may be asked to complete a practical assessment covering application architecture, AI-assisted development, agentic workflows, debugging, automated deployment, and production-readiness decisions. **We are looking for builders who can take complete ownership of technology and turn ideas into dependable, production-ready products.** Pay: ₹519,000.00 - ₹630,000.00 per year Application Question(s): * What kind of end to product you have handled * Define product ownership to you, as core skills and expertise you should have. * Define product ownership role to you, as core skills and expertise you dont have. Work Location: Remote

& quality: Improve Core Web Vitals, bundle size, rendering performance, accessibility, and reliability. * Mentorship & technical leadership: Guide engineers through reviews, pairing, best practices, and incident learnings. * AI-enabled engineering: Use AI tools to speed up coding, refactoring, test generation, debugging, and documentation while maintaining strong engineering judgment. * Cross-functional collaboration: Partner with Product, Design, Backend, and QA to deliver cohesive experiences. * Operational excellence: Champion observability (logging, metrics), release hygiene, and safe rollout strategies. **Required Skills & Qualifications:** * 8+ years of frontend engineering experience with strong hands-on coding in production systems. * Strong expertise in Angular (v14+) * Solid experience with PrimeNG (or similar enterprise UI frameworks) and building reusable UI components. * Strong knowledge of TypeScript, modern JavaScript, HTML5, CSS/SCSS, and responsive design. * Deep understanding of SPA architecture: routing, state management, API patterns, caching, error handling. * Experience with state management (e.g., NGXS/NGRX/Redux/Zustand) and reactive patterns (RxJS). * Strong engineering fundamentals: data structures, debugging, code reviews, maintainability. * Proven ability to lead technical decisions and influence without authority. * At least 1 year of deep usage experience in generating UI of higher quality using tools such as Cursor. * Ability to estimate features and meet delivery timelines. **Preferred Skills & Qualifications:** * Experience with micro-frontends / Module Federation, monorepos (Nx), or shared UI libraries. * Familiarity with charts/visualization (AMCharts, D3, etc.). * Strong accessibility (WCAG) and i18n experience. * Testing expertise: Jest/Vitest, React Testing Library, Cypress/Playwright. * CI/CD experience for frontend builds and deployments. **AI Tools & Engineering Workflow:** * Comfortable using tools such as GitHub Copilot, Cursor, ChatGPT, code search/refactoring assistants, and test-generation helpers. * Ability to validate AI outputs with strong judgment: security, correctness, performance, and maintainability. * Establish team guidelines for safe and effective AI usage (prompting patterns, review standards). **Success Metrics (First 90 Days):** * Stabilize and improve key UI areas: performance, reliability, developer experience. * Deliver at least 1–2 major features hands-on, end-to-end. * Introduce or refine reusable UI patterns/components and raise code quality through reviews and mentorship. * Improve build/test speed and establish practical AI-assisted workflows. **Diversity & Inclusion Statement:** We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive team and encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply. About Us: SymphonyAI is building the leading enterprise AI SaaS company for digital transformation across the most critical and resilient growth industries, including retail, consumer packaged goods, financial crime prevention, manufacturing, media, and IT service management. Since its founding in 2017, SymphonyAI today serves 1500+ Enterprise customers globally and has grown to 3,000 talented leaders, data scientists, and other professionals across over 30 countries.

title: AI/ML Engineer
description: **AI Engineer** **Location:** Remote. Shift Timing: -5PM-2AM **Role Summary** We are hiring a senior Developer for AI Development & Engineering to design, build, and operate production AI systems end to end. You will work across the full AI stack: classical machine learning, deep learning, and modern generative AI (LLMs, RAG, and agentic workflows). You will turn ambiguous business problems into AI capabilities our users trust, taking ownership from data through deployment, monitoring, and iteration. Our developers work fluidly across AI-assisted coding (Claude Code, Cursor) and traditional manual coding, deploying onto Azure with Git-based workflows and CI/CD. We expect strong software engineering instincts, comfort with experimentation, and a bias toward making AI systems observable, evaluable, and safe in production. Key Responsibilities * Design, train, evaluate, and ship machine learning and deep learning models (classification, regression, ranking, vision, NLP, time series) against well-defined business and scientific problems. * Design and implement LLM-powered applications using major model providers (Claude/Anthropic, Azure OpenAI, OpenAI, or equivalents). * Build retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems, including chunking strategies, embeddings, vector store selection (e.g., Azure AI Search, pgvector), and re-ranking. * Develop agentic workflows with tool use and orchestration; implement guardrails, evaluation harnesses, and human-in-the-loop reviews were appropriate. * Apply prompt engineering, fine-tuning, and structured output techniques; measure quality with offline evals and online metrics. * Build and maintain robust data and feature pipelines on Azure; ensure data quality, lineage, and reproducibility. * Productionize models with sound MLOps practices: versioning, automated retraining, drift detection, and rollback strategies. * Use AI coding assistants (Claude Code, Cursor) effectively alongside traditional manual coding methods, choosing the right approach for each task and reviewing AI-generated code with rigor. * Manage source code in Git using a clean branching strategy and pull-request-based review. * Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines (e.g., Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions) for automated testing, packaging, and deployment of AI services. * Deploy and operate services on Azure using containers (Docker), orchestration (Kubernetes/AKS), and infrastructure-as-code (Terraform or Bicep). * Instrument AI systems with logging, tracing, and evaluation pipelines so that quality, latency, and cost can be observed and managed over time. * Partner with security and compliance to address data privacy, PHI/PII handling, prompt injection, and model risk in regulated contexts. * Work directly with product, scientific, and business stakeholders to scope problems, set realistic expectations, and choose the right level of AI sophistication for the job. * Mentor engineers on AI-assisted development practices and on the patterns and pitfalls of LLM-based systems. * Conduct rigorous design and code reviews; advocate for evaluation, safety, and observability as first-class concerns. Required Qualifications * Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, Machine Learning, Data Science, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related field — or equivalent practical experience. * 4 + years of professional software engineering experience, with at least 2 years building and shipping ML or AI systems in production. * Strong proficiency in Python and core ML libraries (PyTorch and/or TensorFlow, scikit-learn, pandas, NumPy). * Hands-on experience deploying LLM-based applications using major model providers (Anthropic Claude, Azure OpenAI, OpenAI, or open-source models). * Practical RAG and embedding experience, including at least one production vector store. * Demonstrated proficiency with AI coding tools such as Claude Code and Cursor, balanced with strong manual coding fundamentals. * Solid command of Git, branching strategies, and pull-request-based code review. * Hands-on experience building and operating CI/CD pipelines (e.g., Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions) for production workloads. * Hands-on experience deploying services on Azure (AKS, App Service, Functions, Azure AI/ML services, or similar) and with containerization (Docker). * Strong written and verbal communication; able to explain modeling decisions and trade-offs to non-technical stakeholders. * Proven ability to thrive in a fully remote, globally distributed team.

description: **AI/ML Scientist / Engineer — LLM Post-Training** **Sahai | eGovernments Foundation** **About Sahai** Sahai is an initiative backed by the **eGovernments Foundation** , building an AI triage system and clinician co-pilot to expand primary healthcare access across rural India. Through voice-based conversations, Sahai gathers patient histories and prepares differential diagnoses and draft care recommendations for qualified doctors to review. We are developing open-weight models suited to Indian primary care, supported by clinical data, safety controls, and rigorous evaluation. **The AI recommends. The doctor decides.** **The Role** We are looking for a hands-on AI/ML Scientist / Engineer to develop and validate a **proof-of-concept model** for clinical interviewing and diagnostic decision support. The challenge goes beyond teaching models medical facts. It involves improving their ability to conduct useful multi-turn patient interviews, work with clinical tools, and reason with incomplete information. You will collaborate with clinicians, data specialists, and engineers to design experiments, post-train candidate models, and establish what works. **This role focuses on model research and development, not production deployment or operational infrastructure.** **What You Will Do** * **Post-training and alignment:** Design and run experiments using supervised fine-tuning, reinforcement learning, preference optimization, and reward design. * **Agentic model development:** Improve language models for sequential patient interactions and tool-augmented clinical workflows. * **Knowledge distillation:** Explore transferring capabilities from larger teacher models into smaller, computationally efficient models. * **Training data and simulation:** Partner with clinical and data teams to develop curated datasets, synthetic conversations, and patient-simulation environments. * **Rigorous evaluation:** Compare models and approaches through reproducible experiments, automated assessments, and clinical review. * **India-specific adaptation:** Investigate adaptation to the communication patterns, languages, and resource constraints of Indian primary care. * **Research handover:** Deliver model checkpoints, experimental code, evaluation results, and clear documentation of findings, limitations, and recommended next steps. **What You Bring** * A strong research or industry background in machine learning, with hands-on ownership of substantial model-development work. * Demonstrated experience **post-training open-weight LLMs** , beyond prompting or integrating model APIs. * Practical experience with **reinforcement learning or preference optimization for LLMs** , including reward design, alongside supervised fine-tuning. * Strong Python skills and proficiency in **PyTorch or JAX/Flax** . * Experience running and debugging GPU-based training experiments, with an understanding of compute and memory constraints. * Sound judgment in data curation, experimental design, and model evaluation. * The ability to read research critically, implement promising methods, and test whether they work in practice. We value demonstrated technical depth and experimental rigor more than familiarity with a long list of tools. Prior production-deployment experience is not required. **Especially Valuable** * Experience with knowledge distillation, smaller language models, or model compression. * Work on multi-turn agents, simulated environments, or multi-agent evaluation. * Experience with distributed training. * Work in healthcare AI or another safety-critical domain. * Experience with multilingual or Indic-language models. * Relevant publications, open-source contributions, or substantial independent projects. A medical background is not required. Respect for clinical expertise and responsible handling of sensitive data are essential. Speech-model training is not the primary focus of this role. **What Success Looks Like** An evaluated proof of concept that demonstrates measurable improvements over a baseline, supported by reproducible experiments and an honest account of its limitations. The work should help Sahai decide which approaches merit further development; production readiness is not the expected outcome. **Why Sahai** Apply advanced AI research to a concrete public-health challenge. Help establish the model capabilities that could bring qualified medical judgment within reach of underserved communities.
