title: Artificial Intelligence Engineer
description: Role Overview We are looking for an AI Engineer with strong AI/ML, GenAI and agentic systems expertise to build and productionize next-generation AI systems. This role is for someone who goes beyond using frameworks: someone who understands how models, retrieval systems and agents work internally, can design the architecture and orchestration around them, evaluate them rigorously, and take a prototype all the way to a scalable, reliable, production-grade system. The candidate will lead the following workstreams: 1. AI/ML & Multimodal AI • Strong first-principles understanding of Machine Learning, Deep Learning and Computer Vision • Deep understanding of LLMs and Vision-Language Models (VLMs): tokenization/encoding, vision and language representations, multimodal alignment and how semantic information is fused • SFT for LLMs/VLMs, PEFT/LoRA and fine-tuning strategies, including fine-tuning for tool use, function calling and structured outputs • Model optimization: quantization (AWQ, INT4, HQQ), distillation, batching and inference optimization • vLLM and high-performance model serving, including guided/constrained decoding and serving models behind agent workloads • Reward modelling, custom/verifiable rewards, DPO, RLHF and GRPO, including reinforcement learning on multi-step, tool-using agent trajectories • Hands-on experience with PyTorch, Hugging Face Transformers and TRL 2. RAG, Retrieval & Knowledge Systems • Build advanced RAG / GraphRAG / VisionRAG systems, including agentic RAG where an agent plans, routes and iterates over retrieval steps • Retrieval and ranking: BM25, semantic retrieval, hybrid search, re-ranking (cross-encoders, LLM re-rankers) and vector databases • Understand and implement RRF, MRR, Recall, Precision, F1, RAGAS and other retrieval evaluation approaches • Query optimization using HyDE, query expansion, decomposition and rewriting • Document ingestion and chunking strategies for text, tables, images and scanned/handwritten documents • Knowledge graph construction and entity/relationship extraction to power GraphRAG • Expose retrieval and knowledge stores as reusable tools and MCP servers that agents can call 3. Agentic Systems & Orchestration Design, build and run reliable single- and multi-agent systems that plan, use tools and complete multi-step business workflows in production. Agent architecture and design patterns • Judge when a problem needs an autonomous agent versus a deterministic workflow or a simple LLM call, and design accordingly • Single- and multi-agent patterns: ReAct, plan-and-execute, router, orchestrator–worker, supervisor/hierarchical, handoff/swarm and evaluator–optimizer (reflection, self-critique) • Task decomposition, planning and reasoning strategies, including effective use of reasoning models and extended thinking • Long running and asynchronous agents, background tasks and agents that operate over hours or days Orchestration frameworks and runtimes • Hands-on with LangGraph (state graphs, checkpointing, interrupts, sub-graphs) and at least one of CrewAI, AutoGen/AG2, OpenAI Agents SDK, Claude Agent SDK, Google ADK, Agno or equivalent • Durable execution and workflow engines (Temporal or equivalent) for retries, resumability and exactly once side effects • Coding, browser and computer-use agents, with sandboxed code execution Tools, protocols and context engineering • Build and consume MCP servers and clients: tools, resources and prompts; stdio and Streamable HTTP transports; authentication and authorization • Agent-to-agent communication using A2A or equivalent protocols • Tool design: clear tool descriptions, schemas, idempotent tools, timeouts, retries, fallbacks and error recovery • Structured output generation, schema validation (Pydantic/JSON Schema) and reliable tool execution • Context engineering: what goes into the context window and when, dynamic tool selection, prompt caching, summarization and compaction for long sessions State and memory • Short-term/working memory and agent state management across steps and sessions • Long-term memory (episodic, semantic, procedural), memory stores and retrieval of past interactions • State persistence, checkpointing and resume-after-failure Human-in-the-loop, guardrails and safety • Approval gates, interrupt-and-resume, escalation to humans and confidence-based routing • Input/output guardrails, prompt-injection defense, PII handling and policy enforcement • Least-privilege tool permissions, sandboxing, and controls on cost, step count and runaway loops Agent evaluation and observability • Evaluate agents end to end: task success rate, trajectory quality, tool-call accuracy, step efficiency, cost and latency per task • LLM-as-judge, simulated users and environments, and regression suites for agent behaviour • Tracing and observability with Open Telemetry, LangSmith, Langfuse, Arize Phoenix or equivalent; root-cause analysis of agent failures Scaling agents in production • Model routing and fallbacks across providers, rate-limit handling and cost optimization • Concurrency, queue-based agent execution and multi-tenant isolation 4. Hands-on model training experience is not mandatory, but the candidate should understand how AI services are integrated, orchestrated and scaled within a production platform. Databases & Data Architecture Strong hands-on experience with: \* PostgreSQL \* MySQL \* MongoDB \* Redis The candidate should understand: \* Database schema and data modelling \* SQL and query optimization \* Indexing and performance tuning \* Transactions and concurrency \* Database scaling and replication \* Caching strategies \* Relational vs NoSQL architecture decisions Microservices & Distributed Systems \* Strong understanding of microservice architecture and distributed systems. \* Experience defining service boundaries and communication patterns. \* Experience with asynchronous/event-driven architecture. \* Exposure to technologies such as Kafka, RabbitMQ, SQS, Pub/Sub or similar systems. \* Understanding of idempotency, retries, distributed transactions, fault tolerance and graceful degradation. \* Ability to identify when a microservice architecture is appropriate versus unnecessary complexity. Should understand: \* Payment gateway APIs \* Webhooks \* Subscription payments \* Recurring billing \* Payment reconciliation \* Refunds and cancellations \* Transaction states \* Failure and retry handling \* Secure payment workflows Experience building monetization systems for SaaS subscriptions, credits/tokens, usage-based billing or digital products will be a strong advantage. Cloud & DevOps Strong working knowledge of AWS and/or GCP, including relevant services across: \* Compute \* Storage \* Databases \* Networking \* Load balancing \* Queues \* Serverless infrastructure \* Monitoring and logging Hands-on exposure to: \* Docker \* Kubernetes \* CI/CD pipelines \* Git / GitHub / GitLab \* Infrastructure monitoring \* Production debugging The candidate is not expected to replace DevOps/SRE but should be capable of independently understanding and troubleshooting production infrastructure. Engineering Excellence As an SDE III, we expect the candidate to contribute beyond individual feature development. You will: \* Participate in architecture and system-design decisions. \* Conduct high-quality code reviews. \* Define coding and API standards. \* Identify technical debt and drive its resolution. \* Improve backend performance and reliability. \* Mentor junior and mid-level engineers. \* Troubleshoot complex production issues. \* Challenge weak technical approaches and propose scalable alternatives. \* Work closely with Product, AI, Frontend, DevOps, QA and Data teams. Security & Reliability Strong understanding of: \* OAuth / JWT \* Authentication and authorization \* RBAC \* API security \* Rate limiting \* Encryption \* Secrets management \* Data privacy \* Logging and audit trails \* OWASP fundamentals Experience designing systems for high availability, fault tolerance, disaster recovery and production observability is preferred. What We’re Looking For Must Have \* 6–9 years of backend/software engineering experience. \* Strong hands-on expertise in Node.js and TypeScript/JavaScript. \* Strong API and backend architecture fundamentals. \* Production experience with microservices and distributed systems. \* Strong knowledge of PostgreSQL/MySQL and MongoDB. \* Experience with AWS and/or GCP. \* Hands-on experience with Git and modern development workflows. \* Experience building systems that have operated at meaningful production scale. \* Strong debugging and problem-solving capabilities. \* Ability to independently own a service or major platform component. Strongly Preferred \* Previous experience building a SaaS platform. \* Experience with AI/GenAI products or AI API integrations. \* Payment gateway and subscription architecture experience. \* Redis and caching. \* Kafka/RabbitMQ or similar messaging infrastructure. \* Docker/Kubernetes. \* High-concurrency or high-transaction-volume platforms. Good to Have Experience working with: \* GenAI / LLM APIs \* AI inference infrastructure \* API gateways \* Vector databases \* WebSockets \* GraphQL \* Search infrastructure \* Media/video processing platforms \* CDN architecture \* Usage-based billing systems \* Observability platforms such as Grafana, Prometheus, Datadog or New Relic What Makes Someone Successful in This Role We are looking for an engineer who thinks like an owner, not someone who only executes tickets. How do we reduce latency and infrastructure cost? How should this service evolve over the next 2–3 years? If you enjoy building products from 0→1 and then scaling them from 1→100, this role will give you significant engineering ownership.**

title: Backend Engineer — Cladbe
description: **About Cladbe** **India sold over ₹6 lakh crore of new homes in its top seven cities, and most of it still runs on spreadsheets, WhatsApp threads and tools never built for real estate. Cladbe is building the operating system a real-estate developer runs the whole business on: every enquiry, site visit, booking, payment schedule and handover in one place. It connects to property.new, our marketplace built to show buyers every RERA-registered project in a city, checked and current.** **We're building toward commercial launch and hiring a Backend Engineer to join our core engineering team and build systems that stay fast and correct under heavy load.** **Where you'll work:** for the first few months, the core team builds together in Bareilly. After that, the whole team moves to Noida, where the role is based. **What you'll do** * Build the core APIs: stateless Node.js and TypeScript services that carry the business logic of the Cladbe OS. * Own data integrity: PostgreSQL is the source of truth and the final guard against a double sale; a Redis-compatible store serves live inventory and fast, short-lived holds in front of it. * Engineer for concurrency: locks, idempotency and retries that hold up on a launch day. * Build event-driven workflows: when a booking is confirmed, the payment schedule, demand letters and inventory updates follow automatically. Kafka carries the events; a workflow engine runs them. * Integrate with a licensed payment partner (RBI-regulated): booking and payment-status workflows, and reconciliation. Buyer money never sits with Cladbe; your code tracks it, never holds it. * Run what you build: deploy and tune services on Kubernetes, where resource efficiency matters. **The stack** * Node.js and TypeScript, PostgreSQL, a Redis-compatible store for caching and locks * Kafka as the event bus, plus a durable workflow engine * A graph database (experience is a plus) * Kubernetes, with tracing and metrics you'll own **Must have** * Node.js and TypeScript in production * PostgreSQL in production: transactions, isolation levels, row locking * Idempotent APIs and safe retries * At least one message queue or event bus in production * Debugging from logs, metrics and traces **Nice to have** * Graph databases * Redis-based distributed locks * Kubernetes in production * Payments or fintech experience **Why join us** **This is a rare chance to build the core of a new system for how India's homes are bought and sold, early enough that your decisions become its foundations. The problems are the kind good engineers enjoy: correctness under heavy load, numbers that must reconcile to the rupee, and systems that connect end to end. You'll work in a small team, close to the founder, where what you build ships and matters.** **If that sounds like your kind of work, apply.**

title: Cloud Engineer
description: **Role: Cloud Engineer** **OCI Platform and Infrastructure Automation** **Role Summary** We are building our managed services cloud platform as code, starting with Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI). As a Cloud Engineer, you will design, build, and maintain the automation that deploys and runs it: the network hub, shared services, customer connectivity, customer landing zones, and workloads up to and including servers, along with automated backup and disaster recovery. You will also provide Tier 2 support for customer environments already in production. Everything is delivered through infrastructure-as-code and CI/CD pipelines, with manual steps treated as defects to be automated away. The focus is cloud platform engineering and automation. Deep expertise in Oracle applications or databases is not required. **Key Responsibilities** Platform and Landing Zone Automation * Build and maintain OpenTofu modules for the managed services platform: network hub, shared services, and centralized security and logging. * Automate customer landing zone deployments following OCI best practices (such as the OCI CIS Landing Zone): compartments, IAM policies, tagging, budgets, and guardrails. * Automate customer connectivity into the platform: DRG, FastConnect, IPSec VPN, routing, and DNS. Security by Default * Build security controls into every deployment: least-privilege IAM, network segmentation, security lists and NSGs, Vault and key management, Cloud Guard, and Security Zones. * Implement policy-as-code checks in pipelines so non-compliant infrastructure is caught before it is deployed. Workload and Server Automation * Automate deployment of compute and servers end to end: images, instance configuration, block and file storage, load balancers, and OS bootstrap (cloud-init or similar). * Automate post-deployment configuration, patching, and agent installation for Linux and Windows servers with Ansible, run from the same pipelines as OpenTofu. Backup and Disaster Recovery Automation * Automate backup policies and cross-region replication for customer workloads. * Build and test automated DR plans (such as OCI Full Stack DR), including regular, repeatable DR testing. Customer Environment Support * Provide Tier 2 support for running customer environments: troubleshoot incidents, fulfill service requests, and execute changes following change management processes. * Bring existing customer environments in line with platform standards, automating fixes wherever possible. * Escalate complex issues to the Cloud Architect with clear findings and next steps. Pipelines and Engineering Practice * Deliver all changes through GitHub pull requests and CI/CD pipelines, with code review, automated validation, and versioned modules. * Write Python automation using the OCI SDK and REST APIs, including event-driven automation using OCI Events, Functions, and Notifications. * Write and maintain runbooks, knowledge base articles, and module documentation for the platform and customer environments you build and support, so Tier 1 engineers can operate them without escalating. * Work second shift with overlap for handoffs to the US team, and join the on-call rotation after onboarding. **Required Skills and Experience** * 4+ years in infrastructure or cloud engineering, including 2+ years hands-on in a major public cloud (OCI, Azure, or AWS). * Terraform or OpenTofu: writing reusable modules, managing remote state, and deploying through Git-based workflows. OpenTofu experience preferred; Terraform experience transfers directly. * Ansible for configuration management: writing playbooks and roles for Linux and Windows (or strong experience with a comparable tool such as Chef, Puppet, or PowerShell DSC). * Python automation: writing production-quality scripts and tools using cloud SDKs and REST APIs, including event-driven automation. * CI/CD pipelines and GitHub: repositories, pull request workflow, and GitHub Actions or equivalent. * Core cloud services in at least one major cloud: identity and access management, virtual networking, compute, block and object storage, load balancing, and key management. * Cloud landing zone concepts and best practices: account or tenancy structure, identity, networking, guardrails, and tagging. * Cloud networking: hub-spoke designs, VPN and private connectivity, routing, and DNS. * Solid, hands-on Linux and Windows Server administration: installation and configuration, patching, storage and file systems, networking, services, user and access management, Active Directory basics, and OS-level troubleshooting. * Experience supporting production environments: incident troubleshooting, service requests, and change execution. * Lifelong learner: self-driven to research, study documentation and training videos, and figure out unfamiliar technologies on the fly. * Sound judgment in handling customer data securely and working within compliance requirements such as SOC 2 and ISO 27001. * Clear written and spoken English; comfortable documenting work and collaborating with US-based team members. **Preferred Skills and Experience** * OCI hands-on experience (strongly preferred). Candidates with strong Azure or AWS backgrounds who are ready to ramp on OCI are encouraged to apply. * OCI CIS Landing Zone or other landing zone frameworks (Azure Landing Zones, AWS Control Tower). * Backup and DR automation, including OCI Full Stack DR or similar tools. * Image and bootstrap tooling such as Packer or cloud-init. * Policy-as-code tools such as OPA, Checkov, or tfsec. * Hands-on experience across more than one public cloud. * Additional scripting and configuration languages beyond Python, such as PowerShell, Bash, YAML, and JSON. * Practical experience using AI-assisted engineering tools. * Managed-services or MSP experience. * Certifications: OCI Architect Associate or Professional, OCI Networking Professional, AZ-104, AWS Solutions Architect Associate, or equivalent.

Priceliners are focused on being the best travel deal makers in the world, motivated by our passion to help everyone experience the moments that matter most in their lives. Whether it’s a dream vacation, your cousin’s graduation, or your best friend’s wedding - we make travel affordable and accessible to our customers. Our culture is unique and inspiring (that’s what our employees tell us). We’re a grown-up, startup. If you want to be part of something truly special, check us out! **Flexible work at Priceline** Priceline is following a hybrid working model, which includes two days onsite as determined by you and your manager (ideally selecting among Tuesday, Wednesday, or Thursday). On the remaining days, you can choose to be remote or in the office. **Perks & Benefits At Priceline** Our benefits are designed to support your health, wellbeing, and life inside and outside of work. Eligible Priceliners have access to: **Health & wellness coverage** including medical, dental, vision, and mental health resources **Generous time off** including PTO, holidays, a company-wide Priceline Pause reset week, and paid volunteer days **Work/life support** including the ability to work up to 4 weeks per year from anywhere, parental leave, dependent care and family support resources, Summer Fridays, and office perks like stocked kitchens and catered meals (varies by location) **Financial security programs** such as retirement plans with company contributions, life and disability coverage, and tax-advantaged accounts **Signature travel perks** including employee-only discounts on hotels and flights, VIP deals, and Big Deal Bucks credits **Additional perks & discounts** like travel and partner discounts, tuition support, legal support, and pet benefits **A people-first culture** with Employee Resource Groups (ERGs), social events, recognition programs, and service awards that help you connect, grow, and celebrate together *Specific benefits and programs vary by location.* **Inclusion is a Big Deal!** To be the best travel dealmakers in the world, we believe our team should reflect the broad range of customers and communities we serve. Our values of **Integrity, Partnership** , **Excellence** and **Change** underpin our purpose and set the standard for everything we do, every day. They go to the heart of who we are and guide our decision making and everyday actions. Working with us means that you will be part of a dynamic organisation of 25,000 people across 65 countries. However, we will value your individuality and enable you to bring your true self to work so you can help enrich our diverse workforce. We are proud to be an equal opportunities employer. This means that we do not discriminate on the basis of anyone’s race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital status, veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. title: Conversation AI Engineer
description: We are looking for a Conversation AI Specialist who builds agentic, process-aligned dialogue systems — not scripted chatbots. You will build the conversational intelligence layer of our advisor efficiency platform. It includes timely orchestration, intent reasoning, and LLM-powered assist systems that help advisors during complex customer interactions across chat, phone, and ecommerce. You will own the full conversation stack, from utterance to action. Key Responsibilities * Agentic Conversation Design: Architect and build the conversational layer of our prompt-based agentic platform — including intent detection, dialogue orchestration, and multi-step reasoning flows aligned to advisor workflows. * LLM Integration & Prompt Engineering: Design and maintain the prompt architecture that drives advisor-assist features — including context injection, tool-calling patterns, guardrails, and output validation. * Advisor Assist Systems: Build real-time AI tools that surface relevant knowledge, suggest responses, and guide advisors through commerce, subscription, and support interactions. * Process Mapping: Work with operations and product teams to deeply understand advisor business processes, then translate that understanding into conversation system design. * Evaluation & Quality: Define conversation quality metrics, build evaluation datasets from real interaction logs, and operate a continuous improvement loop for deployed systems. * Probabilistic Fallback Design: Design graceful degradation patterns — ensuring the system handles low-confidence states, ambiguous intents, and out-of-scope inputs without advisor disruption. * Cross-platform Delivery: Integrate conversational AI features throughout chat, phone, and ecommerce advisor surfaces — maintaining coherent behavior across channels. **Attitude & Approach We're Hiring For** Beyond technical skills, we are specifically hiring for three attitude shifts that define success in this role: * Process-aligned composition: you build conversation flows that mirror advisor operational workflows — not abstract dialogue trees disconnected from how work actually happens. * Probabilistic reasoning: you architect systems where intent is inferred, confidence is tracked, and ambiguity is handled gracefully rather than failing hard. * Data-driven iteration: you measure conversation quality with data, not intuition — defining metrics, curating evaluation sets, and iterating based on evidence. **Required Qualifications** * 3–5 years in conversational AI, NLP engineering, or LLM-based product development. * Experience building dialogue systems with real business process alignment, not just scripted flows. * Proficiency in Python and NLP tooling * Strong understanding of intent classification, entity extraction, and context management in stateful conversations. * Experience deploying conversational AI to production with real user traffic. * Ability to build for uncertainty — confidence scoring, fallback handling, human-in-the-loop blocking issue. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience building agentic systems with tool use, function calling, or multi-step LLM orchestration. description: **About the Company** Founded in 2013 by Arpit Jain (CEO), PubScale (formerly greedygame) is a leading ad-tech company that drives app growth and monetization. We have built a sustainable, profitable business for over 7 years without chasing vanity metrics. Having completed our 0→1 journey, we are now scaling rapidly through our 1→10 phase. As a Google Publishing Partner, we serve 100M+ daily ad impressions and support 5,000+ apps and games worldwide, delivering up to 75% revenue uplift. We are trusted by brands such as Amazon, Dream11, MPL, ShareChat, Treebo and MobiKwik, and by 1,000+ publishers across 20+ countries. **Our Products** **PubScale (our flagship product)** PubScale brings monetization, user acquisition, revenue uplift and business-growth analytics together in one place. • **Immersive Ads:** Native, non-intrusive ad formats with smart caching, priority loading and adaptive refresh. They deliver a better user experience and higher monetization, without annoying pop-ups. • **Offerwall:** A reward-based engagement layer that monetizes non-paying users through personalized, high-conversion tasks, driving eCPMs of up to $1,000 in Tier geographies and up to 3x more revenue in emerging markets. • **AdX & GROW** : Monetization through Google Ad Manager and premium demand partners, plus GROW, an AI-driven user acquisition engine with free credits and optimization support. **About the Role** As a Data Analyst at GreedyGame, you will analyze mobile advertising, user behavior and monetization metrics to support app growth and revenue platforms such as PubScale. You will be the person teams turn to when they ask, “What is the data telling us?” You will work with Product, Ad Ops, Sales and Engineering to track revenue, understand what drives it, and catch problems early, from a drop in fill rate to a spike in suspicious traffic. **What You'll Do** • Write SQL to pull and combine ad, app and revenue data, using window functions, CTEs and date-based rollups. • Build and maintain dashboards for key metrics such as revenue, eCPM, fill rate, CTR, installs and cost per install. • Analyze trends by country, platform, app and demand partner, and explain why a number moved. • Clean and explore data in Python (pandas and NumPy): handle missing values and duplicates, aggregate data and spot outliers. • Design and analyze A/B tests on ad placements, formats and pricing, and give a clear go/no go recommendation backed by numbers. • Flag unusual traffic or sudden changes in key metrics, and work with Ad Ops to investigate them. • Turn findings into short write-ups and recommendations that non-technical teams can act on. • Improve data quality by defining metrics consistently and documenting where each number comes from. **What We're Looking For** • Experience: 2–5 years in a data analyst or similar analytics role. • SQL (strong): Joins, GROUP BY, CTEs, window functions (RANK, LAG, running totals) and date logic. You write queries that stay correct when data is missing or duplicated. • Python for analysis: pandas and NumPy for filtering, groupby, pivot tables, handling missing values and exploratory data analysis (EDA). • Statistics: Means vs. medians, distributions and outliers, confidence intervals, p-values and A/B testing fundamentals, including common pitfalls such as multiple testing and skewed data. • Dashboards: Hands-on experience with at least one BI tool, such as Looker Studio, Tableau, Power BI or Metabase. • Problem solving: You break a vague question into clear steps and sanity-check your answer before sharing it. • Communication: You explain findings in plain language, with one clear chart and one clear recommendation. • Education: A degree in a quantitative field (engineering, statistics, mathematics, economics or computer science), or equivalent experience. **Nice to Have** • Experience in ad-tech, mobile apps, gaming or another high-volume digital business. • Familiarity with ad metrics and concepts: eCPM, fill rate, ARPDAU, mediation, programmatic auctions and invalid traffic. • Basic machine learning: regression and classification, train/test splits, overfitting and data leakage. • Experience with cloud data tools such as BigQuery, Redshift, Snowflake or Spark. **Why PubScale?** • Your analysis directly shapes revenue decisions for app developers around the world. • Hybrid work model: 3 days in our Bengaluru office and 2 days remote. • High ownership, visibility and direct collaboration with leadership. • A fast-paced startup environment where your work has a significant impact on business growth. • Competitive compensation, performance rewards and learning opportunities. • A collaborative culture focused on innovation, speed and execution.

At first, you will meet specialist teams, identify valuable use cases and build focused proofs of concept that demonstrate what data science and AI can do. As these relationships mature, you will help develop our ability to deliver data science and AI solutions across client projects, working with the wider data science team from discovery through implementation. Knowledge of energy would help, initiative, technical breadth and the ability to earn trust across disciplines are central to the role. **What You Will Do** * Meet colleagues across practice areas to understand their work, identify specific use cases and agree what a useful result would look like. * Initially, scope and demonstrate focused proofs of concept, choosing suitable methods from statistical analysis and forecasting to machine learning and language models. * Explain methods, limitations and potential value clearly to specialists and nontechnical colleagues. Use their feedback to improve the solution and build confidence in the team’s services. * Assess data quality, feasibility, privacy and delivery needs, and define the evidence needed to take a prototype further. * As demand grows, design and deliver data science and AI solutions across projects with the wider team, from modelling and evaluation to integration, documentation and adoption. Contribute to proposals and client presentations. * Establish reusable ways of working and help turn early demonstrations into a sustainable pipeline of well-defined client work. **What You Will Bring** * Hands-on experience in Python for analysis and modelling, including common data and machine learning libraries, ability to use SQL to extract, join and check data. * Sound grounding in statistics and machine learning, including regression or classification, forecasting, validation, baseline comparisons and appropriate performance measures. * Practical familiarity with using large language models in analysis or prototyping, including prompting, checking outputs against evidence and recognising privacy, accuracy and reliability risks. * Experience preparing imperfect data, building reproducible analyses and writing maintainable code with version control and testing. * Ability to take an ambiguous question from discovery to a working demonstration, explain assumptions and uncertainty, and judge whether a solution is worth developing for operational use. * Confidence working independently and engaging stakeholders across teams, clear written and spoken English for technical and nontechnical audiences. * A relevant degree or equivalent practical experience in a quantitative field. **Useful Additional Experience** * Experience in energy, utilities, climate or environmental policy, particularly applied analysis with domain experts. * Experience in consulting, public policy research or client-facing delivery, familiarity with cloud platforms, APIs, data pipelines or deployment. * Experience building AI agents or applications that connect language models to data and tools, such as retrieval-based systems. We can train someone with strong core skills. **How We Work** As the first data scientist in our India team, you will have the opportunity to shape how our established data science and AI services grow there. You will work alongside colleagues with a wide range of technical and subject expertise, tackle varied client challenges, and see promising ideas develop into project work. We will support your career development with ongoing training and opportunities to deepen both your technical and consulting skills. **Bot and Third-Party Applications** Please note that this application must be submitted directly by the applicant for consideration. Failure to do so may result in the application being excluded for consideration. Applicants needing an accommodation for disability or religious purposes in connection with the application process should contact Candidateaccommodation@icf.com for assistance. **Working at ICF** ICF is a global advisory and technology services provider, but we’re not your typical consultants. We combine unmatched expertise with cutting-edge technology to help clients solve their most complex challenges, navigate change, and shape the future. **Candidate AI Usage Policy** At ICF, we are committed to ensuring a fair and equitable interview process for all candidates based on their own skills and knowledge. As part of this commitment, the use of artificial intelligence (AI) tools to generate or assist with responses during interviews (whether in-person or virtual) is not permitted. This policy is in place to maintain the integrity and authenticity of the interview process. However, we understand that some candidates may require accommodations that involve the use of AI. If such an accommodation is needed, candidates are instructed to contact us in advance at candidateaccommodation@icf.com. We are dedicated to providing the necessary support to ensure that all candidates have an equal opportunity to succeed. New Delhi, India (II77)

Production-Grade Engineering & MLOps 4. Problem Solving & Root Cause Analysis 5. Business Problem Framing 6. Stakeholder Communication & Data Storytelling 7. Attention to Detail & Reproducibility 8. Collaboration & Ownership **Why join us?** 1. Build ML that runs on loyaltyprograms serving 400+ million members 2. Own models end to end, from research through production 3. title: Data Scientist
description: **Job Title:** Data Scientist **Experience:** 3 to 6 years of relevant data science experience **About the Job:** We are looking for Data Scientists who can independently own a modelling workstream and deliver practical improvements to Tonik's lending decisions. Depending on allocation, you will work on cash or installment-loan underwriting, behavioural and offer scores, collections, payroll-backed lending, fraud, offer propensity or income prediction. You will develop and validate models, investigate performance changes and work with MLE to bring approved models into production. The team is moving toward risk-based refreshes, generally every three to six months for established scorecards, supported by timely monitoring and stronger development discipline. **Job Responsibilities:** * Own assigned modelling workstreams from business problem definition and data preparation through feature engineering, model development, validation and production handover. Agree the target, population, success measures and delivery plan with stakeholders. * Build features from application, demographic, bureau, device, event, transaction, repayment and alternative data. Use Python and SQL to create reproducible datasets and verify joins, missing values, timestamps and customer or loan identifiers. * Develop and compare scorecards and machine learning models using appropriate statistical and gradient boosting methods. Evaluate component scores, stacked models and segment-specific challengers against credible baselines. * Design temporal and out-of-time validation, prevent target leakage, and ensure repayment outcomes have matured. Identify distortions caused by restructuring, account freezes, approval policy changes or changing collection strategies. * Evaluate discrimination, calibration, stability and segment performance using Gini, KS, PSI, CSI and relevant business measures. For the assigned use case, relate model performance to credit losses, recoveries, attrition, offer uptake or prediction error. * Investigate deterioration and recommend an evidence-based response, including correcting data defects, recalibrating, retraining or redeveloping a model. Explain the effects of changing customer populations and business policies. * Execute planned refreshes and respond to priority risk issues. Maintain model documentation, feature specifications, validation results and reproducible experiments so the work can be reviewed and repeated. * Partner with MLE on feature and inference contracts, test cases and pre-release score reconciliation. Support user acceptance testing and post-release checks for real-time underwriting and batch scoring workflows. * Define monitoring requirements with the DAnR dashboard developer and Risk teams, including cohort definitions, maturity rules, thresholds and segment views. Work with the Data Program Manager on vendor data issues and new-source backtests. * Participate in code and model reviews, seek technical challenge from Lead Data Scientists, and communicate progress, blockers and findings proactively across Chennai, Manila and Singapore. * Adhere to model-governance and regulatory documentation standards for every model you build or refresh. **Required Experience and Qualifications:** * 3 to 6 years of hands-on data science experience, including practical experience developing credit risk or lending models in a bank, fintech, NBFC or a business delivering lending analytics. * A bachelor's or master's degree in statistics, mathematics, computer science, data science, engineering or a related quantitative discipline. * Strong Python and SQL skills, with experience in pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn and at least one gradient boosting library such as XGBoost or LightGBM. * Sound understanding of classification, probability estimation, feature selection, class imbalance, calibration and temporal validation. Ability to interpret scorecard performance and stability metrics correctly. * Experience working with large datasets, developing reproducible analytical code, and collaborating with engineers to put models into production. description: Morgan Stanley is seeking a Data Scientist to join the CDRR Technology team within the Fraud Department. The position is responsible for the development of statistical and machine learning models used to identify, assess, and mitigate fraud risk across Morgan Stanley products. The successful candidate will independently execute model development assignments, including exploratory data analysis, analytical dataset construction, feature engineering, algorithm selection, model training, performance evaluation, and technical documentation. The role requires demonstrated expertise in the mathematical and statistical foundations of classical supervised and unsupervised machine learning methods and the ability to apply those methods to large, complex, and imperfect real-world datasets. This is a Director-level individual contributor position and does not include formal people-management responsibilities. The individual will manage assigned model development projects with guidance from senior members of the team. The individual will also provide technical guidance and mentoring to junior Data Scientists and Data Engineers. Since 1935, Morgan Stanley is known as a global leader in financial services, always evolving and innovating to better serve our clients and our communities in more than 40 countries around the world. **What You'll Do In The Role** * Independently execute end-to-end model development, including technical documentation. * Develop and evaluate models for highly imbalanced, non-stationary, and adversarial environments where fraud patterns, customer behaviour, and operational processes evolve over time. * Apply statistical and mathematical principles to model selection, validation, and performance assessment, including the treatment of class imbalance, overfitting, data leakage, missing data, and model stability. * Monitor deployed models, diagnose performance degradation, assess emerging fraud patterns, and recommend recalibration, redevelopment, threshold changes, or retirement as appropriate. **What You'll Bring To The Role** * 6+ years of professional experience in data science, machine learning, statistical modeling, or quantitative analytics. * Demonstrated depth of knowledge in statistical inference, probability, sampling, hypothesis testing, regularization, bias-variance trade-offs, optimization, feature selection, dimensionality reduction, model calibration, and statistical diagnostics. * Hands-on experience performing exploratory data analysis, constructing analytical datasets, and engineering features from large, complex, and imperfect real-world data. * Advanced proficiency in Python and SQL, and experience with Hadoop, Hive, Impala, Spark, or PySpark. * Experience designing statistically valid training, validation, and testing approaches and evaluating models using appropriate performance, calibration, stability, and diagnostic measures. * Demonstrated ability to independently manage model development assignments and produce technical documentation suitable for review and governance. * Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Including the ability to communicate complex analytical methods and results to technical and non-technical stakeholders. **Good To Have** * Experience developing machine learning or statistical models for fraud detection, financial crime, transaction monitoring, payment risk, or anomalous-behavior detection. * Experience analyzing high-volume transactional, account, client, or behavioral data within financial services. * Knowledge of fraud typologies, risk indicators, and security issues applicable to banking or Wealth Management. * Experience developing models within a regulated environment subject to Model Risk Management, validation, documentation, and governance requirements. * Experience with data-visualization and reporting tools such as Tableau.lmk **What You Can Expect From Morgan Stanley** At Morgan Stanley, we raise, manage and allocate capital for our clients – helping them reach their goals. We do it in a way that’s differentiated – and we’ve done that for 90 years. Our values - putting clients first, doing the right thing, leading with exceptional ideas, committing to diversity and inclusion, and giving back - aren’t just beliefs, they guide the decisions we make every day to do what's best for our clients, communities and more than 80,000 employees in 1,200 offices across 42 countries. If you need an accommodation or adjustment due to a disability during the application or recruiting process, please submit a request at https://expedia.service-now.com/askeg?id=job\_accommodation. **About Expedia Group** Expedia Group includes three flagship consumer brands - Expedia, Hotels.com, and Vrbo - along with a leading B2B travel business and travel advertising offerings. Our no-code platform delivers the fastest time to market, lowest total cost of ownership, and simple, scalable management of AI agents for any CX use case. Backed by WndrCo, Y Combinator, and Index Ventures, we help enterprises drive efficiency, lower costs, and deliver higher quality customer experiences. Want to be part of the AI revolution and transform how the world’s largest global brands do business? Join us! **About The Role** We are looking for a DevOps Engineer to work collaboratively with the software development team to deploy and operate the systems. You'll be responsible to ensure the system is running smoothly and is being monitored continuously to resolve issues. **Responsibilities** * Kubernetes Management * Design, deploy, and manage Kubernetes clusters. * Configure and enforce RBAC policies and access control mechanisms. * Optimize cluster performance and scalability. * CI/CD Pipeline Development * Build, maintain, and enhance CI/CD pipelines using tools like Jenkins, ArgoCD, Spinnaker, or similar. * Automate deployment processes to improve delivery efficiency and reduce lead times. * Helm Templates * Develop, maintain, and optimize Helm charts for Kubernetes applications. * Ensure proper versioning and deployment strategies through Helm. * Service Mesh Implementation * Integrate and manage service meshes such as Istio or Linkerd for service discovery, load balancing, and secure communication. * Implement observability and traffic management within the service mesh. * Scripting and Automation * Write and maintain automation scripts using Python, Ruby, or Golang. * Leverage scripts for infrastructure provisioning, monitoring, and debugging. * (Bonus) Chaos & Resilience Engineering * Implement chaos engineering principles to test and improve system reliability. * Simulate failures and measure system resilience to ensure production readiness. **Requirements** * Experience: At least 2 years in DevOps or a related field. * Tools and Technologies: * Kubernetes (RBAC, cluster administration, Helm). * CI/CD tools such as Jenkins, ArgoCD, or Spinnaker. * Service mesh solutions like Istio, Linkerd, or similar. * Hands-on experience with Amazon ECS and Terraform is a mandatory requirement for this role. * Skills: * Proficiency in scripting languages (Python, Ruby, Golang). * Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure). * Strong understanding of system design, networking, and infrastructure management. * Bonus Skills: Knowledge and experience in chaos engineering tools like Chaos Monkey, LitmusChaos, or Gremlin. title: DevOps Engineer - Netwrix DevOps Group
description: **About Us** At Netwrix, our mission is to revolutionize data security by placing identity at the core - providing unparalleled visibility and control. Engineered and supported by over 900 highly talented, motivated employees and hundreds of trusted partners in nearly every geography, Netwrix solutions are relied upon daily by security professionals across more than 13,500 organizations in over 100 countries around the world. Over the past two decades, Netwrix has expanded its market presence through innovation, organic growth, and strategic acquisitions, and are proud to be backed by renowned private equity firms, TA Associates and Centerbridge Partners. Netwrix maintains a global presence, fostering a remote-first work environment while encouraging and facilitating frequent face-to-face interaction with colleagues, customers, and partners. **Position Overview** We are building a cutting-edge Platform that will transform the way our customers identify, protect and govern their data. This will revolutionize how customers secure their data by placing identity at the core – providing unparalleled visibility and control. We are seeking a ****DevOps Engineer**** with a strong background in ****cloud infrastructure and architecture**** and ****team leadership**** to help define and standardize how we build out our unified security platform. We primarily build our offerings in ****Microsoft Azure**** , and candidates for this role should be experts in the various services and capabilities provided in the Azure ecosystem. Additionally, we’re looking for someone that can raise the bar on both our ****CI/CD maturity and operational posture**** . ****This role requires proximity to Pune, India.**** **Key Responsibilities** Cloud Infrastructure Management * Design, provision, and manage secure, scalable, and highly available Azure environments supporting multiple discrete security products. * Architect and maintain modular infrastructure-as-code (IaC) templates utilizing Terraform to ensure consistent, repeatable deployments across development, staging, and production environments. * Implement cloud governance, cost optimization strategies, and Azure policies to maintain a lean and compliant cloud footprint. CI/CD * Build and optimize robust CI/CD pipelines within GitHub Actions to automate building, testing, and deploying multi-product applications. * Streamline development workflows by integrating automated security scanning (SAST/DAST), dependency checking, and vulnerability assessments directly into the GitHub workflow. Collaboration and Agile Operations * Partner closely with product development teams to translate complex engineering requirements into scalable infrastructure solutions. * Leverage Jira to manage sprint workflows, track infrastructure tasks, document system architectures, and ensure seamless communication across cross-functional engineering teams. * Participate in an on-call rotation and drive root-cause analysis (RCA) for infrastructure incidents, continually improving system resilience. **Required** ****Qualifications**** * Experience: 2+ years of dedicated DevOps or Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) experience, preferably within a SaaS or multi-product environment. * Cloud Platform: Proven expertise in Azure services (e.g. AKS, App Services, Azure Functions, Azure SQL, Key Vault, Entra ID, etc). * Infrastructure as Code: Advanced proficiency with Terraform, including writing custom modules and managing complex state files in a team environment. * CI/CD & Version Control: Deep understanding of GitHub, Git workflows, and building enterprise-grade GitHub Actions pipelines. * Monitoring: Deep expertise in a solution like Datadog or New Relic, along with alerting integrations like Incident.io or PagerDuty. * Agile Tooling: Strong familiarity with Jira for task tracking, sprint planning, and documenting operations. **Preferred** * Security Mindset: Experience working in a security-first environment or security software company; familiarity with compliance frameworks (e.g., SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA). * Containerization: Experience managing and orchestrating containers using Docker and Kubernetes (AKS). * Certifications: Microsoft Certified: Azure DevOps Engineer Expert or HashiCorp Certified: Terraform Associate. ****Our Values**** **At Netwrix, Our Values Guide Every Action** * Next-Level Customer Focus -Customers first, always. We listen, protect, and go the extra mile— because their success is our mission. * Excellence - We set high standards and take pride in delivering exceptional results. We celebrate wins, seek constant improvement, and address shortcomings professionally. * Transparent Ownership - We celebrate our successes, own up to our mistakes, communicate openly, and face challenges head-on with a genuine commitment to doing the right thing. * Winning with Clear Thinking - We value clarity, find straightforward solutions to complex problems, and make swift, effective decisions. * Relentless Innovation - We continually seek better ways to serve our customers and stay ahead. We foster creative thinking, and we embrace new approaches. * Industry-Leading Expertise - We take pride in our expertise and continuously seek to learn and share knowledge, striving to be the trusted experts our customers rely on. * eXceptional Together - We believe in the power of collaboration and diverse perspectives. By valuing each other’s strengths, we achieve outcomes that surpass individual contributions. Join us in a culture where integrity, respect, and hard work are foundational. Be part of a team dedicated to making a lasting impact. ****Why You’ll Love Working at Netwrix**** * Competitive Health Benefits * Continuous Learning and Development Opportunities * Team-Oriented, Collaborative, and Innovative Work Environment * Regular Company Town Halls to Keep You Informed * Opportunities for Career Growth and Advancement We pride ourselves on a culture that truly values employee input across various backgrounds and experiences. We look forward to welcoming new talent who can help us further our mission. Netwrix Corporation and its wholly owned subsidiaries are Equal Opportunity Employers (EEO) and welcome all applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law. Please let us know if you require any accommodation.

requirements for the implementation of changes by setting policy and standards. * Report on established KPIs to ensure performance is measured against expected business outcomes. **Requirements** **Functional** **Done it:** * 4 to 5 years of relevant experience in cloud-based infrastructure architecture, administration and monitoring. * In-depth knowledge and hands-on experience of AWS * collaboration. * Experience in inter-cloud migration. * Experience with scripting languages like Python, Ruby, PowerShell or Bash. * Advanced experience with usage and management of Git version control technologies (GitHub, Gitlab, AWS Commit etc.) * Proven experience applying best practices for frontend and backend infrastructure (web engines, relational databases, storage, network, disaster recovery, high availability) * Experience troubleshooting complex issues ranging from system resources to application stack traces **Know It** * Hands on in GCP/Azure * Experience with continuous Integration tools (TeamCity, Azure DevOps, Gitlab CI/CD, AWS Code Pipeline) * Working knowledge of automation service provisioning. * Hands on experience with IAC tools such as Ansible, Chef, Terraform,CloudFormation, Bicep, Typescript, Azure ARM etc. * Hands on in containerization technologies (Docker, Kubernetes, Docker Swarm, AWS Fargate) * Strong knowledge of Identity and Access Management * Secure systems & networks’ management through automation, capacity planning, monitoring, performance tuning and testing * You are aware of information security at large Networks, Docker security, Kubernetes Security. * Strong hardware and software diagnostic skills **Shown It** * Familiarity with web development experience and setup: Apache, Nginx etc. * Familiarity with Agile/Scrum process using platforms like Jira/Confluence * Experience with Grafana, Prometheus, ELK/EFK stack * Demonstrable experience in converting complex business & security needs into fit-for-purpose, straightforward solutions, with well-managed execution and non interruptive transition to operations, as well as effective troubleshooting & escalation handling. * Demonstrated competencies in system administration. DevOps or systems knowledge, security protocols for client/server environment. * Experience supporting at least one of the following databases: MS-SQL server, MySQL, MongoDB, PostgreSQL etc. * Working knowledge of related technologies including encryption, IPsec, VLANs, VPNs, routing, firewalls, proxy services, LAN/WAN connectivity **Do it** * Experience on SCM tools like GitHub, Gitlab, Bitbucket, AWS Code Commit, Azure Repos etc. * Experience in application and systems performance monitoring (Splunk, New Relic, Azure Monitor, AWS CloudWatch). * Excellent communication, interpersonal, analytical and problem-solving skills. * Continuous application of skillsets in, cloud and hybrid environments adding resiliency when introducing new and upcoming technologies. * Experience with API Gee, Kong, or Kafka from an operational perspective will be a good to have. * Read and understand release notes and follow the deployment instructions precisely to ensure zero defects in the deployment. * Experience on open source/Linux will be good to have. **Competencies** * A communicator, humble and patient individual working effectively with distributed teams who is equally a mentor and a mentee * A creative mindset that brings ideas to life by leveraging technologies in new ways that could have high impact in every aspect of operations * A technical player who is trusted to identify challenges and define how to overcome them. * A multi-tasker and flexible towards work timings, working in a fast-paced environment without getting overwhelmed easily. * Detail-oriented, always ready to put in the extra effort to deliver polished, well-formed IT solutions for Material. * Mindful of the employee experience - articulate, confident & well-spoken in all forms of communication, comfortable to be the voice of our customer to Material IT, and the face of Material IT to our customers.

As Engineer 2, Cloud Delivery Engineer, you'll staff Experience-Based Acceleration (EBA / SBA) and other acceleration events, partner with lean application teams, and build Terraform that operationalizes AWS services and third-party platforms like Confluent Kafka and Kong. If you like shipping real workloads to the cloud with a globally distributed team across the US and India, this is your seat. **Job Overview** As the Engineer 2, Cloud Delivery Engineer, you are a hands-on mid-level cloud engineer in the Delivery team within LPL's Cloud Center of Excellence (CCOE). Delivery is CCOE's internal professional-services team: it staffs Experience-Based Acceleration (EBA / SBA) and other acceleration events with white-glove delivery support, partners with less-funded application teams to get their workloads onto the AWS cloud, and engineers Infrastructure-as-Code solutions that operationalize AWS services and third-party platforms (for example, Confluent Kafka and Kong). You also help migrate application workloads into the multi-account landing zone. LPL is an AWS-first CCOE: a multi-account landing zone with 100+ private reusable Terraform modules that enable 60+ AWS services, all delivered through Terraform Cloud and GitHub Actions. You partner with the Platforms and Containers teams, the Support team, and the Foundations pods (Security & Governance, FinOps, Functional Design Engineering & Strategy, Network Engineering, Monitoring), and you spend the majority of your time hands-on in Terraform and delivery work across LPL's US offices and India Global Capability Center (GCC) — leaving the teams you help able to run what you built together. **Responsibilities** * Deliver white-glove cloud delivery support during Experience-Based Acceleration (EBA / SBA) and other acceleration events — embedding with application teams to land workloads on AWS quickly and correctly * Partner with less-funded / lean application teams to deliver their applications to the cloud: reference-architecture guidance, hands-on Terraform, and pairing that leaves the team able to run what you built together * Engineer Infrastructure-as-Code solutions that operationalize AWS services — turning a raw AWS capability into a paved, reusable path consumable through the private Terraform module library * Operationalize third-party systems on AWS (for example, Confluent Kafka and Kong) as Terraform-managed, supportable title: Fresher - ERP Full Stack Developer (MERN & NestJS)
description: **Job Description** Job Description Fresher – ERP Full Stack Developer (MERN & NestJS) **Company:** Gway Tech Solutions Private Limited **Department:** Product Development **Experience:** Fresher **Employment Type:** Full-Time * Role Overview Gway Tech Solutions Private Limited is looking for enthusiastic, analytical, and technology-driven freshers to join our ERP development team. The selected candidates will work on GwayERP and other enterprise application projects, gaining practical experience in developing scalable business applications using **NestJS, Node.js, React.js, TypeScript, MongoDB, and modern AI-assisted development tools** . This role is suitable for candidates who have a strong foundation in programming, a genuine interest in software development, and the willingness to learn new technologies, understand business processes, and contribute to real-world ERP applications. Candidates will participate in the complete software development lifecycle, including requirement understanding, development, debugging, testing, deployment support, and maintenance. We are looking for individuals who can combine **strong technical fundamentals, rapid learning, AI-assisted development, problem-solving, ownership, and accountability** to deliver quality software efficiently. ****Our Development Philosophy:**** **Understand the Requirement → Develop Rapidly → Validate Thoroughly → Deliver Quality → Continuously Improve** Candidates are not expected to know every technology on their first day. However, they must demonstrate a strong willingness to learn, experiment, solve problems independently, and apply their knowledge to practical development challenges. * Key Responsibilities * ERP Application Development * Understand ERP requirements and business workflows. * Develop and maintain ERP modules under the guidance of experienced developers. * Understand the relationship between different ERP modules. * Implement new features and enhancements. * Fix bugs and resolve application issues. * Follow established development standards. * Ensure new developments do not unnecessarily affect existing functionality. * Participate in the complete development lifecycle. * Learn how enterprise applications support real-world business operations. The candidate will gain exposure to integrated ERP applications covering multiple business functions. * Understanding ERP Business Processes **Develop An Understanding Of Enterprise Workflows, Including:** * Sales * Purchase * Procurement * Inventory * Production and Manufacturing * Finance and Accounts * Customer Relationship Management (CRM) * Service Management * HR and Payroll * Project Management * Reports and Dashboards * Master Data Management * Approval Workflows * User and Role Management * Notifications * API Integrations * Document Management The candidate should learn to translate a business requirement into a technical implementation. **Business Requirement → Workflow → API → Database → User Interface → Validation → Testing** A willingness to understand why a feature is required, rather than simply implementing instructions, is essential. * Full Stack Development The candidate will work on both backend and frontend development. Backend Development **Learn, Develop, And Maintain Backend Services Using:** * NestJS * Node.js * TypeScript * REST API development * Mongoose ODM * MongoDB * API integration * Request validation * Error handling * Authentication and authorization * Business logic implementation * Backend debugging and optimization **Responsibilities Include:** * Developing backend functionality. * Implementing APIs based on requirements. * Integrating APIs with frontend applications. * Debugging backend errors. * Following existing architectural patterns. * Writing clean, reusable, and maintainable code. Frontend Development **Develop And Maintain User Interfaces Using:** * React.js * JavaScript * TypeScript * Redux * Redux-Saga * Formik * React Hook Form (RHF) * Reusable React components * State management * REST API integration * Form validation * Responsive UI development **Responsibilities Include:** * Developing reusable frontend components. * Implementing forms and business workflows. * Integrating APIs. * Managing application state. * Debugging UI issues. * Implementing appropriate validation and error handling. * Following existing UI/UX designs. * Ensuring functionality works correctly across supported browsers. * MongoDB & Database Development The candidate will gain practical experience working with MongoDB in enterprise applications. **Responsibilities Include:** * Understanding MongoDB collections and documents. * Working with Mongoose schemas. * Developing database queries. * Implementing CRUD operations. * Understanding relationships between ERP entities. * Learning MongoDB aggregation pipelines. * Debugging database-related issues. * Following data validation standards. * Understanding data integrity and consistency. * Learning basic database performance optimization. The candidate must handle database changes carefully, particularly when working with existing ERP data. * AI-Assisted Development **Active use of AI tools for software development is an important expectation of this role.** The candidate should learn to use AI-assisted development tools to improve development speed, accuracy, and problem-solving ability. **AI Tools Should Be Used To Support:** * Understanding unfamiliar code. * Generating code suggestions. * Debugging errors. * Explaining technical concepts. * Refactoring code. * Developing API functionality. * Creating test cases. * Understanding database queries. * Preparing technical documentation. * Investigating implementation approaches. * Identifying potential edge cases. * Improving repetitive development activities. The candidate must understand that AI-generated code should never be accepted blindly. All AI-assisted code must be reviewed, understood, validated, and tested before being used in the application. **The Candidate Should Continuously Learn To Answer:** * Can this requirement be implemented more efficiently? * Can AI help identify the root cause of this bug? * Can repetitive development work be automated? * Can the solution be made more accurate and maintainable? * Have the generated changes been properly tested? **The expectation is not simply to use AI, but to use it intelligently to produce better software in less time.** * Rapid Development & Productivity The candidate should develop the ability to complete assigned development tasks efficiently without compromising quality. **Responsibilities Include:** * Understanding requirements before coding. * Breaking tasks into manageable steps. * Reusing existing components and services. * Following established coding patterns. * Avoiding unnecessary code duplication. * Identifying and resolving development blockers. * Minimizing avoidable rework. * Completing assigned tasks within agreed timelines. * Using AI tools appropriately to accelerate development. * Continuously improving technical skills and productivity. The objective is to deliver **more useful, reliable functionality in less time** , rather than simply writing more code. * Ownership & Accountability We expect candidates to demonstrate responsibility for the tasks assigned to them. **Responsibilities Include:** * Understanding assigned requirements clearly. * Taking responsibility for task completion. * Providing progress updates. * Communicating blockers promptly. * Meeting agreed delivery timelines. * Testing completed functionality. * Fixing issues identified during testing. * Following tasks through to completion. * Asking relevant questions when requirements are unclear. * Learning from mistakes and avoiding repeated errors. * Documenting important implementation details where required. Candidates should develop the habit of taking ownership of their work rather than waiting for continuous instructions. **If you encounter a problem, investigate it, understand it, attempt a solution, and communicate clearly when assistance is required.** * Code Quality & Development Standards The candidate must learn and follow established software development standards. **Responsibilities Include:** * Writing clean and readable code. * Following naming conventions. * Developing reusable components and services. * Avoiding unnecessary duplication. * Implementing proper error handling. * Following validation standards. * Understanding separation of concerns. * Following existing application architecture. * Participating in code reviews. * Addressing review feedback. * Maintaining basic technical documentation. * Avoiding unnecessary changes to unrelated functionality. The objective is to develop software that can be maintained and enhanced by other developers. * Git, GitHub & Version Control Practical knowledge of Git and GitHub is expected. **Responsibilities Include:** * Using Git for version control. * Creating and managing branches. * Committing code with meaningful messages. * Pushing changes to GitHub. * Understanding pull requests. * Resolving basic merge conflicts. * Following the organization's branching strategy. * Keeping changes organized. * Participating in code reviews. * Learning how version control supports collaborative development. Candidates must understand the importance of protecting the existing codebase and avoiding unapproved changes to production code. * Jenkins, CI/CD & Deployment Support The candidate will gain exposure to automated build and deployment processes. **Responsibilities Include:** * Understanding Jenkins pipelines. * Learning continuous integration and continuous deployment. * Supporting application build processes. * Investigating build failures. * Understanding application deployment workflows. * Supporting deployment-related troubleshooting. * Following release procedures. * Learning how code moves from development to testing and production. * Coordinating with the DevOps team when environment-related issues arise. The candidate should gradually develop a practical understanding of the complete software delivery lifecycle. * Debugging & Problem Solving Strong analytical and problem-solving ability is essential. **The Candidate Should Learn To Investigate:** * Frontend errors. * Backend errors. * API failures. * Database issues. * Integration problems. * Validation errors. * Unexpected application behaviour. * Performance issues. * Business workflow inconsistencies. * Browser-specific issues. **The Expected Troubleshooting Approach Is:** **Understand the Problem → Reproduce It → Investigate the Cause → Implement a Solution → Test the Fix → Prevent Recurrence** Candidates should demonstrate the ability to investigate problems systematically rather than relying only on trial and error. * Testing & Application Reliability The candidate will be responsible for validating assigned development work before considering it complete. **Responsibilities Include:** * Testing new functionality. * Validating API responses. * Testing input validation. * Checking error handling. * Verifying database operations. * Testing relevant business workflows. * Identifying edge cases. * Fixing defects. * Supporting QA activities. * Retesting resolved issues. * Ensuring existing functionality has not been unintentionally affected. The candidate should understand that a feature is not complete merely because the code has been written. **A task is complete when the functionality works as expected and the implementation has been appropriately validated.** * Current & Future Product Development The candidate will contribute to the continued development of GwayERP and other enterprise applications. **Responsibilities Include:** * Understanding the existing application architecture. * Learning the purpose of different ERP modules. * Developing new functionality. * Supporting enhancements to existing modules. * Fixing reported defects. * Implementing API integrations. * Improving existing code where required. * Learning application performance optimization. * Following established architectural patterns. * Adapting to new technical requirements. * Contributing to future product development. * Technical Learning & Continuous Improvement We are looking for candidates who are serious about building a career in software development. **The Candidate Is Expected To:** * Learn unfamiliar technologies when required. * Research technical problems independently. * Read official documentation. * Understand the code before modifying it. * Practise effective debugging. * Learn from code reviews. * Improve programming fundamentals. * Develop a deeper understanding of ERP workflows. * Explore AI-assisted development methods. * Improve development speed without sacrificing quality. * Document useful findings and solutions. * Stay updated with relevant development practices. **Your ability to learn, apply knowledge, and improve continuously is more important than knowing every technology at the time of joining.** * Required Technical Skills Backend * Basic knowledge of JavaScript or TypeScript. * Fundamental understanding of Node.js. * Basic understanding of NestJS or willingness to learn it. * Understanding of REST APIs. * Basic knowledge of backend application development. Frontend * Basic knowledge of React.js. * Understanding of HTML and CSS. * JavaScript fundamentals. * Basic understanding of component-based development. * Familiarity with frontend API integration. Database * Basic understanding of MongoDB. * Familiarity with CRUD operations. * Willingness to learn Mongoose ODM. * Understanding of data structures and validation. Development Tools * Git and GitHub fundamentals. * Familiarity with VS Code or a similar development environment. * Willingness to learn Jenkins and CI/CD. * Familiarity with AI-assisted development tools. Good to Have * TypeScript. * NestJS. * Redux and Redux-Saga. * Formik. * React Hook Form. * MongoDB aggregation. * Docker fundamentals. * Basic API testing. * Familiarity with ERP or business applications. * Eligibility & Experience * Fresh graduates in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or a related discipline may apply. * Candidates with 0–1 year of relevant experience are welcome. * Academic projects, internships, personal projects, and practical coding experience will be considered. * Candidates should have a genuine interest in full-stack development. * A strong understanding of programming fundamentals is expected. * Practical knowledge demonstrated through projects is an advantage. **We value demonstrated ability, learning potential, problem-solving skills, and commitment over the number of technologies listed on a resume.** * Professional Qualities **The Ideal Candidate Should Demonstrate:** * Strong willingness to learn. * Logical and analytical thinking. * Problem-solving ability. * Attention to detail. * Ownership of assigned work. * Accountability. * Good communication. * Time management. * Adaptability. * Curiosity about technology. * Willingness to accept feedback. * Ability to work collaboratively. * Commitment to continuous improvement. * Responsible use of AI tools. * Interest in understanding business processes. * Performance Expectations The candidate's progress and performance will be evaluated based on: * Understanding of assigned requirements. * Quality of code. * Development speed and consistency. * Accuracy of implementation. * Ability to debug issues. * Completion of assigned tasks within agreed timelines. * Effective use of AI-assisted development. * Reduction in avoidable rework. * Adherence to coding standards. * Quality of testing. * Understanding of ERP workflows. * Collaboration with the development team. * Willingness to learn and apply new technologies. * Improvement in individual productivity over time. The expectation is to progressively become a dependable developer who can handle increasingly complex ERP development tasks. * Growth Opportunity This role provides an opportunity to gain practical experience in building enterprise ERP applications. **The Candidate Will Develop Skills Across:** **Programming Fundamentals → Full Stack Development → ERP Workflows → API Development → Database Design → AI-Assisted Development → Testing → Deployment → Production Application Development** As technical capability improves, the candidate will have the opportunity to work on more complex modules, integrations, application enhancements, and development responsibilities. * The Ideal Candidate We are looking for a fresher who is enthusiastic about software development and interested in solving real business problems through technology. You do not need to know everything before joining. **However, You Should Be Willing To:** * Learn new technologies. * Understand business requirements. * Write and test code. * Investigate errors. * Use AI tools intelligently. * Take responsibility for assigned tasks. * Meet agreed timelines. * Improve your technical skills continuously. * Understand how ERP applications support businesses. * Deliver reliable and maintainable software. We are particularly interested in candidates who can combine **rapid learning, disciplined development, AI-assisted productivity, and a strong sense of responsibility** . Our Expectation We do not expect you to be an expert on your first day. We expect you to become better every day. If you are ready to learn, build, experiment, solve problems, and contribute to real-world ERP products, we would like to hear from you. How to Apply Interested candidates should submit their application through the official recruitment website. For quicker communication regarding your application, you may send a WhatsApp message to our official HR number after submitting your application through the website. We appreciate your patience and look forward to connecting with candidates who are passionate about learning, growing, and building a successful career with Gway Tech Solutions Private Limited. **HR Contact Details** **WhatsApp:** +91 7200082250 **Email:** hr@gwayit.com
